agents & orchestration.title: Agents lack shared state and messaging channels
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents working in parallel or across tools have no safe way to share state, message each other or hand off sessions. They fall back on shared files and ad hoc channels that cause conflicts, overwrites and duplicates.
agents & orchestration.who: developers and teams running multi-agent or multi-tool setups
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Shared files, JSON files on disk, Redis scratchpads, Slack as an interoperability layer, IRC-style chatrooms, file reservation via MCP, Slipstream protocol
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a cross-framework coordination layer with shared state, versioning, messaging, identity, audit logs and shared sessions.

agents & orchestration.title: Multi-agent collusion and emergent misbehavior
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents collude, lie and amplify bad behavior, and they are hard to trust or oversee when delegating to agents they do not own. Few monitoring or legal mechanisms exist.
agents & orchestration.who: operators and platforms running many interacting agents
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Manual cleanup; proposals for encrypted agent spaces with human visibility
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build monitoring, reputation gating and audit tooling for inter-agent communication.

agents & orchestration.title: Agents escape guardrails and need trajectory monitoring
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents have broken out of sandboxes and circumvented restrictions, and per-step checks miss harmful sequences. Monitoring is immature.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Pre-execution command verification, tighter sandbox configuration
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build monitoring that evaluates whole action sequences and flags policy circumvention.

agents & orchestration.title: Dashboards to supervise many parallel agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Running many concurrent agents overwhelms people with context switching, notifications and review work. There is no good single view of status or what needs attention.
agents & orchestration.who: developers running many coding agents in parallel
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: tmux setups, Vibe Kanban, Superset, Conductor, Gastown, Emdash, custom TUIs, ticket-based small tasks
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a control tower that shows status, summarizes work, triages interruptions and queues reviews across agents.

agents & orchestration.title: Steering and inspecting agents mid-run
agents & orchestration.problem: Users cannot redirect or inspect running agent jobs without stopping them, and micromanaging is tiring. Intermediate decisions are hard to see.
agents & orchestration.who: people delegating long async tasks to agents
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Mid-task follow-up messages, Plannotator plan annotation, asking the model to explain itself
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an interface for mid-run steering, plan and diff annotation and decision visibility.

agents & orchestration.title: Orchestrators for parallel coding agents and worktrees
agents & orchestration.problem: Splitting work among parallel or nested coding agents needs planning, branch isolation and merge handling, and teams are building orchestrators themselves. Harnesses differ across providers.
agents & orchestration.who: developers using several coding agents on one codebase
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Git worktrees, Gas Town, Claude Code agent teams, Kimi swarms, Omnigent, Replit Parallel Agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an open, harness-agnostic orchestrator that plans non-overlapping work, manages worktrees and merges results.

agents & orchestration.title: Subagent fan-out and orchestrator templates
agents & orchestration.problem: Spawning and coordinating subagents is confusing, and developers face decision fatigue. Subagents are useful for keeping parent context clean.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude subagents, lead-plus-async patterns, master agent with specialist agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer templates and defaults for fan-out, summarizing subagents and specialist teams.

agents & orchestration.title: Subagents duplicate work, drift and add noise
agents & orchestration.problem: Multi-agent teams duplicate work, argue, drift off role and leak context between tasks, sometimes underperforming a single agent.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Fresh-context subagents, scoped contracts, role clarity, human-defined task graphs
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a dispatcher that scopes subagent context, task ownership and roles and filters noise.

agents & orchestration.title: Is multi-agent orchestration worth the cost?
agents & orchestration.problem: It is disputed whether subagents and teams add capability or just burn tokens and reallocate compute.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Single-agent-first guidance

agents & orchestration.title: Agentic software factories from ticket to release
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want agents to handle tickets, PRs, CI and alerts with humans writing specs, but nobody has figured out the full pipeline. Token costs are high.
agents & orchestration.who: engineering teams and enterprises automating software production
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: In-house headless harnesses, Flue, Factory.ai, StrongDM Software Factory, OpenAI Symphony, Sentry-triggered agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a platform guiding setup of ticket-to-review-to-release agent pipelines with human gates and cost analytics.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent memory is unreliable and hard to maintain
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents forget across sessions, and memory drifts, accumulates contradictions, stores irrelevant facts and is costly to maintain. There is no agreement on architecture.
agents & orchestration.who: developers building agents with persistent memory
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Markdown memory files, Mimir, Supermemory, Honcho, Hyperspell, consolidation passes, wiki-style memory
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a pluggable memory service with consolidation, dedupe, scoping and inspection.

agents & orchestration.title: Portable, visible, shared agent memory
agents & orchestration.problem: Memory is siloed in tool-specific hidden stores, so users cannot inspect, edit, export or share it across agents, vendors or teams.
agents & orchestration.who: users of multiple agents and enterprises
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Shared markdown files, hook-based injection, Notion shared memory, open-format memory
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a vendor-neutral memory store with export, editing, scoping and per-user isolation.

agents & orchestration.title: Durable agent identity and state over long horizons
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents struggle to keep state and identity over weeks, and it is unclear whether sessions should be perpetual or ephemeral.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: File-based architectures, daily coordinators with ephemeral subagents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer durable agent state with snapshots, fork/resume and a meta-coordination layer.

agents & orchestration.title: Context compaction is lossy and drops instructions
agents & orchestration.problem: Compaction loses constraints, decisions and safety instructions, causing drift and even destructive actions after compaction.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Manual summaries and restarts, server-side compaction, notes to files
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a compaction layer that pins instructions, preserves retrievable pre-compaction text and audits summaries.

agents & orchestration.title: Trimming and structuring agent context
agents & orchestration.problem: Tool outputs, repeated reads and long prompts bloat context, and teams need ways to keep it small, such as recursive models and filesystem-style access.
agents & orchestration.who: agent builders, especially with small-context models
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Recursive Language Models, output clipping, deduplicated reads, filesystem navigation
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Package context-management policies as a reusable middleware or harness library.

agents & orchestration.title: Tool definitions burn tokens; MCP versus CLI and code
agents & orchestration.problem: Loading many MCP tool schemas wastes tokens and hurts tool selection, and developers look to CLIs, code execution and deferred loading.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: MCPorter, mcp-cli, Code Mode, deferred tool search, programmatic tool calling
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a gateway that lazy-loads and ranks tools and converts MCP servers into token-efficient CLIs or code APIs.

agents & orchestration.title: Debate over MCP, skills or CLIs for agent tools
agents & orchestration.problem: Practitioners disagree on which interface best extends agents.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Skills, CLIs, MCP servers

agents & orchestration.title: MCP setup, debugging and spec friction
agents & orchestration.problem: MCP connections fail with opaque errors, setup is hard, and statefulness and spec gaps cause migration and scaling problems.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: ngrok workarounds, FastMCP, reading GitHub issues, stateless MCP proposals
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build MCP debugging, validation, migration and hosting tools.

agents & orchestration.title: Governed gateways for MCP servers
agents & orchestration.problem: Organizations lose track of which agents reach which tools and credentials, and need centralized access, auditing and discovery.
agents & orchestration.who: enterprises deploying agents with many tools
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Runlayer, ToolHive, Executor gateway, LangChain Auth Proxy
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer a managed MCP gateway with registry, RBAC, secret isolation and audit logs.

agents & orchestration.title: Durable, resumable execution for long-running agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents crash or restart and lose state, and need checkpoints, queues, retries and rollback.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Temporal, DBOS, LangGraph checkpoints, Render Workflows, Durable Objects
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a lightweight durable runtime for agents with checkpoint, resume and branching.

agents & orchestration.title: Deterministic validators and workflow graphs around LLMs
agents & orchestration.problem: Models do not reliably follow prompt rules, and fully agentic flows deviate, so teams want deterministic code to control and validate LLM steps.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Blueprints, DAG planners, validators plus human approval, state machines
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a framework mixing deterministic nodes and LLM nodes with verifier gates.

agents & orchestration.title: Compile agent runs into replayable automations
agents & orchestration.problem: Calling an LLM at every step is slow and costly, and brittle RPA fails, so successful runs and recorded workflows could become deterministic automations.
agents & orchestration.who: teams automating GUI and business workflows
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: ActionEngine, guarded replay state machines, AgentHandover
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Record agent runs or human workflows and compile them into replayable workflows or skills.

agents & orchestration.title: Long-running agents drift, stall and compound errors
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents lose focus, stop early, falsely report progress and accumulate errors over long runs.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Nudging, goal reminders, external memory, supervising models, stronger models
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a harness add-on that checks goal adherence, verifies completion and resumes stalled agents.

agents & orchestration.title: Runaway loops and run-until-done control
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents get stuck in retry loops burning tokens, while developers also deliberately loop agents until criteria are met with unpredictable control.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Step limits, iteration caps, Ralph Wiggum loops
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build loop runners with completion criteria, cost anomaly detection and automatic halts.

agents & orchestration.title: Hosted scheduled and always-on agent runners
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents stop when a laptop sleeps, and recurring or event-triggered jobs need a hosted environment with scheduling and monitoring.
agents & orchestration.who: users with recurring or background agent tasks
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude Routines, /loop, cron prompts, heartbeat checks, Cowork scheduled tasks
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build hosted agent scheduling with triggers, retries and a view of automations.

agents & orchestration.title: Background agents triggered from team tools
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want async agents triggered by alerts, webhooks or Slack, but background UX is unclear and notifications are noisy.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude Tag, OpenAI Dots, on-call triage containers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build trigger-driven background agents with scoped access and review that surface only what matters.

agents & orchestration.title: Tool design and tool-call failures
agents & orchestration.problem: Poorly designed tools and malformed tool calls across models and providers make agents unreliable and slow.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Outcome-oriented tool design, OpenRouter response healing, tool-call limits, rewritten descriptions
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a linter, validator and repair layer for tool definitions and calls.

agents & orchestration.title: Sandbox runtimes for agent code
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents running untrusted code need fast, cheap, isolated and persistent sandboxes with snapshots and controlled egress.
agents & orchestration.who: teams running agents that execute code
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Modal, Daytona, E2B, Firecracker, gVisor, LangSmith Sandboxes, Cloudflare containers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer sandboxes with fast cold starts, snapshots, pause-billing and egress and credential controls.

agents & orchestration.title: Separating agent harness from sandboxed execution
agents & orchestration.problem: Running the harness inside the sandbox hurts security and reliability, and desktop harnesses do not move cleanly to the cloud.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Brain/hands split managed agents, Devin architecture
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide a cloud-native harness separating loop, tool execution, session and memory.

agents & orchestration.title: Keeping secrets away from agent-run code
agents & orchestration.problem: Credentials leak into model context or sandbox code through injection, and juggling per-project tokens confuses agents.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: 1Password for Agents, sidecar proxies, secret placeholders, auth proxies
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a credential broker that injects secrets at execution time.

agents & orchestration.title: Browser agents need logins and site access
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents hit logins, 2FA and bot detection, and users must paste passwords. Datacenter sessions get blocked.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: 1Password for Agents, cloud browser credential pass-through, persistent cloud profiles, Browserbase
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an authenticated browser session broker with human handoff for 2FA.

agents & orchestration.title: Human approval, escalation and pause/resume
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need to pause for human approval, resume later and escalate ambiguous cases without causing approval fatigue.
agents & orchestration.who: teams running agents with side effects
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Human routing tools, Dial MCP, confidence-based routing, ask_clarification tools
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a risk-tiered approval service with resumable tool calls and multi-channel escalation.

agents & orchestration.title: Policy gates and kill switches for risky agent actions
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents take unsanctioned or destructive actions, and permission checks are weak. There is no reliable gate or remote stop.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Hooks, policy gateways, auto-mode classifiers, Composio Firewall, manual killing
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an action firewall that gates irreversible actions, enforces updatable rules, logs and halts on command.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent identity and scoped delegated permissions
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents inherit users' full permissions, with no standard for identity, delegation or least-privilege access, which exposes them to injection and leaks.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: WorkOS Airlock, Windows agent identities, namespaced profiles, trusted-model restrictions
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer scoped delegated credentials, RBAC and audit trails per agent.

agents & orchestration.title: Agents spam people and act without consent
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents send unsolicited emails, flood maintainers and act on third parties without accountability.
agents & orchestration.who: recipients such as open-source maintainers and journalists, and agent operators
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Ask-a-human tools
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build filters, rate limits and confirmation controls for outbound and inbound agent actions.

agents & orchestration.title: Prompt injection and memory poisoning
agents & orchestration.problem: Injected content, poisoned memory and tool-chaining attacks make ambitious agent access risky.
agents & orchestration.who: teams deploying agents with sensitive access
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Model robustness, isolation, auto mode
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build injection scanning and memory-integrity auditing.

agents & orchestration.title: Inboxes, phones, payments and identity for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents lack ways to receive messages, call, pay or register for services safely.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Twilio, one-time virtual cards, auth.md, here.now
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide agent-ready inbox, phone, card and storage primitives with abuse controls.

agents & orchestration.title: Making products and sites agent-accessible
agents & orchestration.problem: Sites and apps built for humans are hard for agents to discover and use, and wrapping APIs is not enough.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: WebMCP, MCP Apps, markdown.new, agent directories, agent CLIs
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build tooling that exposes app functions as agent endpoints and directories of agent-ready services.

agents & orchestration.title: Voice agent infrastructure
agents & orchestration.problem: Voice agents need low latency, handoffs, interruption handling and tool calls during live calls.
agents & orchestration.who: voice and customer service agent builders
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Twilio, GPT-Realtime, Speechmatics, customer-facing MCP servers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a voice agent harness handling latency, interruptions and integrations.

agents & orchestration.title: Managed agent hosting platforms
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want hosted agents without managing infrastructure, with background execution and credential refresh.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude Managed Agents, DeepAgents deploy, LangGraph deploy, Gemini Managed Agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer deploy-as-function agent hosting with per-agent computers and scheduling.

agents & orchestration.title: Cloud primitives built for agents to operate
agents & orchestration.problem: Existing infrastructure is not designed for agents that run, deploy and debug it with tight feedback loops.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Railway CLI self-deploy, checkpoints
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build agent-oriented hosting with safe rollout primitives.

agents & orchestration.title: Computer-use and GUI agents are unreliable
agents & orchestration.problem: GUI agents click wrong elements, time out, hit CAPTCHAs and are slow or costly, with weak training environments.
agents & orchestration.who: builders of browser and desktop agents
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Grid overlays, event-driven timing, state machine compilation, small models
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a reliable computer-use runtime with recovery, labeled UI and test environments.

agents & orchestration.title: Browser and web-access tooling for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Developers need SDKs and bridges for agents to browse, search and drive apps without separate keys or polling.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Stagehand, Browser Use, Browserbase Search, Cua Driver, Peekaboo, Codex Computer Use
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build web-access layers with search, push updates and session reuse.

agents & orchestration.title: Model routing, failover and provider portability
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want to send each task to the cheapest adequate model and switch providers without rewriting agents when models change or fail.
agents & orchestration.who: agent builders watching cost and uptime
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter, Cline Pareto routing, classifier routers, Factory Router, LangChain
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a provider-agnostic router with normalized interfaces, failover and cost-aware selection.

agents & orchestration.title: Provider policies and lock-in hit agent builders
agents & orchestration.problem: Providers revoke access, restrict third-party use of subscriptions and change policies opaquely.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter, BYO-key harnesses

agents & orchestration.title: Strong planner with cheaper executor subagents
agents & orchestration.problem: Using frontier models for everything is costly, so teams split planning from execution by hand, with poor per-subagent model selection and review overhead.
agents & orchestration.who: developers and teams managing agent costs
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Opus with Sonnet or Haiku subagents, advisor strategy, Codex review, local Qwen workers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build orchestration that assigns model and effort per subtask with cost visibility and escalation.

agents & orchestration.title: Multi-model ensembles and councils
agents & orchestration.problem: No single model is best everywhere, and users manually combine several models to critique each other.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter Fusion, Sakana Fugu, councils of coding CLIs
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer an API that runs several models and synthesizes results with a judge.

agents & orchestration.title: Skill registries, packaging and trust
agents & orchestration.problem: Skills lack a vetted registry, versioning and portability across harnesses, and break across model releases.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Clawhub, skills.sh, Vercel skills, Agent Skills spec, Harness Profiles
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a skill registry with versioning, signing, regression tests and cross-harness sync.

agents & orchestration.title: Writing and tuning high-quality skills
agents & orchestration.problem: Good skills are hard to write, stock skills can hurt, and teams want to encode expertise as skill files.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: skill.md files, Claude skill creator with A/B tests, DSPy skill optimization
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer skill authoring templates, linting and A/B testing.

agents & orchestration.title: Turning agent experience into skills
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents do not learn from past work, so trajectories and tacit expertise rarely become reusable skills.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Hermes auto-skills, EvoSkill, skill distillation, ACE playbooks
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Mine traces into verified skills or deterministic code.

agents & orchestration.title: Self-improving harnesses with safe rollback
agents & orchestration.problem: Automated harness optimization gives unstable gains and can silently break behavior, so changes need evals and rollback.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Autoagent, Darwin Gödel Machine, LangChain hill-climbing, nightly AGENTS.md updates
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build tooling tracing harness changes, gating them with held-out evals and enabling rollback.

agents & orchestration.title: Autonomous research and experiment agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Researchers want multi-agent pipelines and experiment loops, but pruning ideas, verification and scaling remain hard.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Sakana Agentic Scientist, Kosmos, Karpathy loop, autoresearch
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer research-agent templates with benchmarks, experiment tracking and verification.

agents & orchestration.title: Modular open harness infrastructure
agents & orchestration.problem: Memory, orchestration, tool policy and governance are the bottleneck, and teams want swappable, host-portable harness components.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Pi, Vercel Eve, Flue, Vercel AI SDK Harness API, dynamic workflows
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an open modular runtime with swappable loop, tools, sessions and providers.

agents & orchestration.title: Harness design drives agent performance and portability
agents & orchestration.problem: Harness and tools often matter more than the model, but models overfit to their harnesses, and some models lack mature ones.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Minimal custom harnesses, harness profiles, BYO-key harnesses, ACP
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build benchmarks and harness-tuning tools that compare harness fit per model.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent framework churn and build-versus-buy
agents & orchestration.problem: Frameworks change fast, break between releases and are often seen as overengineered, so teams roll their own.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents SDK, Strands, DeepAgents, minimal custom harnesses

agents & orchestration.title: Debate over what a harness is and where the moat lies
agents & orchestration.problem: People disagree on the definition of a harness and whether value lies in models, harnesses or apps.

agents & orchestration.title: Observability and evaluation of agent runs
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams lack readable traces, replay and evals for long agent runs and subagents, so failures are hard to diagnose.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Run logs, Agent Trace standard, tool-call timelines
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build trace summarization, replay and eval tools for harnesses.

agents & orchestration.title: Personal agents are hard to set up and risky
agents & orchestration.problem: OpenClaw-style agents are strongly desired but hard to deploy, costly and insecure, especially for non-technical users.
agents & orchestration.who: individuals and non-technical users wanting a personal agent
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Nebula, Claude Cowork, Hermes Agent, Docker or VM isolation, one-click deploys
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a one-click hardened personal agent with safe defaults and guided connections.

agents & orchestration.title: Customizable always-on personal and coworker agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Users want persistent, customizable agents with memory and accounts, but they either do little or act intrusively.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Hermes Agent, OpenAI dots, Grok Bot, per-agent cloud machines
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an open assistant with persistent memory, scheduling and controllable proactivity.

agents & orchestration.title: Controlling agents from chat apps and phones
agents & orchestration.problem: Users want to reach and steer agents beyond the terminal via Telegram, Discord or phone control.
agents & orchestration.who: agent users away from their desk
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Telegram bots, Claude Code channels, ADB over Tailscale
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a mobile or chat control channel for agent harnesses.

agents & orchestration.title: Assembling business context for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need context scattered across Slack, docs, email and internal tools, which users supply manually.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: MCP connectors to GitHub, Jira, Slack, Notion, WorkIQ
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a cross-app context retrieval layer.

agents & orchestration.title: Specs and delegation briefs before agent runs
agents & orchestration.problem: Underspecified goals waste agent hours, and users need help writing specs, success criteria and plans and breaking work into reviewable tasks.
agents & orchestration.who: people delegating long or large tasks
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Plan mode, plan.md, spec.md milestones, interview prompts, ticket loops
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a spec authoring tool that elicits context, defines done states and decomposes work.

agents & orchestration.title: Verifying agent work with independent reviewers
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents claim work is done when it is not, fabricate results and agree sycophantically, so independent verification is needed.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Reviewer agents, cross-model review, adversarial checkers, deterministic checks
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Package a reusable critic and verification pipeline checking work against the spec.

agents & orchestration.title: Agents fail at running real businesses
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents show poor judgment running real operations, and many agentic products are marketed as autonomous chatbots.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Vending machine experiments

agents & orchestration.title: How much autonomy agents should have
agents & orchestration.problem: Opinions differ on full autonomy versus human-in-the-loop.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Human-defined task graphs

agents & orchestration.title: Orchestrators for robots and drone fleets
agents & orchestration.problem: Robotics and drone systems pair LLM planners with low-level executors but coordination and edge cases remain hard.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: LLM plus VLA pairing

agents & orchestration.title: Agents playing games need state bridges
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents driving games need frame-to-action interfaces and compressed state.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: RTS tool plugins, MCP bridges, OCR
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a generic game-to-agent bridge that compresses state and actions.

agents & orchestration.title: Agents handling consumer errands and disputes
agents & orchestration.problem: People want agents to complete customer-service chores like appeals and bookings.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Codex writing an appeal, Gemini booking services
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an errand agent handling multi-step customer-service workflows with oversight.

agents & orchestration.title: Enterprise and vertical agent platforms
agents & orchestration.problem: Enterprise back-office and domain agents are built bespoke, with shared context, release process and governance missing.
agents & orchestration.who: enterprises and domain teams in legal, finance and operations
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Slack intake bots, ChatGPT Workspace Agents, bespoke builds
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer standardized vertical agent templates with evals, versioned releases, identity and audit.

agents & orchestration.title: Manus credit loss and reliability complaints
agents & orchestration.problem: Users lost credits and files to sandbox resets and got poor support.

agents & orchestration.title: Prompts tuned for older models hold new models back
agents & orchestration.problem: Instructions written for older models underperform on newer ones.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Rewriting prompts, adding skills
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a prompt and skill migration tester for new models.

agents & orchestration.title: DSPy tooling gaps
agents & orchestration.problem: DSPy users lack typed outputs, trajectory injection for ReAct, provider support, deployment tooling and prompt transfer across models.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: dspy-cli, custom adapters, GEPA
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build DSPy integrations, optimizers and deployment tooling.

business & markets.title: Opaque, shrinking AI subscription usage caps and quotas
business & markets.problem: Paying users cannot tell how credits, weekly caps and session windows are consumed, and limits change quietly. Plan labels like 5x or 20x do not map to real usage, so work cannot be planned.
business & markets.who: heavy users of Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and coding-agent subscriptions
business & markets.current_solutions: Trial and error, multiple accounts, outdated support articles, switching providers or to Codex, buying extra credits, falling back to local models, community estimates of API-equivalent value
business & markets.opportunity: Build a cross-provider usage tracker that shows remaining quota, burn rate and API-equivalent dollar value, warns before cutoffs and recommends the cheapest adequate plan.

business & markets.title: Missing mid-priced AI subscription tiers and costly fast modes
business & markets.problem: Subscription ladders jump from $20 to $100-$200, and premium or fast modes burn usage several times faster. Solo users hit caps but cannot justify the top tiers.
business & markets.who: solo power users, hobbyists and indie developers
business & markets.current_solutions: Splitting spend across providers, switching to Codex, cheaper plans such as Kimi's
business & markets.opportunity: Offer a reseller or pooled-access bundle that provides a mid-priced plan across several model providers.

business & markets.title: Billing, refund, credit expiry and support failures at AI vendors
business & markets.problem: AI vendors have overcharges, cancellations that still bill, expiring prepaid credits, denied refunds, failed payments and slow or bot-only support. Users get locked out or lose money they paid.
business & markets.who: paying users and teams of AI subscriptions and API credits
business & markets.current_solutions: Chasing refunds by email, support tickets, multiple accounts, third-party subscriptions that risk suspension
business & markets.opportunity: Build a subscription and credit management tool that tracks renewals, expiry, cancellations and refunds and helps with disputes, possibly with outcome-verified auto-refunds or rollover wallets.

business & markets.title: Frontier models cost too much; need routing and price comparison
business & markets.problem: Buyers pay a premium for top models that few tasks need, and per-token comparisons mislead because token usage and bundles vary. Teams lack an easy way to pick the cheapest adequate model per task and track cost.
business & markets.who: developers and teams using multiple model APIs and coding agents
business & markets.current_solutions: Cheaper models (Sonnet, Flash, DeepSeek), open-weight models, OpenRouter, manual switching, ad-hoc benchmarking
business & markets.opportunity: Build a router and benchmark dashboard that measures cost per completed task, sends each prompt to the best-value model and tracks per-model spend.

business & markets.title: Unpredictable AI vendor price, plan and model-access changes
business & markets.problem: Vendors raise, cut and restructure prices and plans, remove model access and deprecate models with little notice, often through quiet page edits. Builders cannot plan around them.
business & markets.who: app builders and users depending on AI vendor plans and models
business & markets.current_solutions: Switching providers, open models, OpenRouter, manual monitoring
business & markets.opportunity: Build a monitor that tracks vendor pricing pages, terms, model availability and sunset dates and alerts users to changes with cost-impact forecasts and migration help.

business & markets.title: Subsidized AI pricing makes economics fragile and prices uncertain
business & markets.problem: Flat-rate plans and AI startups lean on subsidized inference and VC cash, so users and builders fear price hikes and burn spikes when subsidies end. Whether prices will rise or fall is contested.
business & markets.who: AI startups, builders and heavy subscription users
business & markets.current_solutions: Passing price increases to customers, fundraising, cheaper or open models, diversifying providers
business & markets.opportunity: Build cost-scenario modeling and multi-provider abstraction tooling that stress-tests burn against API price changes.

business & markets.title: Coding agent and enterprise token spend gets expensive and untracked
business & markets.problem: Developers and companies burn tokens quickly with surprise bills and variable billing, and cannot link spend to output. Integrations can burn thousands of credits in seconds with no guardrails.
business & markets.who: developers running coding agents and engineering orgs managing token budgets
business & markets.current_solutions: Flat plans, spending caps, cheaper models, Ramp's spend tracking, expensing subscriptions
business & markets.opportunity: Build a spend monitor with caps, per-task credit limits, model routing and spend-to-outcome analytics for teams.

business & markets.title: Usage and outcome pricing is hard for AI products and SaaS
business & markets.problem: Per-seat pricing predates agents, token price does not reflect task value, and flat plans break under agent workloads. Teams need metering, credits or outcome pricing while customers fear unpredictable bills, and legacy CPQ cannot quote them.
business & markets.who: AI product and SaaS vendors and their finance and sales teams
business & markets.current_solutions: Devin's ACUs, Sierra per-resolved-ticket pricing, Databricks/Snowflake credits, consumption meters alongside subscriptions, patched CPQ
business & markets.opportunity: Build metering, billing, forecasting and quoting tools for credit, usage and outcome-based pricing, including agent API access.

business & markets.title: AI app resellers and apps lose margin to inference costs
business & markets.problem: Apps passing through model tokens earn near-zero gross margin, and bring-your-own-key makes markups visible. Unclear whether app or model layers capture margin.
business & markets.current_solutions: Platform-fee models, owning the model and chip stack
business & markets.opportunity: Offer margin analytics and billing tooling supporting platform fees and outcome pricing over pass-through inference.

business & markets.title: AI revenue and company financials are opaque and unverifiable
business & markets.problem: Run-rate figures, prepayments, undisclosed hyperscaler numbers and inconsistent metrics make real AI demand and unit economics hard to verify. There is no standard metric like gross profit per token.
business & markets.current_solutions: Trailing revenue checks, Ramp AI Index, manual deal-network charts, leaks, gross profit per token
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tracker that aggregates and normalizes verifiable AI revenue, costs, commitments and deal networks into comparable metrics.

business & markets.title: AI financing, debt, concentration and circular deals look fragile
business & markets.problem: Labs and hyperscalers rely on debt, off-balance-sheet vehicles, circular deals and a few concentrated customers, making systemic risk hard to read.
business & markets.current_solutions: Investigative reporting, tip lines, leverage analyses
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tracker mapping AI financing, debt, covenants, circular deals and counterparty exposure.

business & markets.title: GPU compute markets, depreciation and residual value are unclear
business & markets.problem: GPU compute is illiquid and non-standard, depreciation and capex payback are uncertain, and buyers cannot hedge price or availability.
business & markets.who: GPU owners, renters, startups and compute financiers
business & markets.current_solutions: Secured debt for hardware, SF Compute standardized futures, cash-settled derivatives
business & markets.opportunity: Build a compute marketplace with standardized contracts, price indexes, forwards and GPU asset valuation tools.

business & markets.title: AI bubble and sustainability debate
business & markets.problem: Commentators disagree on whether AI spending and valuations are a bubble and what a correction would look like.
business & markets.current_solutions: Holding cash, gold or treasuries

business & markets.title: Businesses cannot measure ROI and productivity from AI
business & markets.problem: Companies spend heavily on AI but cannot show measurable returns, and productivity gains are contested and may be untracked in official statistics.
business & markets.who: companies adopting AI, executives and economists
business & markets.current_solutions: Case studies, surveys, micro studies, JPMorgan TFP estimates
business & markets.opportunity: Build an AI ROI measurement tool tying AI usage to business outcomes and productivity.

business & markets.title: AI wrapper and vertical startups lack a durable moat against labs
business & markets.problem: Base models absorb features, clones are easy, and frontier labs move into apps and verticals, threatening wrappers and vertical builders.
business & markets.current_solutions: 7 Powers framework, proprietary data, workflows, domain models, integration-heavy products
business & markets.opportunity: Build domain-specific vertical models or workflow products using proprietary data, or tools that assess moat strength.

business & markets.title: LLM commoditization squeezes frontier lab margins
business & markets.problem: Top models perform similarly with thin margins, little moat and price wars, while labs outspend ecosystems.
business & markets.current_solutions: Enterprise contracts, full-stack platforms, moving up the stack

business & markets.title: Open-weight model businesses struggle to monetize
business & markets.problem: Open-weight developers bear training costs and give products away, while users want managed access rather than self-hosting.
business & markets.current_solutions: Licensing for fine-tuning and deployment, third-party hosts, coding plans, revenue-share licenses
business & markets.opportunity: Sell fine-tuning, customization and managed hosting on open-weight base models.

business & markets.title: Open-source licensing is mislabeled, restrictive and risky
business & markets.problem: Vendors call open-weight models open source while using custom licenses that stay unclear on commercial use.
business & markets.who: developers and companies adopting open models
business & markets.current_solutions: Arcee moved to Apache 2.0, AGPL-style restrictions
business & markets.opportunity: Build a license-checking tool that classifies model and library licenses and flags commercial restrictions.

business & markets.title: Chinese open models, cheap pricing, bans and export controls
business & markets.problem: Cheap Chinese open models pressure Western pricing and prompt security debates, bans and export-control fights.
business & markets.current_solutions: Kimi and DeepSeek as cheap open alternatives

business & markets.title: Distillation of frontier models and gated access
business & markets.problem: Labs dispute whether distillation is theft and ration access to top models through partner-only programs.
business & markets.current_solutions: Partner-only programs, ToS prohibitions

business & markets.title: Prediction market insider trading, analytics and liquidity
business & markets.problem: Prediction markets are vulnerable to insiders and manipulation, lack baselines for detection, and offer few useful long-term questions.
business & markets.current_solutions: Unusual Whales' Polymarket scanner, on-chain analytics
business & markets.opportunity: Build monitoring and analytics tools that flag suspicious trades and measure market bias, plus markets for long-term conditional questions.

business & markets.title: Funders struggle to find and evaluate grants and nonprofits
business & markets.problem: Grant information is scattered and adversarial, so funders cannot find vetted opportunities or gauge funding gaps, and valuable work goes unfunded.
business & markets.current_solutions: Lightcone Commons S-Process, donor-advised funds, regranters like Manifund
business & markets.opportunity: Build a donor-facing platform aggregating vetted grants, room for funding and shared evaluation.

business & markets.title: Clinical trials are slow, costly and a drug-discovery bottleneck
business & markets.problem: Trials are rebuilt from scratch with recruitment hurdles, slow approvals and high costs, limiting AI-accelerated discovery.
business & markets.opportunity: Build reusable trial infrastructure, recruitment and approval-cost tooling.

business & markets.title: AI outbound sales and prospecting needs personalization with QA
business & markets.problem: Teams use agents to personalize outbound at scale, but messages sound generic and need ICP encoding and QA.
business & markets.current_solutions: Clay, LLM emails, Lightfield CRM, Concierge.ai, AI-native CRMs
business & markets.opportunity: Build a sales agent with ICP encoding, buying-signal timing, QA rubrics and CRM integration.

business & markets.title: Getting recommended by AI answers and shopping agents
business & markets.problem: Buyers research with AI and agents that favor different sources and pick products inconsistently, so marketers cannot track or influence recommendations.
business & markets.current_solutions: Use-case pages and docs, structured data, mentions on other sites, Parallel Web Systems Index
business & markets.opportunity: Build tooling that tracks brand mentions and citations across AI models and agents and tests how agents rank products.

business & markets.title: Distribution and traction are the bottleneck for AI-built products
business & markets.problem: Building is easy but getting discovered and paid is hard; markets are flooded with low-effort software and builders dislike marketing.
business & markets.current_solutions: Show HN, cold calling, niche audiences, LinkedIn, open-source cores with premium layers
business & markets.opportunity: Build go-to-market and audience-acquisition tools and curated showcases for technical founders.

business & markets.title: Solo developers build without validating market need
business & markets.problem: Solo developers cannot size their market and LLMs tell them what they want to hear.
business & markets.opportunity: Build a market validation tool giving honest evidence-based feedback before building.

business & markets.title: Payment rails and wallets for AI agents
business & markets.problem: Agents need to pay safely in micro-amounts, but card rails expose details and assume humans, and liability is unclear.
business & markets.current_solutions: agentcard.sh, Coinbase Agentic Wallets, Stripe MPP, x402, one-time credentials
business & markets.opportunity: Build agent wallets and micropayment tooling with spend limits, scoped credentials and dispute handling.

business & markets.title: Private, anonymous payment for LLM access
business & markets.problem: Users want to pay for LLM services without linking identity.
business & markets.opportunity: Build an anonymous pay-per-use gateway for LLM APIs.

business & markets.title: Fair compensation for creators and writers
business & markets.problem: Creators lack consumption-based payment, collective ways to negotiate pay for AI use of their work, and reliable income.
business & markets.current_solutions: Cloudflare AI crawler pricing, data unions proposed, paid tiers and partial paywalls
business & markets.opportunity: Build pay-as-you-go splitting, collective licensing and paywall tools that show value before charging.

business & markets.title: Ads as a business model for AI chatbots
business & markets.problem: Free chatbots need funding but ad targeting is unproven, advertisers lack performance data, and users worry ads influence answers.
business & markets.who: AI chat providers, advertisers and users
business & markets.current_solutions: Koah native ads, Sourcegraph free tier ads, hybrid subscription plus ads, ad-free positioning
business & markets.opportunity: Build ad networks and attribution analytics for conversational AI.

business & markets.title: Consumer generative AI struggles to convert to paid
business & markets.problem: Few weekly users pay for chatbots and consumer unit economics are hard to sustain.

business & markets.title: Cheap fraud detection and trust signals
business & markets.problem: Fraud handling creates friction and costly KYC, and credit scoring is gameable by agents.
business & markets.current_solutions: Consistency probing and pattern matching
business & markets.opportunity: Build a lightweight fraud and trust-scoring service.

business & markets.title: Data center local impact, backlash and transparency
business & markets.problem: Communities oppose data centers over power, water, noise and tax incentives, with NDAs hiding terms and little local benefit.
business & markets.current_solutions: Community organizing, moratoria
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tool tracking data center deals, incentives and resource impacts by locality, or passing compute revenue to communities.

business & markets.title: Simulating customer behavior to test changes
business & markets.problem: Small merchants cannot reach A/B significance and miss second-order effects of launches.
business & markets.current_solutions: SimGym simulations
business & markets.opportunity: Build customer-journey simulation tools.

business & markets.title: AI tools for trading and investor research
business & markets.problem: Traders and investors want portfolio-aware analysis, startup screening and credible LLM research, but LLMs fail at multi-step research and market data is expensive.
business & markets.current_solutions: Claude Code backtesters, Alpaca experiments, Finnhub data, agentic trading
business & markets.opportunity: Build portfolio-aware analysis tools and a trading benchmark with random controls.

business & markets.title: AI accounting and finance assistants
business & markets.problem: Businesses and individuals do not understand their profit drivers and find month-end close and money tracking tedious.
business & markets.current_solutions: Silvia dashboard, Ramp Stack, personal AI CFO
business & markets.opportunity: Build AI accounting assistants with source-linked explanations.

business & markets.title: Private-market liquidity and secondary trading
business & markets.problem: LPs and employees lack liquidity and secondary infrastructure covers only top names.
business & markets.who: private company employees, LPs and investors
business & markets.current_solutions: Tender offers, Forge Global, Industry Ventures, continuation vehicles
business & markets.opportunity: Build tender-offer and secondary trading tools for broader private companies.

business & markets.title: Replacing SaaS with AI-built custom software
business & markets.problem: Vendors raise prices while coding agents make custom replacements cheap, raising build-versus-buy and maintenance questions.
business & markets.current_solutions: Three-week AI rebuilds, in-house systems, buy to learn build to keep
business & markets.opportunity: Build a service that scopes, builds and maintains custom replacements of SaaS tools.

business & markets.title: SaaS decline and AI commoditization
business & markets.problem: SaaS multiples compress as simple products are replaced and customers want composable slices of functionality.
business & markets.current_solutions: Stripe and WorkOS building blocks, API-first design, vertical specialization, bundling
business & markets.opportunity: Build modular API-first products serving small functionality slices for agents and lean teams.

business & markets.title: Distributing software through private equity portfolios
business & markets.problem: AI startups need a channel bypassing traditional enterprise sales.
business & markets.opportunity: Build a channel program distributing AI software into PE portfolio companies.

business & markets.title: Robotics pilots fail to become deployments
business & markets.problem: Robotics demos rarely become validated multi-site deployments.

business & markets.title: Excess capital and culture problems at AI labs
business & markets.problem: Well-funded labs ship poorly and giant seed rounds fund pre-revenue labs.

business & markets.title: Perplexity referral payouts canceled and accounts banned
business & markets.problem: Affiliate users saw payouts held or canceled and accounts banned with no appeal.

business & markets.title: SaaS sales efficiency and funnel metrics
business & markets.problem: Software firms spend heavily on sales with misleading stage conversion, nonlinear journeys and complex commission cash flow.
business & markets.current_solutions: End-to-end conversion rate, gross profit quotas
business & markets.opportunity: Build revenue analytics modeling journeys, quotas and commission cash flow.

business & markets.title: Tracking AI and tech political spending
business & markets.problem: Industry super PAC spending is invisible to voters and no AI tracker exists comparable to the crypto one.
business & markets.current_solutions: Follow the Crypto tracker
business & markets.opportunity: Build an election spending tracker for AI and tech.

business & markets.title: Personalized algorithmic pricing is hard to detect
business & markets.problem: Surveillance pricing raises individual prices invisibly.
business & markets.current_solutions: Negotiating directly
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tool that detects and compares personalized prices.

business & markets.title: Free tier cuts and paywalled AI features
business & markets.problem: Free quotas are cut with little notice, leaving no cheap tier for students and indie developers.
business & markets.current_solutions: Cheaper alternative services

business & markets.title: Fake engagement and undisclosed paid promotion
business & markets.problem: Companies pay influencers without disclosure and orchestrate fake accounts.
business & markets.opportunity: Build detection and disclosure tooling for undisclosed promotion and inauthentic accounts.

business & markets.title: Insurance for AI agent deployment risk
business & markets.problem: Liability insurance does not cover catastrophic AI risks and risk is not priced.
business & markets.opportunity: Build an agent insurance product with lower premiums for safer deployments.

business & markets.title: Anti-AI stigma and human-made certification
business & markets.problem: Audiences punish visible AI use, and certifying human-made work is hard.
business & markets.current_solutions: Steam AI disclosure labels
business & markets.opportunity: Build a provenance service certifying human-made content.

business & markets.title: AI hardware price increases
business & markets.problem: RAM shortages and upgrade pricing raise costs for consumers and local LLM users.

business & markets.title: Pressure to ship AI features without requirements
business & markets.problem: Stakeholders demand AI features without defined functionality, causing half-baked releases.

business & markets.title: Faster cross-border and ACH settlement
business & markets.problem: Businesses want faster, cheaper settlement than traditional rails.
business & markets.current_solutions: Stablecoin payments
business & markets.opportunity: Build stablecoin-based B2B payment tools.

business & markets.title: Scaling AI services via forward-deployed engineering and rollups
business & markets.problem: Consultancies struggle to build AI delivery capacity while labs use partners and acquisitions.
business & markets.current_solutions: Acquiring consultancies, partner ecosystems, AI rollups
business & markets.opportunity: Offer AI-native delivery services or partner enablement.

business & markets.title: Model gateway and reseller trust issues
business & markets.problem: Gateways raise ToS, neutrality and credit questions, and teams want human support.
business & markets.current_solutions: OpenRouter, token resellers
business & markets.opportunity: Build a neutral multi-model gateway with human support.

business & markets.title: Acquisition of AI tools creates user uncertainty
business & markets.problem: After Meta acquired Manus, users feared policy changes and data exploitation.
business & markets.current_solutions: Team reassurances

business & markets.title: AI agents running businesses autonomously
business & markets.problem: Agents can profit but lack infrastructure for sales and operations.
business & markets.current_solutions: Project Vend
business & markets.opportunity: Build operational infrastructure for agent-run businesses.

business & markets.title: Human data-labeling alternative to Scale AI
business & markets.problem: AI systems need human labeling beyond existing providers.
business & markets.current_solutions: Scale AI
business & markets.opportunity: Launch a human data-labeling and judgment service.

business & markets.title: Open API for German real estate listings
business & markets.problem: ImmoScout24 charges for listing data, limiting housing research.
business & markets.current_solutions: Paid ImmoScout24 access
business & markets.opportunity: Build an open real estate data API.

business & markets.title: AI small business operations assistants
business & markets.problem: Small businesses face paperwork and scattered tools and want AI connecting Shopify, Stripe and accounting.
business & markets.current_solutions: Meta's Muse connectors
business & markets.opportunity: Build AI assistants handling setup, forms and daily operations.

coding agents.title: Human review of agent code is the bottleneck
coding agents.problem: Agents produce diffs and PRs faster than humans can read them, so review caps what ships and bugs slip through. Plain line diffs make it hard to see behavior changes or the agent's reasoning.
coding agents.who: developers and teams reviewing agent-written PRs
coding agents.current_solutions: Shorter PR descriptions, AI first-pass reviewers, Devin Review, Claude Code review, small chunked iterations, reviewing specs instead of code.
coding agents.opportunity: Build review tooling that summarizes agent changes, ranks risk, shows intent and behavior changes, and triages what needs human eyes.

coding agents.title: Automated and cross-model AI code review
coding agents.problem: Teams want an independent AI reviewer that catches what the authoring model missed, but built-in review is costly, noisy and shallow.
coding agents.who: teams using coding agents and CI
coding agents.current_solutions: Custom headless reviewers in CI, Codex reviewing Claude (and vice versa), Greptile, Cursor BugBot, review subagents, custom slash commands.
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a configurable, vendor-agnostic review service that runs a second model on each change, posts inline comments and escalates only risky PRs.

coding agents.title: Open-source maintainers flooded by AI-generated PRs
coding agents.problem: Low-effort agent PRs are cheap to submit but expensive to review, and maintainers lack trust signals to filter them.
coding agents.current_solutions: Blanket bans, vouching systems, GitHub Actions with agentic workflows, auto-triage agents.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a contributor-reputation and AI-PR triage service that screens PRs against project rules.

coding agents.title: Agents can't show proof their UI work functions
coding agents.problem: Agents cannot see or operate the UI they build, so frontend failures go unnoticed and reviewers lack evidence the change works.
coding agents.who: developers using agents for frontend and app work, and their reviewers
coding agents.current_solutions: Demo videos and screenshots (Cursor, Showboat, Rodney), Playwright, Chrome MCP, computer use, uiautomator dumps.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a drop-in toolkit giving agents screenshots, UI state and recordings, attached to PRs as reviewable evidence.

coding agents.title: Agents falsely claim completion and cheat on tests
coding agents.problem: Agents report tasks done or verified when they are not, weaken or delete tests, and take shortcuts, forcing users to recheck everything.
coding agents.who: developers relying on agents for autonomous work
coding agents.current_solutions: Manual rechecking, stop hooks, TDD prompts, cross-model review, verification subagents, conformance suites, Playwright MCP.
coding agents.opportunity: Build an independent verification layer that checks agent claims against repo state and real tests, and flags test tampering or faked success.

coding agents.title: Agents lack runtime data for debugging
coding agents.problem: Agents debug without logs, errors, traces or usage signals, resorting to print-and-restart loops.
coding agents.current_solutions: Cursor Debug Mode, logging helpers, Sentry-style integrations, live CloudWatch access.
coding agents.opportunity: Build connectors that stream logs, traces and error data to agents for root-cause analysis and fixes.

coding agents.title: Test-driven porting and migration with agents
coding agents.problem: Agents can port or migrate large codebases when a strong test suite exists, but one-shot attempts fail and few know the staged pattern.
coding agents.who: teams migrating legacy code or porting libraries
coding agents.current_solutions: Test-suite-driven ports, transpiler-first rewrites, PORTING.md with parallel agents, Devin refactoring.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a migration service that derives conformance suites and drives staged agent ports with comparison harnesses.

coding agents.title: Reverse engineering and rebuilding software with agents
coding agents.problem: Decompiling binaries, legacy hardware and rebuilding software from screenshots or specs is tedious and agents miss details.
coding agents.who: reverse engineers and retro or legacy hardware developers
coding agents.current_solutions: Codex for firmware patching, Claude Code with local decompilers, Ghidra MCP.
coding agents.opportunity: Build workflows that pair decompilers with LLM interpretation, verification and spec extraction.

coding agents.title: Recording agent sessions, provenance and transcripts
coding agents.problem: It is hard to tell what an agent did and why, and to share, export or analyze sessions or attribute accountability.
coding agents.who: developers and teams using coding agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Transcript export scripts, claude-code-transcripts, git change logs, /insights, notes per commit.
coding agents.opportunity: Build tooling that stores transcripts, prompts and touched files linked to commits and offers analytics and sharing.

coding agents.title: Context rot and compaction break long sessions
coding agents.problem: Long sessions fill the context window, degrade quality, and lose instructions or decisions after compaction.
coding agents.current_solutions: /compact, /clear, handoff files, plan.md notes, fresh sessions, checkpoints.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a context manager that checkpoints goals and decisions, prunes safely, and resumes sessions without drift.

coding agents.title: Coding agents lack persistent cross-session memory
coding agents.problem: Agents forget preferences, decisions and mistakes between sessions, so users hand-maintain notes and memory files.
coding agents.who: developers using agents across many sessions
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude-Mem, MEMORY.md files, Cline memory bank, git-tracked context repos, Letta Code.
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a provider-independent memory layer that stores, prunes and re-injects project knowledge.

coding agents.title: Agent instruction files drift, get ignored and don't sync
coding agents.problem: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md rules go stale, bloat, get ignored, and differ across tools and models.
coding agents.current_solutions: Short corrective files, hooks, pre-commit linters, symlinks between files, manual pruning.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a linter, syncer and enforcer for instruction files that detects stale rules, tests their effect and enforces them.

coding agents.title: AI-generated code piles up bloat and technical debt
coding agents.problem: Agent code is duplicated, inconsistent, over-engineered and poorly architected, and complexity sprawls faster than humans notice.
coding agents.current_solutions: Manual refactoring, cleanup passes, lint-fix agent loops, human-designed architecture, linters and type checkers.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a continuous auditor and cleanup agent that finds dead code, duplication, and architecture drift and refactors it.

coding agents.title: Verbose, noisy and over-engineered agent output
coding agents.problem: Models add unrequested changes, verbose comments, extra docs and rambling responses when a small fix is needed.
coding agents.current_solutions: Constraint prompts, Caveman terse-output, concise styles, minimization plugins, cleanup passes.
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a post-generation linter and output-style layer that trims comments, docs and scope to house style.

coding agents.title: Agents misread intent, overreach and skip clarifying questions
coding agents.problem: Agents make confident wrong assumptions, change more than asked and need constant steering.
coding agents.current_solutions: Explicit prompts, ask-before-assuming rules, interview prompts, AGENTS.md bans.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a pre-task clarification and scope guard that surfaces assumptions and constrains edits to the requested region.

coding agents.title: Developers lose understanding of agent-written code
coding agents.problem: Delegating to agents erodes the developer's mental model and ownership, making debugging and maintenance brittle.
coding agents.who: developers and teams relying on agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Asking agents to explain code, Showboat walkthroughs, small reviewed chunks, quizzes, manual architecture.
coding agents.opportunity: Build tools that generate living walkthroughs, architecture maps and quizzes of agent changes.

coding agents.title: Agent-heavy work breaks flow and causes burnout
coding agents.problem: Waiting on agents, context switching and constant review cause fatigue and reduce craft and enjoyment.
coding agents.current_solutions: Parallel sessions, bell notifications, blocking time, manual coding.
coding agents.opportunity: Design workflow and notification layers that batch agent output and summarize where agents left off.

coding agents.title: Splitting work between agents and hand-written code
coding agents.problem: Developers prefer offloading boilerplate while hand-writing core logic to keep understanding and flow.
coding agents.current_solutions: Inline autocomplete, agents for boilerplate and tests, hand-written backend.

coding agents.title: Dashboards for managing many parallel agents
coding agents.problem: Running many agents across repos and worktrees needs status visibility, isolation, conflict handling and orchestration.
coding agents.current_solutions: Git worktrees, tmux, Conductor, Cline Kanban, Claude Code agent teams, Antigravity Agent Manager.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a cross-vendor agent-fleet manager with status, isolated workspaces, task queues and conflict resolution.

coding agents.title: Shared multiplayer workspaces for agent teams
coding agents.problem: Agent sessions are siloed in one person's terminal and miss team context and shared memory.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Tag, Slack-native agents, Replit live collaboration.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a shared agent workspace with team memory, self-hosting and PR output.

coding agents.title: Long-running agent loops stall and need supervision
coding agents.problem: Multi-hour autonomous runs stall, loop or burn budget, and need goals, durable state and resume.
coding agents.current_solutions: Ralph loops, Codex /goal, restart loops, elapsed-time budgets.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a runner with checkpointing, loop detection, budget caps, auto-resume and progress reports.

coding agents.title: Cloud and event-driven background agent infrastructure
coding agents.problem: Cloud agents need persistent, reliable environments and triggers from bugs and CI failures.
coding agents.current_solutions: Cursor cloud agents, Devin Auto-Triage, Codex cloud environments, OpenInspect.
coding agents.opportunity: Offer hosted self-healing agent environments with secrets handling and event triggers returning PRs.

coding agents.title: Sandboxing coding agents on local machines
coding agents.problem: Agents with broad access can wreck the host, leak credentials or execute untrusted code, and existing sandboxes are heavy or leaky.
coding agents.current_solutions: Docker, bubblewrap, Agent Safehouse, microVMs, separate Linux users, Cowork VM.
coding agents.opportunity: Build an easy cross-platform sandbox with snapshots, rollback and network egress control.

coding agents.title: Agents delete files and take unauthorized actions
coding agents.problem: Agents delete data, run destructive git commands and ignore stop instructions, causing data loss and outages.
coding agents.who: developers and users giving agents file or shell access
coding agents.current_solutions: Backups, confirmation safeguards, classifiers, no-push credentials.
coding agents.opportunity: Build guardrails with command interception, snapshots, undo and audit logs.

coding agents.title: Permission prompt fatigue and unclear approval controls
coding agents.problem: Approving every action is tedious, but skipping permissions is risky and auto modes are opaque.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Code auto mode, Codex guardian, allow/deny lists, YOLO flags.
coding agents.opportunity: Build a policy tool that pre-approves safe patterns, explains blocks and escalates risky actions.

coding agents.title: Prompt injection, secrets leakage and supply-chain risk for agents
coding agents.problem: Untrusted content, packages and harnesses can hijack agents or exfiltrate code, keys and data through allowed channels.
coding agents.current_solutions: Hooks, scoped tokens, domain allowlists, classifiers, credential proxies.
coding agents.opportunity: Build scanners, egress monitors and credential brokers that vet inputs and installs.

coding agents.title: Security flaws in AI-generated code

coding agents.opportunity: Build token-efficient code search, code-graph and tool-loading middleware plus token profilers.

consumer apps.problem: Vehicle maintenance, conference and hotel needs are poorly served.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Vehicle Smart
consumer apps.opportunity: Build focused utility apps.

consumer apps.title: Predatory mobile game monetization
consumer apps.problem: Games and betting apps push ads and dark patterns.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an ad-free game storefront.

consumer apps.title: Harassment filtering and captcha friction
consumer apps.problem: Abusive replies slip past moderation, and captchas make chat tools unusable.
consumer apps.who: social users and chat tool users
consumer apps.current_solutions: Claude for Chrome auto-block
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an AI moderation filter for replies and live chat.

consumer apps.title: Text-to-design tools for makers
consumer apps.problem: Makers want AI-generated fabrication designs.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Partforge.ai, Sawdust.diy
consumer apps.opportunity: Build text-to-design tools with cut lists and CNC export.

consumer apps.title: Civic transparency assistants
consumer apps.problem: Voter questions need verifiable sourced answers.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build civic Q&A tools with cited methodology.

creative & media.title: Image edits drift and can't be targeted precisely
creative & media.problem: Repeated AI image edits add artifacts, shift colors and lose instruction-following, and small targeted edits alter the rest of the image. Users restart chats or fix things by hand.
creative & media.who: designers, creators and developers editing AI-generated images
creative & media.current_solutions: Restarting in a fresh chat with the existing image, switching to Nano Banana Pro, Qwen-Image-Layered layer decomposition, visual annotation plugins for Claude Code
creative & media.opportunity: Build a non-destructive, masked, layer-aware image editor that versions edits and re-applies only changed regions.

creative & media.title: AI images garble text, labels and infographics
creative & media.problem: Image models misspell text, mangle labels and local scripts, and struggle with data-accurate infographics. Search grounding and extra prompting help only inconsistently.
creative & media.who: designers, marketers and creators making posters, slides and infographics
creative & media.current_solutions: Nano Banana Pro/2 with Google Search grounding, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image-2.0, iterative prompting
creative & media.opportunity: Build a generator that pulls verified data, renders text deterministically, overlays multilingual text and spell-checks before output.

creative & media.title: Diagrams, charts and infographics need editable, accurate output
creative & media.problem: LLM and image-model diagrams have broken arrows, bad labels, hallucinated or uneditable raster output, and chart layout failures. Users clean up by hand.
creative & media.who: people making technical diagrams, charts and figures with LLMs
creative & media.current_solutions: Excalidraw text-to-diagram, Claude self-critique loops with screenshots, manual cleanup
creative & media.opportunity: Have the LLM emit structured graph data rendered by a layout engine into editable vectors with automatic visual QA.

creative & media.title: Long AI video drifts and needs orchestration beyond short clips
creative & media.problem: Video clips cap around 10-15 seconds, and chained long-form video drifts, forgets objects and changes characters. Multi-shot continuity needs orchestration and failed shots keep failing.
creative & media.who: filmmakers and creators making long-form AI narrative video
creative & media.current_solutions: ComfyUI context-loop nodes, Stable Video Infinity, Kling 3.0 multishot, storyboards into Seedance, FFmpeg-based agents
creative & media.opportunity: Build a storyboard-to-film agent with persistent scene state that plans shots, stitches clips and flags shots for human review.

creative & media.title: Character and face identity drifts across AI images and video
creative & media.problem: Models fail to keep faces, scars and outfits consistent across generations and shots, forcing LoRAs, detailed prompts and manual cleanup.
creative & media.who: creators and filmmakers producing multi-shot image and video work
creative & media.current_solutions: Character LoRAs, reference uploads, LTX-2.5 and Kling 3.0 multishot, first-frame pre-alignment, Viggle Remake, first/last-frame conditioning
creative & media.opportunity: Build a character-bible and identity-locking tool that manages references and LoRAs and checks face consistency across shots.

creative & media.title: Fine control over camera, motion and layout in AI video
creative & media.problem: Video models take prompts too literally and can't make small precise revisions. Users want direct control over camera, motion and layout.
creative & media.current_solutions: Runway Motion Sketch, camera-trajectory controls, 3D blocking, multi-angle LoRAs, JSON prompts with bounding boxes
creative & media.opportunity: Build a control layer combining 3D blocking, camera paths and structured prompts to drive any video model.

creative & media.title: AI video ad production is trial and error
creative & media.problem: Ad studios generate hundreds of clips and hand-tune prompts. Audiences spot glitches and disclosure lowers click-through.
creative & media.current_solutions: Hybrid live-action plus AI effects; AI for storyboards while humans write, direct and edit
creative & media.opportunity: Build ad tooling that auto-ranks and QA-checks generated variants for glitches and supports targeted revisions.

creative & media.title: On-brand ad and asset generation
creative & media.problem: Small businesses and marketing teams want on-brand headers, ads, social campaigns and videos made cheaply from brand guidelines, websites or performance data. Brand assets need to be callable by agents.
creative & media.who: small businesses, marketing teams and agent builders
creative & media.current_solutions: Bloom (Claude skill with Nano Banana), Pomelli, Canva Business, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Gemini avatar generators
creative & media.opportunity: Offer an API/MCP that ingests brand assets and returns on-brand images, ads and video variants, iterating from performance data.

creative & media.title: Agent-driven and AI-native video editing
creative & media.problem: Video editing lacks a Cursor-like AI-native tool. LLM auto-edits are uncanny and hallucinate, so people drive ffmpeg and Premiere through coding agents.
creative & media.current_solutions: Codex Premiere plugin, Claude with ffmpeg and Remotion, Kino, Wideframe, Edit Studio, Claude recording/editing plugin, Gemini Omni
creative & media.opportunity: Build an agent-drivable video editor with MCP interface, transcript-based cuts, subtitles and automatic rough cuts with human review.

creative & media.title: Code-driven explainer, demo and motion graphics videos
creative & media.problem: Coding agents can produce animated explainers, demos and motion graphics from code cheaply, but the workflow is ad hoc and lacks fine-grained editability.
creative & media.who: product teams, developers and educators making demo videos
creative & media.current_solutions: Claude Code with Remotion, headless Chrome and ffmpeg, Teasr, agent-directed terminal recording, demo-video agent skills
creative & media.opportunity: Package script, asset, TTS and animation steps into a one-click generator with timeline-level editing.

creative & media.title: Turning text and ideas into shareable explainer media
creative & media.problem: People want essays, podcasts, transcripts and reading history turned into interactive, narrated or video explainers without manual production.
creative & media.current_solutions: Opus-generated interactive companions, ElevenLabs narration, code-rendered explainer videos
