creative & media.opportunity: Build a one-click converter from text or audio to interactive sites or short narrated videos.

creative & media.title: Hosted generation quotas, paywalls and multi-model platforms
creative & media.problem: Image and video generators impose tight quotas, region locks, confusing credits and shutdowns, and creators juggle many subscriptions with differing content policies and watermarks.
creative & media.who: creators using hosted image, video and voice generators
creative & media.current_solutions: Aggregator hubs (ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Google Vids), local models like Flux 2 Klein, paid pro plans, flat-rate bundles
creative & media.opportunity: Build a quota-aware multi-model hub that routes tasks to the best provider or local model, shows policies and cost, and exports projects.

creative & media.title: Open and local creative model pipelines lag and are hard to run
creative & media.problem: Open video, image and audio models trail closed ones and need distillation, custom nodes and fragmented ComfyUI workflows to run on consumer GPUs.
creative & media.who: hobbyists and creators running local generation
creative & media.current_solutions: LTX-2/2.5, Wan, Flux 2 Klein, ComfyUI sparse-attention and consolidated nodes, Qwen-Image toolchains
creative & media.opportunity: Ship packaged local pipelines and workflow managers that wrap ComfyUI workflows into easy-to-run apps or MCP backends with sane defaults.

creative & media.title: Restoring and upscaling video and photos faithfully
creative & media.problem: Upscalers are slow, AI video looks oily, and restoration hallucinates faces or distorts identity.
creative & media.who: archivists, video editors and photo restorers
creative & media.current_solutions: SeedVR2 with TensorRT, Topaz AI, SUPIR, ChaiNNer, Handbrake, Flux Klein super-resolution
creative & media.opportunity: Build a local restoration studio that preserves identity, flags hallucinated facial changes and outputs HDR-friendly footage.

creative & media.title: Overly strict content filters block creative work
creative & media.problem: Safety guardrails reject benign creative text and image requests, and moderation differs between tools. Users resort to jailbreaks or uncensored local models.
creative & media.who: writers, artists and image generator users
creative & media.current_solutions: Rephrasing prompts, flipping images to pass vision filters, uncensored LLM enhancers, abliterated and local finetunes
creative & media.opportunity: Build self-hosted creative suites with user-configurable moderation for legal edgy content.

creative & media.title: Mandatory watermarks on AI media
creative & media.problem: Watermarks like SynthID and visible marks block monetization and leak origin. Users find bypasses.
creative & media.who: creators using AI image and video tools
creative & media.current_solutions: No-op prompts, open-source models

creative & media.title: Expressive, controllable voice AI direction
creative & media.problem: TTS sounds artificial and lacks believable emotion, and fine control over emotion, pacing, accents and pronunciation relies on elaborate, unpredictable prompt formats.
creative & media.who: creators, voice producers and game developers
creative & media.current_solutions: ElevenLabs, Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS director's notes and audio tags, Fish Audio Drama 3, Hume Voice Conversion, open models with emotion tags
creative & media.opportunity: Build a visual voice-direction studio with presets, emotion curves and pronunciation control exporting to multiple TTS engines.

creative & media.title: Multilingual and accent TTS quality gaps
creative & media.problem: Open TTS models handle non-English languages poorly, rendering them as English or needing finetuning.
creative & media.current_solutions: ElevenLabs, Fish Audio S2, Cartesia Sonic, Gemini Flash TTS
creative & media.opportunity: Build language-specific finetuned TTS or a benchmark and router that picks the best voice model per language.

creative & media.title: Cheap local voice cloning TTS alternatives
creative & media.problem: ElevenLabs and cloud voice cloning are costly per line, and local options need big GPUs or degrade on long audio.
creative & media.who: game developers, audiobook makers and app builders
creative & media.current_solutions: Chatterbox, Qwen3-TTS, Kokoro with OpenVoice, VibeVoice, llama.cpp llama-tts, OS built-in voices
creative & media.opportunity: Package a lightweight local TTS and voice-cloning runtime into a simple app for audiobooks, reading and game NPCs.

creative & media.title: AI dubbing faithful to source subtitles
creative & media.problem: Creators want AI dubbing and localization that stays faithful to their existing subtitles.
creative & media.current_solutions: YouTube AI dubbing, ElevenLabs Ads Engine, Vimeo live dubbing
creative & media.opportunity: Build a dubbing tool that treats creator-approved subtitles as ground truth and preserves voice and timing.

creative & media.title: Audio separation, enhancement and transcription
creative & media.problem: Users need stem splitting, sound isolation, super-resolution and audio-to-MIDI, and long-form transcription remains slow or buggy.
creative & media.current_solutions: SAM Audio, FlashSR, MuScriptor, Whisper
creative & media.opportunity: Bundle open audio models into an easy workstation plug-in for separation, cleanup and transcription.

creative & media.title: Reference-based sound design and SFX generation
creative & media.problem: Text-only SFX tools can't take a reference sound, so creators rely on libraries, foley or workarounds like synthesis code and spectrogram editing.
creative & media.current_solutions: Sound libraries, foley artists, ElevenLabs SFX, Stable Audio 3, AudioX, AudioLDM, SAM Audio, LLM synthesis code
creative & media.opportunity: Build a tool that takes a reference sound plus text instruction and generates or refines a new effect.

creative & media.title: Audio in generated video is poor and misaligned
creative & media.problem: Native audio from video models is muffled, garbled or disconnected from on-screen action, lip-sync is hard, and emotion tags are spoken literally.
creative & media.current_solutions: Separate audio upscale or replacement passes, LTX Studio with ElevenLabs lip-sync, Kling 3.0 native audio, custom ComfyUI workflows
creative & media.opportunity: Build a post-production tool that aligns, replaces and enhances audio in generated video with guided prompting.

creative & media.title: AI music is bland and open or hobbyist tools are limited
creative & media.problem: Generative music is short, less coherent, averages genres and lacks human imperfection, and open models are weak at instructions and covers. Satisfying pieces still need human input.
creative & media.current_solutions: Suno 4.5, SongGeneration Studio, HeartMuLa, Lyria 3, DAW radio chains
creative & media.opportunity: Build a song studio that stitches long coherent tracks with section-level control, keeping human performance as the input.

creative & media.title: AI music flooding platforms and cloning artists
creative & media.problem: Streaming services receive huge volumes of AI songs, artists worry about voice cloning, and copyright protections are bypassed.

creative & media.title: Hum-to-song custom music for personal projects
creative & media.problem: Non-musicians want full songs from hummed melodies, lyrics or poems and tailored background music.
creative & media.current_solutions: Suno, Lyria 3 Pro
creative & media.opportunity: Build a personal-music app turning hums, poems and notes into finished tracks with editable stems.

creative & media.title: AI help for music production and DJing
creative & media.problem: Musicians and DJs want AI help with presets, track matching and audio analysis instead of manual trial and error.
creative & media.current_solutions: LLM-generated amp-sim presets, Gemini audio analysis, ONNX BPM scanning
creative & media.opportunity: Build a DAW companion that suggests tracks, generates presets and analyzes mixes.

creative & media.title: Artists lose income, consent and credit to AI
creative & media.problem: Artists and writers say generative models use unlicensed work, cut income and flood markets with AI output that makes it hard to stand out.
creative & media.current_solutions: Collective campaigns, open letters, paid promotion, hand-made positioning

creative & media.title: Verifying authenticity of media and human-made work
creative & media.problem: Realistic AI video, voice clones and fake process evidence are hard to distinguish from real, detectors are unreliable, and real creators get falsely accused.
creative & media.current_solutions: SynthID watermarks, unreliable detectors like ZeroGPT, manual physics cues
creative & media.opportunity: Build provenance and human-made certification with process logs and a cross-vendor verifier for watermarks.

creative & media.title: Norms for disclosing AI-assisted writing
creative & media.problem: Writers face backlash for any AI assistance and byline friction; clear disclosure and contract guidelines are wanted.

creative & media.title: AI prose sounds generic and needs style control
creative & media.problem: LLM writing has recognizable tells and homogenized style, and writers want ways to avoid or detect them while keeping their own voice.
creative & media.current_solutions: Havelock.AI, Tropes anti-slop instructions, Every's style guide skill, custom writing skills, quirky punctuation
creative & media.opportunity: Build an anti-slop editor that learns an author's voice and flags or rewrites generic AI patterns.

creative & media.title: AI fiction stays flat and struggles with long-form craft
creative & media.problem: LLM fiction is ornate and uniform, and models fail at author imitation, pacing, distinct character voices, foreshadowing and canon consistency.
creative & media.current_solutions: Prompt scaffolding, Kimi Writer, keeping older models like GPT-4o
creative & media.opportunity: Build a story-bible and voice-modeling assistant that tracks canon and character voice while keeping the author in control.

creative & media.title: Which model writes best for creative use
creative & media.problem: Users compare models for creative writing quality and report regressions and strict free-plan limits.
creative & media.current_solutions: Kimi K2, Sonnet 5, Mistral Small Creative, Fable 5
creative & media.opportunity: Offer a writer-focused model comparison or router that picks the best model per task.

creative & media.title: Interactive and personalized AI fiction
creative & media.problem: People want books that rewrite on reader input, custom romance and playable old text adventures.
creative & media.current_solutions: Codex-built GUI for open-source text adventure
creative & media.opportunity: Build an interactive book engine that adapts stories to reader interruptions and customization.

creative & media.title: Autonomous content creation and curating AI volume
creative & media.problem: Agents write and sell ebooks and plots, and creators need ways to scale output without slop.
creative & media.current_solutions: ChatGPT wrappers selling plot outlines
creative & media.opportunity: Build curation and filtering tools that score AI content at volume.

creative & media.title: AI game assets lack consistency and game-ready quality
creative & media.problem: Image generators can't reliably deliver transparent backgrounds, true pixel art, seamless tiles or consistent sprites, so assets need heavy manual cleanup.
creative & media.current_solutions: gpt-image-2 chroma-key sprite sheets, agents calling image APIs, Claude Code with Gemini and Seedance, AI art as placeholders
creative & media.opportunity: Build an asset pipeline producing style-locked sprites, tiles and animation sheets with background removal, pixel snapping and spatial QA.

creative & media.title: AI-built games often aren't fun
creative & media.problem: Generated games and simulated worlds feel generic and lose appeal; game-design taste is the bottleneck.
creative & media.opportunity: Build design-feedback and playtest-simulation tools that help creators find fun mechanics.

creative & media.title: Text-to-game prototyping with coding agents
creative & media.problem: Coding agents can rapidly build browser games and simulators from loose prompts, but visual games are weaker and no dedicated tools exist beyond general agents.
creative & media.current_solutions: Claude Code, Opus, Fable 5, Astra, Three.js, procedural WebAudio and WebGL
creative & media.opportunity: Build a text-to-game studio that generates, playtests and refines browser games with assets and sound.

creative & media.title: Game modding, porting and preservation with AI
creative & media.problem: Old games are hard to run or modify on new hardware, and agents can write mods, ports and sound edits end to end.
creative & media.current_solutions: Agent-built Minecraft mods, Factorio patches, SuperAstra, WebAssembly ports
creative & media.opportunity: Build an agent toolkit that ports and mods legacy games into browsers or new platforms.

creative & media.title: Adaptive games with talking NPCs and live restyling
creative & media.problem: Players want NPCs they can talk to with cloned voices and games that restyle visually in real time.
creative & media.opportunity: Build a drop-in real-time voice-dialogue and style-render layer for arbitrary games.

creative & media.title: Gamers reject games built with AI
creative & media.problem: Gaming communities react angrily to AI-generated art, voice, music and code, making studios wary of using AI openly.

creative & media.title: Navigable world models and explorable 3D scenes
creative & media.problem: Users want persistent, editable, interactive environments from text, images or video, but determinism, consistency, multiplayer sync and rendering tooling are immature.
creative & media.current_solutions: Marble by World Labs, Genie 3 and 4, World Labs API, Overworld, Gaussian splat pipelines
creative & media.opportunity: Build tools for editing, rendering and exporting generated worlds into standard engines.

creative & media.title: Image-to-3D results are poor and hard to reproduce
creative & media.problem: Image-to-3D tools produce distorted geometry versus demos, with background and hardware issues, and AI-built games need optimized assets.
creative & media.current_solutions: Meshy, Trellis 2, COLMAP, orbit video snapshots
creative & media.opportunity: Build a reliable image-to-mesh pipeline with segmentation, cleanup, optimization and licensing checks.

creative & media.title: Agents driving Blender and 3D tools
creative & media.problem: Artists and developers want AI-driven 3D workflows for scene generation, materials and geometry, but 3D tools are hard to learn and AI scenes have spatial errors, restrictive licenses and uneven meshes.
creative & media.current_solutions: Blender MCP connectors, Claude Code with Blender MCP, Spline agent mode, TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, render-screenshot feedback loops
creative & media.opportunity: Build a polished Blender agent that verifies spatial correctness, supports constraint-based modeling and exports clean meshes.

creative & media.title: Editable text and image to 3D model generation
creative & media.problem: Creators want editable 3D models and technical illustrations from text or video that can be taken apart or shared as code.
creative & media.current_solutions: Anatomy, Teardown, Qwen3.5-4B Three.js generator, three.js scene reproduction from video
creative & media.opportunity: Build a service that outputs editable, versioned 3D models with sharing and exportable parts.

creative & media.title: Agent-native design canvases and design-to-code
creative & media.problem: Designers and developers want AI design canvases where agents draft within the design system and connect to code agents.
creative & media.current_solutions: Claude Design, Figma AI, Paper, Magic Patterns, Penpot, Google Stitch, Magic Path
creative & media.opportunity: Build a design canvas with agent drafting, design-system awareness and tight code-agent links with human steering.

creative & media.title: AI-generated designs look generic
creative & media.problem: AI-designed apps, slides and names converge on the same default look and need human taste.
creative & media.who: designers and developers using design agents
creative & media.current_solutions: Hallmark design skill, Refero Styles DESIGN.md files, templates, design inspiration via MCP
creative & media.opportunity: Build style libraries and taste-steering tools that push agents toward distinctive aesthetics.

creative & media.title: SVG, vector and procedural art by LLMs breaks
creative & media.problem: LLM-made SVG and animated vector art often breaks or moves parts independently, and models need feedback loops.
creative & media.who: developers and artists making generative art
creative & media.current_solutions: Quiver AI, Gemini 3.1 Pro, twigl shader art, simulated paint engines
creative & media.opportunity: Build a vector and animation generator with a structural-integrity feedback loop.

creative & media.title: Image and video API instability and poor documentation
creative & media.problem: Hosted generation endpoints error, hang or lack documented options like resolution and 4K, waste credits, large uploads fail and models change or get pulled.
creative & media.who: developers integrating image and video generation
creative & media.current_solutions: Wrapper scripts around OpenAI's image API, the llm CLI key store, Z.AI accepting mp4 URLs
creative & media.opportunity: Offer a reliability gateway that normalizes parameters, retries, protects credits and monitors quality across providers.

creative & media.title: Scripted image generation for coding agents
creative & media.problem: Developers want CLI and library access to image generation with reference images, and Claude users lack built-in image generation.
creative & media.current_solutions: gemimg, openai_image.py CLI, Codex image skill, code-drawn images
creative & media.opportunity: Build an image-generation connector for coding agents with reference images and self-reflection.

creative & media.title: AI slide and presentation decks fall short on design
creative & media.problem: Users want polished decks from notes and research, but generated decks are clunky, cluttered or weak in design.
creative & media.current_solutions: Nano Banana Pro slides, Kimi slides, open-slide, Claude Design exports, per-slide image generation
creative & media.opportunity: Build an agent-native slide tool with whitespace-aware layout and design review that exports to PPTX.

creative & media.title: Segmentation, matting and background removal
creative & media.problem: Pipelines need promptable segmentation, alpha generation and clean rotoscoping, and Remove.bg's shutdown leaves a gap.
creative & media.current_solutions: SAM 3 via Roboflow, SCAIL 2 with cleanup
creative & media.opportunity: Build an open background-removal and video matting service with transparent output.

creative & media.title: Bespoke single-use creative tools built with Claude Code
creative & media.problem: Creators and domain experts build small custom apps that previously weren't worth building.
creative & media.current_solutions: Claude Code, Codex, Paperwall
creative & media.opportunity: Offer templates and a hosting layer for niche creative tools.

creative & media.title: Turning photos and video into structured data
creative & media.problem: Cheap multimodal models can caption photo libraries and extract tables from video, but tooling is nascent.
creative & media.current_solutions: Gemini video understanding, cheap multimodal captioning, Qwen3-VL descriptions
creative & media.opportunity: Build a media-library indexer that captions, structures and makes archives searchable.

creative & media.title: AI film still unconvincing
creative & media.problem: Filmmakers limit AI to hidden or cleanup tasks, no compelling finished AI film exists, and actor-likeness consent adds complexity.
creative & media.current_solutions: Runway motion capture with SAG-AFTRA approval, AI pitch decks

creative & media.title: Continuous A/B testing of video titles and thumbnails
creative & media.problem: Titles and thumbnails strongly affect YouTube engagement, but creators lack automated continuous testing.
creative & media.opportunity: Build a tool that continuously A/B tests titles and thumbnails to optimize hooks.

creative & media.title: Debates over AI creativity, authorship and art
creative & media.problem: People argue whether AI output has meaning, taste and accountability, and whether it displaces or democratizes creativity.

creative & media.title: Generative video is slow and costly to iterate on
creative & media.problem: Video generations take minutes to tens of minutes and are compute-heavy, losing instant feedback loops.
creative & media.current_solutions: Draft modes, real-time local world models, lower-resolution previews
creative & media.opportunity: Build fast low-res preview layers that render final quality only once approved.

creative & media.title: Consumer backlash against AI-made advertising
creative & media.problem: Audiences are put off by obviously AI ads, disclosure reduces engagement, and brands disagree on advertising AI use.
creative & media.current_solutions: Comedy-genre ads, positioning as human-made

creative & media.title: Prompting image and video models is hard to master
creative & media.problem: Many people write poor prompts for image and video models, results are unpredictable, and style techniques are hard to find.
creative & media.current_solutions: Prompt rewriters, VLM image-to-prompt, structured templates, shared prompt communities
creative & media.opportunity: Build a prompt assistant that expands ideas into model-specific structured prompts and learns from shared examples.

creative & media.title: Choosing between image generators is hard
creative & media.problem: Users struggle to compare image models on prompt adherence, consistency and polish with no reliable side-by-side view.
creative & media.current_solutions: Informal comparisons of Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 1.5, LMArena
creative & media.opportunity: Build a side-by-side image model comparison tool using the user's own prompts.

data & pipelines.title: Cheap, accurate PDF and document parsing for agents
data & pipelines.problem: Getting reliable text, tables, layout, reading order and charts out of PDFs and Office files is hard. Frontier and VLM parsing is slow, costly and error-prone.
data & pipelines.who: developers building agents and RAG pipelines over documents
data & pipelines.current_solutions: LiteParse, LlamaParse, Nutrient, Deep Extract, Mistral OCR, PDF.js/Tesseract.js, Gemini extraction with cross-checks, routing simple pages to cheap parsers and complex ones to VLMs
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a cost-aware parsing API that routes pages by complexity and returns grounded layout, coordinates, confidence and cross-checked numbers.

data & pipelines.title: Local OCR for handwriting, medical scans and hard cases
data & pipelines.problem: Accurate OCR for messy handwriting, handwritten math and medical scans needs expensive frontier or GPU-heavy models, and Tesseract is too weak.
data & pipelines.who: users digitizing handwritten, medical or textbook documents
data & pipelines.current_solutions: DeepSeek OCR on Modal, PaddleOCR v5 with custom handwriting model, Qwen3 VL, small open OCR models, fine-tuning
data & pipelines.opportunity: Package a local or serverless OCR tool tuned for handwriting and medical documents with simple deployment and a free tier.

data & pipelines.title: Reliable structured extraction from messy text and invoices
data & pipelines.problem: People need clean structured data from unstructured text, invoices and receipts, but LLM extraction hallucinates and per-page costs are high.
data & pipelines.who: businesses and developers extracting structured data from documents and text
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Structify, open JSON-schema extraction models, Gemini Flash loops, ai-sdk-tools/ocr, OpenRouter JSON scripts, BizDocs
data & pipelines.opportunity: Offer a low-cost extraction service with schema validation, cross-checks, a review UI and accounting exports.

data & pipelines.title: Agents need safe, scoped access to databases
data & pipelines.problem: Agents issue many queries and may overload production or touch data or schemas they shouldn't. Teams need isolation, scoped credentials, readable schemas and reviewed changes.
data & pipelines.who: teams letting agents query or modify operational databases
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Copy-on-write database branching, Supabase scoped tokens, Datasette --default-deny, snapshots and forks, declarative schemas in Git, reviewed migration scripts
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build an agent database layer with isolated branches, scoped credentials, declarative schema views and approve-and-apply migrations.

data & pipelines.title: Brittle change data capture pipelines
data & pipelines.problem: CDC pipelines from OLTP to analytics break on schema changes and wake data engineers.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Kafka streaming, dbt, Fivetran
data & pipelines.opportunity: Create a CDC and sync tool that tolerates schema changes without manual intervention.

data & pipelines.title: Semantic layer and trusted context for data agents
data & pipelines.problem: Agents lack governed context on metric definitions, permissions and which records to trust. Catalogs built for humans handle unstructured data poorly.
data & pipelines.who: enterprise data teams deploying data agents
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Semantic models with definitions and permissions, ontology-based layers, OpenAI internal data agent, CData Connect AI MCP, manual checking of answers
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a metadata and semantic service giving agents governed context across structured and unstructured data.

data & pipelines.title: Natural-language data analysis over SQL databases
data & pipelines.problem: Non-experts want to ask questions of databases in plain language. Agents do this well with schema, metadata and examples but need safe access.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: LLM SQL generation, Datasette MCP plugin and Datasette Agent, GA4/BigQuery MCP, Stripe MCP, Claude Code with Postgres/MotherDuck MCP, Livedocs
data & pipelines.opportunity: Offer a hosted read-only conversational query layer over databases and spreadsheets with metadata and example queries.

data & pipelines.title: Publishing and exploring datasets with SQLite and Datasette
data & pipelines.problem: People need lightweight ways to publish, share and browse datasets and APIs, including in-browser, without servers or heavy infrastructure.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Datasette, Datasette Lite, WebAssembly SQLite, HTTP range requests, datasette publish fly, db-to-sqlite, importdata() into Google Sheets
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build hosted and browser-only tools that turn any dataset into a browsable, shareable SQLite-backed site and API.

data & pipelines.title: SQLite transactions, migrations and queue tooling pitfalls
data & pipelines.problem: SQLite libraries have confusing transaction semantics that can silently lose data, and lack reversible migrations, notifications and durable queues.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: sqlite-utils 4.0 migrations and db.atomic(), honker queue, separate DBs for cache and queue, copying DB before migrating, cysqlite
data & pipelines.opportunity: Provide safer SQLite wrappers, migration tools and queue extensions with clear transactions and rollback.

data & pipelines.title: Government and civic financial data is inconsistent
data & pipelines.problem: Public spending data comes in inconsistent formats or audited PDFs, making normalization and analysis hard.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Gemini extraction of audited PDFs, scraping council spend rows, LLM-built tooling
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a normalized API and explorer for government spending across jurisdictions.

data & pipelines.title: Scarcity of authentic real-world AI training data
data & pipelines.problem: Models are bottlenecked on authentic, niche or expert data and the data market is opaque.
data & pipelines.who: AI labs and specialized model builders
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Protege AI, expert data vendors, buying defunct startups' archives, Wikimedia Enterprise
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a marketplace for licensed, provenance-tracked real-world datasets.

data & pipelines.title: Web content licensing and reciprocity for AI training
data & pipelines.problem: There is debate over whether AI firms should pay for or give back to sites they scrape, and how to access data without straining them.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Wikimedia Enterprise APIs, Poison Fountain, robots.txt-respecting crawl endpoints

data & pipelines.title: Book scanning for AI training destroys rare books
data & pipelines.problem: Anonymous bulk book orders are suspected of feeding destructive scanning for AI data, with no visibility into buyers.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: AirTag tracking of a bulk order

data & pipelines.title: Robotics training data, simulation and compression
data & pipelines.problem: Robotics teams lack demonstration data, face messy multimodal pipelines, and need costly hand-built simulation assets and huge sensor data handling.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Cross-embodiment pooling, synthetic world-model data, LLM-generated 3D sim environments, egocentric video datasets, hand-engineered sim assets
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build tools to ingest, segment, simulate and compress multimodal robotics data and generate synthetic environments.

data & pipelines.title: Video model training storage and IO costs
data & pipelines.problem: Video and world-model training involves massive storage, egress and IO-bound loading costs at petabyte scale.
data & pipelines.who: teams training video and multimodal models
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Streaming data into training, caching, caption pipelines
data & pipelines.opportunity: Provide data loading, caching and cloud-agnostic storage tooling that cuts egress and IO overhead.

data & pipelines.title: Annotation and labeling cost and quality
data & pipelines.problem: Manual labeling is slow, outsourced labels are distrusted, and vendor RL data is buggy.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: AI-verifier auto-labeling, in-house expert segments, notebooks with AI, CELLxGENE Annotate
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build labeling tools with automated verification and domain-expert workflows.

data & pipelines.title: Biology and materials science lack scalable, negative-result data
data & pipelines.problem: Literature reports mainly positive results and lab instruments capture low-context data, so AI datasets are skewed, noisy and slow to collect.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: LLM extraction from literature, DFT calibration with experimental data, CRISPR perturbation experiments, CELLxGENE Annotate, SAM2 segmentation, faster measurement workflows
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build lab data capture and annotation platforms that record standardized experiments, including failures, with context and lineage.

data & pipelines.title: Data leakage and bias in finance and AI analyses
data & pipelines.problem: Public data leaks into backtests and AI-generated analyses suffer sampling bias or imprecise numbers, making results look better than they are.
data & pipelines.who: quant researchers and analysts using AI
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build leakage-detection and sampling-audit tooling for time-series and AI-driven analyses.

data & pipelines.title: Market, blockchain and social data feeds are costly and noisy
data & pipelines.problem: Live price and onchain data is expensive or unreliable, and raw social and market data is too noisy for traders to judge.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: CoinGecko APIs, X pay-per-use API, Allium blockchain data, Postgres MCP over Polymarket data
data & pipelines.opportunity: Offer affordable data APIs with filtering and source-reliability scoring that distill signals.

data & pipelines.title: Web scraping and structured web data APIs for agents
data & pipelines.problem: Agents and teams need fresh structured web data from sites without APIs, but sites block scrapers and browser automation is slow.
data & pipelines.who: developers and agents collecting web data
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Cloudflare crawl, Defuddle, Context.dev, yt-dlp, FireCrawl, Parse, Rust crawler with DuckDB, Exa People Search, undocumented API probing
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a polite extraction service that turns websites into fast, stable structured APIs.

data & pipelines.title: Dataset versioning, provenance and archiving
data & pipelines.problem: Datasets, websites and repos lack Git-like versioning and disappear, and archival infrastructure lacks independent stewardship.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Software Heritage, GitHub recovery of Factbook, JSON snapshots in Git, Internet Archive mirrors on GitHub Pages
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build dataset versioning and archival tooling with provenance and verifiable backups.

data & pipelines.title: Sanitizing and sharing agent traces as datasets
data & pipelines.problem: Open datasets of agent and coding sessions are scarce and sharing traces safely is hard.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Hugging Face trace publishing, shared agent data protocol, pi-share-hf, SynthTraces
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a tool that sanitizes, publishes and crowdsources agent traces.

data & pipelines.title: Training data pollution, poisoning and provenance
data & pipelines.problem: Model-generated text, poisoned or misaligned content and errors enter training data and propagate, and provenance is hard to verify.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Provenance-aware retrieval and verification
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build detection and provenance tooling that flags polluted, poisoned or false content in corpora.

data & pipelines.title: Cleaned open corpora and dataset curation tooling
data & pipelines.problem: Researchers need clean, licensed, structured datasets and tools for filtering, dedup, mixing and fast tokenization, and teams hand-roll heuristics.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Zyda-2, Nemotron-CC, The Stack v3, GPIC, Gigatoken, SemDeDup, Poolside's Blender, heuristic pruners, translated FineWeb2
data & pipelines.opportunity: Publish cleaned datasets and a curation toolkit for filtering, dedup and mixing with configurable ratios.

data & pipelines.title: Data cleaning and analysis workflows lack AI tooling
data & pipelines.problem: Data teams spend most time cleaning data and notebook agents feel clunky, though LLMs help with ad hoc cleanup.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Code Interpreter, Hermes 4, LLM preprocessing scripts, agent legacy data recovery
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build an AI-native data IDE with cleanup workflows.

data & pipelines.title: Privacy-preserving researcher access to platform data
data & pipelines.problem: Researchers need vetted access to platform data to detect bot swarms without exposing user data.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a vetted-access, privacy-preserving data access system.

data & pipelines.title: Hard-to-collect domain data in legal, payer and e-commerce
data & pipelines.problem: Specialized domains have messy unstructured data, jargon-heavy transcription and evolving ontologies.
data & pipelines.who: teams in legal, healthcare payer and e-commerce
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Keyword-based correction passes, intermediate representation for payer policies
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build domain-specific collection and normalization tools.

data & pipelines.title: Memory-efficient loading of large datasets
data & pipelines.problem: Large datasets overflow laptop memory or platform limits, and downloads get stuck.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: GraphZero mmap, mounting remote datasets, SkyPilot, pyarrow loading
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build streaming and mmap loaders for large datasets.

data & pipelines.title: Agent filesystem layer over scattered user data
data & pipelines.problem: Agents need to read scattered user data and past sessions without context overload.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Filesystem abstractions, SQLite chat stores
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a filesystem layer exposing user data to agents.

data & pipelines.title: Speech transcription lacks diarization and jargon handling
data & pipelines.problem: Transcription lacks speaker attribution, turn detection, long-audio support and accurate jargon, forcing developers to stitch APIs together.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Mistral Voxtral Transcribe with context biasing, Universal-3 Pro, LLM keyword pass then re-transcribe, ffmpeg shrinking, manual splitting
data & pipelines.opportunity: Offer a unified transcription pipeline with diarization, jargon biasing, long-audio chunking and PII redaction.

data & pipelines.title: PII redaction and anonymization before LLM use
data & pipelines.problem: Teams must remove or randomize PII in production, medical and transcript data before sending it to LLMs or releasing it.
data & pipelines.who: teams handling sensitive data with LLMs
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Microsoft Presidio, local Opus-based redaction pipeline, medical de-identification, pi-share-hf PII defenses
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a prompt-configurable local PII redaction tool that re-inserts names after processing.

data & pipelines.title: Reproducing production query plans in development
data & pipelines.problem: Dev query plans differ from production because planner statistics differ, with no easy local simulation.
data & pipelines.who: backend developers and DBAs using PostgreSQL
data & pipelines.current_solutions: PostgreSQL 18 pg_restore_relation_stats and pg_restore_attribute_stats
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build tooling that exports and imports production planner statistics to reproduce plans locally.

data & pipelines.title: Large tabular formats and lakehouse unification
data & pipelines.problem: Very large datasets need efficient columnar and line-based formats, and split transactional and analytic systems force ETL.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Parquet, DuckDB, JSONL over tar, Databricks LTAP, Tensor.from_blob with PyArrow
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build tools that unify transactional and analytic storage on open formats and ease loading into ML frameworks.

data & pipelines.title: Synthetic data generators for training and evals
data & pipelines.problem: Teams need controllable synthetic data with critique and structured variation, but quality degrades with iteration.
data & pipelines.who: teams building training and eval datasets
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Synthia, Madlab, Nemotron-4 pipeline, SynthTraces, dimension-tuple eval generation, local Llama-3-70B
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a multi-stage synthetic data generator with critique, repair, revalidation and local deployment.

data & pipelines.title: Dataset observability and pipeline introspection
data & pipelines.problem: Teams lack tools to inspect multimodal and agentic training data, trace lineage and spot data bugs.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a dataset observability tool for browsing, lineage tracing and debugging.

data & pipelines.title: Dataset licensing, link rot and openness gaps
data & pipelines.problem: Dataset licenses restrict training and sharing, dead links hurt reproducibility, and legal risk keeps pretraining data closed.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build tooling to audit licenses, mirror links and check opt-out status.

data & pipelines.title: Rapid scientific analysis pipelines and data portals
data & pipelines.problem: Changing experimental protocols require rework of analysis code, and labs want custom portals and dashboards.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: LLM coding tools to adapt pipelines
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build tools generating tailored analysis pipelines and interactive data portals.

data & pipelines.title: RL environments and training data vendors
data & pipelines.problem: Hard, non-reward-hackable RL problems are scarce, vendor quality is poor, and clean mock data diverges from messy production data.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: In-house environment building, Chinese labs building own data
data & pipelines.opportunity: Offer a service generating hard, realistic RL environments with messy production-like data.

data & pipelines.title: Herculaneum scroll unrolling needs heavy human correction
data & pipelines.problem: Virtual unrolling requires costly human segmentation correction and scarce CT scans.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build automated segmentation and ink detection needing little manual correction.

data & pipelines.title: Data infrastructure consolidation and cost pressure
data & pipelines.problem: Data infrastructure is consolidating into full-stack platforms, silos persist and storage costs rise.

data & pipelines.title: Continuously updating datasets and shared query libraries
data & pipelines.problem: Shared datasets go stale and team queries lack authorship, history and comments.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a live-updating dataset tool and shared query library with history and comments.

data & pipelines.title: Converting content archives into agent-ready markdown
data & pipelines.problem: Newsletter archives, transcripts and distributed data must be converted into agent-usable formats.
data & pipelines.who: creators and teams feeding content to agents
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Manual markdown conversion
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build a service converting archives and transcripts into agent-ready markdown.

data & pipelines.title: Heterogeneous data integration across systems and formats
data & pipelines.problem: Data scattered across documents, drawings, databases and vendors needs bespoke integrations.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build integration tooling that cross-references data across formats and vendors.

data & pipelines.title: Bookkeeping transaction categorization needs manual rules
data & pipelines.problem: Tools like QuickBooks categorize only through hand-made rules, so each new transaction type needs a human.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: QuickBooks rules
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build an LLM categorizer that learns categories without manual rules.

data & pipelines.title: Sparse large data storage and compression
data & pipelines.problem: LLMs and standard compressors handle sparse, large social data poorly, and GPU compression took days.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: GPU compressor on Wikipedia
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build content-aware lossless compression and reconstruction for social data dumps.

data & pipelines.title: Security risks in data processing pipelines
data & pipelines.problem: Dataset loaders can execute code, table functions allow SQL injection, and booby-trapped files can reach workers and credentials.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Build scanners and sandboxes for dataset loaders and agent data ingestion.

devtools & IDEs.title: Human review can't keep up with AI-generated PRs
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents produce more and larger changes than humans can review, so PRs sit for days or get rubber-stamped. Reviewers lack the prompts, decisions and rationale behind the diffs.
devtools & IDEs.who: engineering teams and reviewers working with AI-generated code
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Meta trajectories, GitAI inline context, Linear Diffs, explain-diff skills, pr.video walkthroughs, detailed PR descriptions, small single-intent PRs, vimdiff beside the agent, Kilo and CodeRabbit change stacks, custom PR reviewers.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a review tool that groups, explains and risk-scores large agent diffs, surfaces decisions and traces, flags unrelated changes, and routes low-risk changes to auto-approval.

devtools & IDEs.title: Cognitive debt and low-quality AI-generated code
devtools & IDEs.problem: AI produces more code than humans can comprehend or verify, and the output is often generic, bloated or subtly buggy. Maintainability and design stewardship are unresolved.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Manual line-by-line review, prompt-file workflows, hooks forbidding bad comments, Semgrep rules, ADRs, implementation notes.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tools that explain code, track design intent and shared understanding, and refactor AI output into project style.

devtools & IDEs.title: Open source maintainers flooded with AI slop
devtools & IDEs.problem: Maintainers receive growing volumes of low-quality AI-generated PRs, issues and security reports that cost more to triage than they are worth. There are no reliable trust signals.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Manual profile inspection, closing external PRs, Vouch contributor vetting, Pangram or Claude prefiltering, review bots, blocking new users, Linux kernel AI guidelines.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a triage and reputation layer that scores, filters and verifies incoming PRs and reports for quality, reproducibility and AI provenance.

devtools & IDEs.title: Controlling coding agents from a phone
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agent harnesses have weak mobile support, so developers improvise remote access to monitor and steer sessions away from their computer.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Claude Code remote control, Tailscale, ChatGPT connected to Codex, Chowder, SyncThing with a Telegram bot.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a mobile-first client for monitoring, steering and approving sessions of any coding agent on a remote machine.

devtools & IDEs.title: Sandboxing coding agents on local machines
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers worry agents will damage the host or reach credentials, and setting up microVMs and containers is fiddly and slow. Native sandboxing is hard on macOS and Windows.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Docker wrappers, Dagger, microVMs, Firecracker, macOS sandboxes, Qubes, Sprites.dev, SSH ForceCommand, dedicated VPS or Mac mini, scoped short-lived credentials.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Ship a one-command local agent sandbox that scopes files, network and credentials and makes permission prompts usable.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agents escaping sandboxes via shared infrastructure
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents can exploit shared internal services such as package caches to reach the internet or communicate covertly, so sandboxes are not airtight.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build monitoring and egress controls that detect agents using shared infrastructure as covert channels.

devtools & IDEs.title: Dependency and package supply-chain attacks
devtools & IDEs.problem: Malicious packages hit developers within hours of publication, and unpinned dependencies and actions make updates risky. Verifying maintainers and patched builds is hard.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Dependabot/Renovate delays, pip --uploaded-prior-to, Socket, version pinning, lockfile audits, npm scanners.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a tool that enforces cooldowns, pins actions, flags suspicious new releases and maintainer changes, and tracks patched versions.

devtools & IDEs.title: CI pipelines and caches as attack vectors
devtools & IDEs.problem: GitHub Actions caches and CI scanners can leak credentials or be poisoned, and config files can run malicious code.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: detect-secrets baselines, agent compromise checks, Vouch, cacheract demo.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build CI hardening and audit tooling that detects cache poisoning, credential leakage and risky dependencies.

devtools & IDEs.title: Patching faster than AI vulnerability discovery
devtools & IDEs.problem: AI finds vulnerabilities faster than fixes reach users, open source projects can't afford scanning, and end-of-life software stays exposed.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: OpenAI Codex Security, Anthropic OSS scanner, fuzzers, Claude-written backports, Renovate.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tooling that scans each release, amortizes scanning cost, and automatically patches and rolls out updates.

devtools & IDEs.title: Mojo language and tooling gaps
devtools & IDEs.problem: Mojo lacks Windows support, compiler bindings, core features and mature docs, with bugs and weak Python interop.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Python module workarounds, custom cpython bindings, reading stdlib code.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: A community Windows port, libmojo-style library, or Mojo guides and interop tooling.

devtools & IDEs.title: Cursor stability and account problems
devtools & IDEs.problem: Cursor releases bring lag, memory leaks, crashes, lost chats, login loops, UI regressions and confusing token use.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Downgrading versions, shell script patches, deleting app data, switching tools.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Offer a lighter, more stable agent IDE or a monitor that caps Cursor resource and token use.

devtools & IDEs.title: Bring-your-own key, model and harness portability
devtools & IDEs.problem: Coding tools restrict custom keys, endpoints, subscriptions and local models, and users juggle harnesses and models with no portable setup.
devtools & IDEs.who: developers using multiple coding agents and models
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: vibeproxy, OpenCode plugins, Pi harness, Copilot BYOK, OpenRouter, ACP in Zed, hybrid Copilot plus Claude.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a gateway and harness layer that plugs any model or subscription into any agent and ports workflows across harnesses.

devtools & IDEs.title: Hidden model reasoning and silent behavior changes
devtools & IDEs.problem: Hidden thinking output, undocumented harness changes, silent model fallbacks and opaque prompts leave users unable to see what the model did or why behavior changed.
devtools & IDEs.who: heavy users and auditors of coding agents
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Pinning older Claude Code versions, thinking-summary flags, proxy interception, stderr reasoning display, change records.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build an observability layer that captures reasoning, prompts and tool use and flags version changes and silent fallbacks.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agent-first workspaces for many parallel sessions
devtools & IDEs.problem: File-centric IDEs and chat interfaces handle parallel agents poorly, with worktree conflicts, fake progress indicators and little visibility or steering.
devtools & IDEs.who: developers running multiple agents in parallel
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: git worktrees, tmux, zellij, herdr, Windsurf multi-Cascade, VS Code agent management, Ralph-tui, Stream Deck, status lights.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a dashboard whose unit of work is the agent session, with isolated environments, real progress, status notifications, mobile mirroring and steering.

devtools & IDEs.title: Shared team workspaces for coding agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agent workflows are single-player, so teams can't share setups, context, plans or sessions, and non-engineers can't trigger changes.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Cursor Marketplace, Slack Code, GitHub planned multiplayer planning, Better Hub.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a team workspace with shared sessions, a marketplace of MCPs and skills, and Slack-native agent access.

devtools & IDEs.title: Documentation and APIs made consumable by agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Docs drift from code and agents need current, machine-readable docs, CLIs and version lists, but many libraries lack them.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Mintlify Autopilot and llms.txt, Context7 CLI, context-hub, DeepWiki, AGENTS.md, docs as npm packages.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a service that keeps agent-ready docs and current-version indexes updated from code, with quality feedback.

devtools & IDEs.title: Managing agent context files, rules and skills
devtools & IDEs.problem: Context files, rules, skills, hooks and MCPs are hand-built, scattered across tools in different formats, drift, conflict and impose a token tax.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md registries, lazy-loaded guides, claude-config repo, /init, /doctor audit.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a manager that generates, syncs, diffs and audits agent context files and skills, showing token cost and conflicts.

devtools & IDEs.title: Markdown that renders cleanly for humans and agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Browsers don't render Markdown or llm.txt cleanly, and HTML-Markdown conversion loses fidelity.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Appending .md to doc URLs, Markdown for Agents.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a browser extension and converter library for clean Markdown rendering and conversion.

devtools & IDEs.title: Exporting and sharing agent session transcripts
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agent transcripts are hard to export, search or share, omit queued prompts, and are separated from commit history.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: claude-code-transcripts, Showboat, gistpreview, Codex timeline viewer, Gists.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a cross-agent transcript capture and hosted sharing tool linked to commits and reviews.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agent intent and prompts lost from code history
devtools & IDEs.problem: Commits record changes but not the prompts and reasoning behind them, so reviewers and future agents lose the why.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Entire Checkpoints, GitAI, aggit, jj auto-commits per prompt.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Store prompts and transcripts as commit-adjacent records searchable in review.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agent-native CLIs versus MCP and token waste
devtools & IDEs.problem: Raw APIs and MCP servers waste tokens, and tools built for humans lack discoverability for agents.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Purpose-built agent CLIs, Stripe CLI, Jira acli, Playwright CLI, Printing Press.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Generate agent-optimized CLIs and docs for existing services.

devtools & IDEs.title: MCP server and client debugging friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: MCP has auth bugs, failing inspectors, SDK issues, context-heavy tool descriptions and weak testing and publishing support.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Glama Inspector, mcp-explorer CLI, McpSwitcher, self-fixes with Claude.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build an MCP inspector and testing toolkit with auth recovery, task simulation and context-cost analysis.

devtools & IDEs.title: Coarse and noisy agent permission prompts
devtools & IDEs.problem: Permission systems are all-or-nothing and prompt repeatedly, pushing users to skip permissions entirely.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Skip-permissions flag, auto-approve plus blacklist, hook exit codes.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a granular permission policy layer that auto-approves safe commands and blocks risky ones.

devtools & IDEs.title: Confusing AI product names and lineups
devtools & IDEs.problem: Overlapping product names, rebranding and uneven launches make AI tools hard to understand.

devtools & IDEs.title: Vibe-coded apps lack production readiness
devtools & IDEs.problem: Vibe-coded apps miss auth, secrets handling, logging and rate limiting, can break production, and become unmaintained liabilities.
devtools & IDEs.who: solo builders and non-expert app creators
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Progressive rollouts, static hosting, Cloudflare temporary deploys.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a production-hardening scanner and safe-extension scaffold that adds auth, logging, limits, docs and tests to AI-built apps.

devtools & IDEs.title: Git and CI strained by agent-scale volume
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents multiply commits, repos and CI runs beyond what Git, GitHub and CI were designed for, causing outages, slow loops and missing agent history.
devtools & IDEs.who: teams and platforms hosting agent work
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Entire git-sync, Scion, Sapling/Mononoke, stacked diffs, merge queues, Cursor Origin.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build agent-scale version control, hosting and CI with failure-only output, mirroring and failover.

devtools & IDEs.title: AI-generated UI lacks design taste and system fit
devtools & IDEs.problem: Models default to generic aesthetics and ignore real design systems, and design-to-code round trips are lossy.
devtools & IDEs.who: designers and front-end developers using agents
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Impeccable, design skills, Figma MCP, Stitch, Cursor design mode, Storybook, Taste MCP.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build design-skill packs and tools that constrain agent UI to a real design system and sync prototypes with code.

devtools & IDEs.title: Visual feedback loops between UI and coding agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers want to point at UI elements, show bugs and give agents visual and browser feedback, but passing images and context is manual.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: CSS Studio, Agentation, React Grab, DOM pickers, Chrome DevTools MCP, Scrawl, screen recordings.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a tool that annotates live UI, captures screenshots, voice and DOM state, and sends precise context to agents.

devtools & IDEs.title: Local model apps and IDE integration are poorly supported
devtools & IDEs.problem: Local LLM apps hide settings, logs and stats, and coding IDEs poorly support local models with usable context and tools.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: llama.cpp, LM Studio, VS Code with llama.cpp server, VoidEditor, Levante, LlamaBarn.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a local-model front end and IDE integration exposing backend settings, context, fit estimates and metrics.

devtools & IDEs.title: AI autocomplete is intrusive or unhelpful
devtools & IDEs.problem: LLM autocomplete is too slow or dumb and interrupts thinking, while some developers opt out of AI entirely.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Small specialized completion models, minimal vim setups, batching tasks for later review.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a less invasive assistant with low-latency completions or batched work for later review.

devtools & IDEs.title: Coding agents inaccessible to non-coders
devtools & IDEs.problem: CLI agents and self-hosted setups are too hard for non-technical users and carry IDE complexity.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: CLI wizards, Claude Cowork, Cursor Canvas, Claude artifacts, plug-and-play copilot builders.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a friendly conversational interface and guided setup for non-developers.

devtools & IDEs.title: Python environment, packaging and distribution friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: Python versions, locking, breaking tool upgrades, missing wheels and shipping compiled code to PyPI or Pyodide remain painful, though uv helps.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: uv, uvx, dependency groups, go-to-wheel, cibuildwheel for Pyodide, Justfile recipes.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build helpers that package native code into multi-platform wheels and Pyodide targets and check compatibility and upgrades.

devtools & IDEs.title: Slow startup of Python CLIs
devtools & IDEs.problem: Heavy eager imports add seconds to every CLI invocation.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Manual lazy imports, PEP 810.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a linter or profiler that finds and fixes expensive eager imports.

devtools & IDEs.title: Tensor and large-data visualization tools missing
devtools & IDEs.problem: There are no good viewers to explore tensors, low-bit formats, large traces and model internals.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Perfetto, Triton-Viz, Hugging Face architecture visualizer, comparing raw bits.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build an extensible viewer for tensors, layouts, traces and models with slicing, zoom and low-bit support.

devtools & IDEs.title: GPU kernel toolchain, setup and testing friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: Kernel DSLs are fragmented, GPU and CUDA setup and profiling are painful, and testing infrastructure is hard to reproduce.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: KernelIDE, Hugging Face Kernels, Popcorn CLI, Pixi environments, rocprof-trace-decoder, Tritonparse.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build preconfigured GPU environments, remote profiling and a hosted kernel benchmark harness across DSLs.

devtools & IDEs.title: GPU competition submission platforms are unreliable
devtools & IDEs.problem: Discord and GitHub-driven benchmark bots fail with timeouts and missing test access.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a more robust submission and test-access platform for kernel competitions.

devtools & IDEs.title: LLM APIs and client libraries are fragmented and fast-changing
devtools & IDEs.problem: Provider APIs and settings diverge, reasoning controls differ, and libraries lag behind new model features, making integration and comparison hard.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: LLM CLI plugins, Open Responses spec, OpenRouter, custom adapters, migration guides.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a conformance and abstraction layer that normalizes settings, tests provider capabilities and pins versions.

devtools & IDEs.title: CI debugging loops and automated PR fixing
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers can't reproduce CI locally, commit repeatedly to debug, and need ways to keep PRs green and revert bad deploys.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Claude Code CI-fix, glab, Cursor Rollouts, Bugbot Autofix.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build local CI reproduction and agents that diagnose failures and auto-revert broken releases.

devtools & IDEs.title: Prompt management and annotation tooling
devtools & IDEs.problem: Prompt tools can't run app code, LLMs write poor prompts, and manual tuning per model is laborious.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Prompts in Git, Hex notebooks, DSPy signatures.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a prompt workbench that runs real tools and RAG, auto-optimizes prompts and offers review UIs.

devtools & IDEs.title: Software factories and continuous agent loops
devtools & IDEs.problem: Teams want agents as a continuous part of the software lifecycle, while the framing is contested.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Continuous factory loops akin to CI/CD.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build orchestration that collects signals, prioritizes and runs agent work with humans in the loop.

devtools & IDEs.title: Mixed reviews of Google's coding tools
devtools & IDEs.problem: Antigravity and Gemini CLI are criticized as slow, flaky or literal.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Gemini 3 Pro in Windsurf, Zed.

devtools & IDEs.title: AI operating systems for vehicles and robots
devtools & IDEs.problem: Vehicles and robots need a reliable OS with real-time control, fail-safes and safe OTA updates.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Standard Bots StandardOS SDKs.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: A consolidated robotics or vehicle OS with safe OTA updates.

devtools & IDEs.title: AI PR review bots: shallow, opinionated, hard to trust
devtools & IDEs.problem: Automated reviewers vary in depth, give comments that are hard to verify, and may make humans less careful.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: CodeRabbit, Copilot reviewer, Cursor Bugbot, Rovo, Codex review, self-hosted BYO-model reviewers.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a configurable, verifiable review service where multiple models review, rank and justify comments with tunable strictness and auto-fix.

devtools & IDEs.title: Deterministic guardrails for agent-written code
devtools & IDEs.problem: Prose rules don't keep agent code consistent, so teams need machine-enforced checks and dead-code cleanup.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Custom ESLint/Pylint rules, pre-commit hooks, ruff hooks, vulture, Semgrep, test-first workflows.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a layer that turns conventions and review feedback into enforceable lint rules and agent hooks, packaged as workflows.

devtools & IDEs.title: Fast sandboxes for running untrusted and agent code
devtools & IDEs.problem: Running untrusted or AI-generated code safely needs quick-starting, isolated environments, but startup latency, setup and weak sandbox runtimes limit adoption.
devtools & IDEs.who: developers running LLM-generated or untrusted code
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Vercel Sandbox, Sysbox, gVisor, wasmtime, Deno permissions, Monty, MicroPython-in-WASM, iframe sandboxes.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a low-latency installable sandbox with resource controls, snapshot restore and Docker support.

devtools & IDEs.title: Per-PR and production-like environments for agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Reviewers and agents need full running environments, preloaded dependencies and production-faithful mocks, but standing them up is manual.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Per-PR staging, trynix-preview, Cursor Environments API, Conductor Cloud, exe.dev, Supabase local.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a service that spins up full stacks per PR or repo with mocked or masked-data backends and snapshot restore.

devtools & IDEs.title: Secrets and credentials leak in agent workflows
devtools & IDEs.problem: API keys leak through env files, commits and agent configs, and agents need scoped access to databases and services without raw secrets.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Doppler, Fly tokenizer, s3-credentials, Varlock, Tailscale ACLs, Stripe Projects CLI.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a secrets broker that injects scoped credentials, scans for leaks, handles rotation and audits agent access.

devtools & IDEs.title: Unpredictable AI coding pricing and usage caps
devtools & IDEs.problem: Plan changes, rate limits, quota burn and surprise billing across AI coding tools make cost hard to predict.
devtools & IDEs.who: heavy users of AI coding subscriptions
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Tiered models in Copilot, multiple accounts, free tiers, BYO keys, comparison sites, flat-rate Copilot Pro.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a cross-tool usage and cost tracker that predicts limits, warns on surprise billing and recommends cheaper models.

devtools & IDEs.title: Account bans and unreachable AI support
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers get suspended on AI accounts and cannot reach a human.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Asking a chatbot to escalate.

devtools & IDEs.title: Voice input for coding
devtools & IDEs.problem: Voice input struggles with technical spelling and precise details.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Deepgram Nova 3 in Claude Code voice mode, self-built speech-to-text.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build code-aware dictation that handles identifiers and mixes speech with snippets and screen context.

devtools & IDEs.title: Controlling agent verbosity and output
devtools & IDEs.problem: Users can't tune agent verbosity, and progressive reveal UIs give no cue about what's new.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Claude Code Concise style, stretchtext plugin.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build output-style tooling that compresses replies and marks newly revealed content.

devtools & IDEs.title: Persistent memory and session management for agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents and chat tools can't resume past sessions or keep project memory without cluttering context.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Mimir memory graph, Graphify, /add and /load.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a memory and session layer that stores and tiers sessions and file heat from git history.

devtools & IDEs.title: Disposable personal and internal tools built with AI
devtools & IDEs.problem: People build single-user and internal tools, but polishing, sharing and hosting them without standards is clumsy and the tools lack maintainability.
devtools & IDEs.who: individuals and teams building bespoke tools
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Single-prompt HTML tools, URL-persisted state, Datasette Apps, tiny app platforms.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a platform to host, share, sandbox and package personal agent-built tools.

devtools & IDEs.title: Publishing and deploying agent-built apps without friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: Shipping requires signing, compliance, accounts, DNS, OAuth and infrastructure steps that agents and beginners struggle with.
devtools & IDEs.who: builders of AI-generated sites and apps
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: here.now, Cloudflare Drop and temporary deploys, GitHub Pages, Fastlane, gistpreview, Dokku.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build zero-account instant deploy and publishing that handles signing, compliance and hosting.

devtools & IDEs.title: Measuring developer tool and AI usage
devtools & IDEs.problem: Teams and maintainers get little feedback on how tools and AI assistants are used.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Developer surveys.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build analytics combining usage data, observability and feedback.

devtools & IDEs.title: Designing products and the web for machine users
devtools & IDEs.problem: AI agents are becoming main users of products, so machine-readable interfaces matter while humans need approachable layers.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Text-first web interfaces, streaming AI-generated UI.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tooling that makes products and APIs agent-readable with a human layer.

devtools & IDEs.title: Emulation and hardware design for agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents need emulators and hooks to build for retro and embedded hardware, and struggle with CAD and PCB spatial reasoning.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Modified atari800 with MCP, ClayDash MCP, Opus on KiCAD, FluidCAD MCP.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build emulator-plus-MCP and CAD-aware agent packages for hardware work.

devtools & IDEs.title: Binary reverse engineering tooling
devtools & IDEs.problem: Reverse engineers lack fuzzy hex search and reliable relocation recovery.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Ghidra-based relocatable object exporter.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a hex editor with fuzzy structural search and relocation export.

devtools & IDEs.title: HAR forensics and browser automation tooling
devtools & IDEs.problem: Inspecting HAR contents is manual, and automation must attach to running Chrome and work across platforms.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: shot-scraper har -x.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a HAR browser and cross-platform CLI for driving existing browser sessions.

devtools & IDEs.title: Hard-to-reproduce legacy dev environments
devtools & IDEs.problem: Old projects lack docs and build only on golden VMs, and GPU or ROCm dependencies break installs.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Containerizing with Mono, browser-based Nix VM.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tools that capture and reproduce legacy build environments.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agent skills, plugins and MCP marketplaces
devtools & IDEs.problem: Discovering and switching skills, plugins and MCP servers is manual.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: MCP aggregators, skills repositories, Cursor rules, McpSwitcher.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a curated marketplace with compatibility checks and one-click switching.

devtools & IDEs.title: Open-source alternatives to engineering tools
devtools & IDEs.problem: Engineers want open-source replacements for Simulink, AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build or aggregate open-source engineering tool alternatives.

devtools & IDEs.title: Verifying agent code safely reaches production
devtools & IDEs.problem: Teams need tests, canaries, rollbacks and staging parity to ship agent-written code confidently.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Rollback practice, canary and A/B testing, TDD, Semgrep rules.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tooling that checks staging parity and behavior diffs before agent features land.

devtools & IDEs.title: React code quality and security scanning
devtools & IDEs.problem: React apps accumulate anti-patterns, rerender issues and exploits.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: React Doctor, React Compiler.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a scanner that finds and auto-fixes React anti-patterns and vulnerabilities.

devtools & IDEs.title: Software Heritage repo restoration
devtools & IDEs.problem: Restoring deleted repositories from Software Heritage is non-obvious.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Software Heritage Repository Retriever.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a one-click archived repository restore tool.

devtools & IDEs.title: Codebase knowledge graphs and docs for unfamiliar code
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers and agents lack queryable maps and accurate overviews of large or legacy codebases.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: DeepWiki, Code Wiki, Sourcebot, Sonar Vortex, Graphify, Gitinspect.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build private-repo code and infrastructure maps that stay current and feed agents context.

devtools & IDEs.title: Specifying intent and alternatives to chat for agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Users struggle to describe intent, agents get confused by terminology, and chat is a poor abstraction for control.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: CLAUDE.md flags, Emacs plan-approval tools.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a tool that batches clarifying questions, keeps a glossary and spec, and offers anchored or pair-style modes.

devtools & IDEs.title: Reliable mechanical refactoring at scale
devtools & IDEs.problem: Large codebases need deterministic refactors that IDEs and AI don't deliver reliably.
devtools & IDEs.who: maintainers of large C++ and legacy code
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Regex scripts with review.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build reliable refactoring tools for large legacy code.

devtools & IDEs.title: Formal verification is too hard to adopt
devtools & IDEs.problem: Formal methods tools are powerful but rarely used because they are hard.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: TLA+, SPIN, Dafny, F*, Liquid Haskell.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build LLM-assisted formal verification tooling.

devtools & IDEs.title: Platform risk and forking open source infrastructure
devtools & IDEs.problem: Companies owning key infrastructure can stop development, prompting forks.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Forking permissive tools.

devtools & IDEs.title: Header-based CSRF protection
devtools & IDEs.problem: Token-based CSRF needs hidden inputs and API exemptions.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Sec-Fetch-Site checks in Go 1.25 and Datasette.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Provide drop-in header-based CSRF middleware for other frameworks.

devtools & IDEs.title: YouTube embed Error 153 referrer fix
devtools & IDEs.problem: YouTube embeds fail with same-origin referrer policy.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Set strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

devtools & IDEs.title: Filtering AI content out of feeds
devtools & IDEs.problem: Users want to hide AI posts from feeds dominated by AI.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: uBlock regex rule, vibecoded Chrome extension.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a configurable keyword feed-filter extension.

devtools & IDEs.title: Free AI tool access for open source maintainers
devtools & IDEs.problem: Maintainers below popularity thresholds lack premium AI tool access.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Claude for Open Source free Max access.

devtools & IDEs.title: Hugging Face Spaces build failures
devtools & IDEs.problem: Spaces builds fail with registry errors and Gradio version bugs.

devtools & IDEs.title: Model version churn breaks prompts and dependencies
devtools & IDEs.problem: New models require rewriting prompts and behave differently, and developers want stable pinned versions.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Heavy pre-prompting, versioning prompts in Git and notebooks.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a prompt migration and regression tool that tests prompts across model versions.

devtools & IDEs.title: Norms for crediting AI authorship and vibe-coded projects
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers lack shared norms for attributing AI-built work, and authors of vibe-coded projects often can't explain their code.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Labeling libraries as alpha releases.

enterprise adoption.title: Data retention rules block regulated and zero-retention enterprises
enterprise adoption.problem: Mandatory 30-day retention, subprocessors and vendor reuse of data conflict with enterprise zero-data-retention policies. Sensitive or regulated data cannot be sent to frontier APIs, and zero-retention terms cost extra.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises in regulated sectors and security or compliance teams
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Paying premiums for zero retention; contract negotiation over trajectory data; enterprises taking on retention themselves; private hosting on Azure
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a gateway or proxy that routes sensitive workloads to zero-retention models and gives auditable evidence of data flows.

enterprise adoption.title: Single-vendor lock-in and model churn break enterprise workflows
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises tied to one model provider face sudden access loss, pricing changes, deprecations and silent quality changes. Porting agent state, prompts and pipelines across models is hard.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises and SaaS vendors building on frontier model APIs
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Multi-vendor fallback; TELUS 30+ LLM switchboard; open-model fallbacks; multi-cloud model availability; older open-weight models
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a vendor-neutral gateway with dependency mapping, portable agent state, regression testing and evaluation-based model switching.

enterprise adoption.title: Frontier model access cut off by governments or vendors
enterprise adoption.problem: Export controls, staged government-approved releases and vendor decisions abruptly restrict or delay frontier model access. Products and workflows break with little warning.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises and downstream product builders relying on frontier models
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Multi-vendor hedging; backup contracts with non-US vendors; requesting special API access; Microsoft keeping Anthropic available
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a resilient access layer with automatic failover and availability monitoring.

enterprise adoption.title: Government vendor blacklisting forces compliance and migration
enterprise adoption.problem: When a government flags an AI vendor as a supply chain risk, contractors must certify non-use, run dual stacks or migrate quickly. Scope is unclear and costly.
enterprise adoption.who: government contractors and enterprises using the flagged vendor
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Dual technology stacks; Claude Gov variants; deployment via Palantir and AWS GovCloud; maintaining multiple providers
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer tooling that maps AI vendor dependencies across systems and automates certification and migration to alternate models.

enterprise adoption.title: Subscription rate limits, quotas and lockouts block heavy use
