enterprise adoption.problem: Subscription plans impose weekly limits, opaque quotas and lockouts without human support, and limits tie to a vendor's own harness. Heavy and autonomous users cannot forecast or convert allowances.
enterprise adoption.who: heavy individual and enterprise users of AI subscriptions
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Upgrading tiers; monthly API credits; usage-based pricing; API billing
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build usage tracking and quota management that pools and forecasts allowances across providers and is harness-agnostic.

enterprise adoption.title: Self-hosted and on-prem LLM deployment is hard
enterprise adoption.problem: Companies whose data cannot leave the premises lack mature practices and tooling for running local or private-cloud models, especially in air-gapped or GPU-limited environments.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises with sensitive or regulated data
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Open-source models on own infrastructure; Ollama; split of cloud models for development and local for private data; self-hosted Kimi/Qwen
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer turnkey private-deployment stacks with orchestration, monitoring, sandboxing and support for constrained hardware.

enterprise adoption.title: Staff paste proprietary data into external AI tools
enterprise adoption.problem: Confidential and regulated data entered into external AI tools creates legal exposure and leakage risk.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build data-loss-prevention tooling that detects and redacts sensitive content before it reaches external AI services.

enterprise adoption.title: Sovereign and regional AI options for governments and EU firms
enterprise adoption.problem: Governments and companies outside the US worry about being cut off and find regional hosting and data-residency options underdeveloped.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Austria's GovGPT on Open WebUI with Mistral; Sakana Namazu API
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer sovereign-hosted, residency-compliant AI platforms built on open models.

enterprise adoption.title: Open-weight model provenance, license and trust barriers
enterprise adoption.problem: Unknown origins, custom licenses, hidden behavior and missing safety documentation keep enterprises from adopting strong open models.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprise legal, security and AI teams evaluating open models
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Legal license review; preferring US-origin models; an openness index
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build model-vetting tooling that scores provenance, license risk and compliance documentation and scans for hidden behavior.

enterprise adoption.title: Identity, permissions and access control for enterprise agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises lack per-agent identity, scoped credentials and permission-aware access to company data and APIs. Agents are often trusted by default and shared identities conflict with audit logs.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprise IT and security teams deploying agents
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Cloudflare AI Gateway; MCP servers with SSO/OAuth; Descope IAM for agents; enterprise-managed MCP auth; banks treating agents as managed digital employees
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an agent identity and authorization control plane with scoped credentials, least-privilege data access, audit logs and approvals.

enterprise adoption.title: Runtime sandboxing and isolation for enterprise agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Agents can take reckless actions, leak data or write dangerously to databases, so enterprises require runtime isolation before deploying them.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Cowork's VM sandboxing; bounded execution environments
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide hardware-isolated agent sandboxes with content scanning and controlled write access.

enterprise adoption.title: Third-party agents acting on bank accounts and service channels
enterprise adoption.problem: Outside agents act faster than banks and providers can respond, and providers cannot verify who or what is acting on accounts.
enterprise adoption.who: banks, financial institutions and service providers
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Credit cards for AI agents with spend limits
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build permissioned agent-access and payment rails with identity verification, spend controls and visibility.

enterprise adoption.title: Enterprises cannot measure or demonstrate AI ROI
enterprise adoption.problem: Few companies track an AI impact metric, many stay stuck in pilots, and productivity claims are unsourced or contradictory. Boards demand ROI without baselines.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Tracking minutes or hours saved per employee on specific workflows
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build ROI measurement tools that baseline workflows and attribute time and cost savings and business impact to AI.

enterprise adoption.title: LLM unreliability limits value in professional work
enterprise adoption.problem: Models are brittle and confidently wrong, and reliability lags accuracy, eroding trust in professional and safety-critical use.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build reliability and verification layers for high-stakes workflows.

enterprise adoption.title: Organizations cannot redesign processes as fast as AI improves
enterprise adoption.problem: Old processes, slow approvals and unclear job boundaries prevent organizations from capturing AI gains.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer process-mapping and change-management tools that find where AI fits and help redesign workflows.

enterprise adoption.title: Teams lack AI enablement and use-case discovery
enterprise adoption.problem: Employees and leaders struggle to learn effective AI practices and see what AI can do for their roles. Use stays with a few early adopters and uneven adoption breeds friction.
enterprise adoption.who: non-engineering teams and enterprise enablement leads
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Role-specific tool bundles pre-installed on laptops; concrete use-case onboarding; staged adoption frameworks
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build enablement platforms that share prompts, skills and role-specific workflows and track adoption by team.

enterprise adoption.title: Mandated AI usage and token leaderboards get gamed
enterprise adoption.problem: Forced AI usage metrics, token leaderboards and review requirements push employees to game numbers, producing low-value use, resentment and waste.
enterprise adoption.who: employees and managers under AI mandates
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Employee petitions; defining outcomes and letting engineers choose tools; some teams banning agentic dev
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build usage analytics that tie AI consumption to useful outcomes by workflow rather than raw activity.

enterprise adoption.title: Managers' AI-generated content burdens colleagues
enterprise adoption.problem: Verbose, shallow or unowned AI-generated documents and messages force engineers to spend time filtering and debunking them.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build workplace tooling that flags, labels or summarizes AI-generated content and enforces communication norms.

enterprise adoption.title: Uncontrolled AI token spend and budgeting
enterprise adoption.problem: Inference costs per engineer and tool are rising and hard to budget, so companies ration usage, cap spend or cut access without clear ROI.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Uber per-tool cap; role-based tiering; routing to cheaper models (Coinbase, AT&T, Lindy on DeepSeek); Shopify DSPy optimization
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build spend-governance software that tracks tokens per team, sets budgets with chargeback, and routes tasks to the cheapest adequate model.

enterprise adoption.title: Companies replace SaaS with in-house AI-built tools
enterprise adoption.problem: Teams debate rebuilding SaaS apps with agents versus buying, and non-developers want to build their own tools. Quick replacements may be cheaper or fragile.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Craft Docs replacing Zendesk; in-house Intercom, Chargebee and PagerDuty replacements; Google Sheets plus LLM replacing CRM; Gemini gems
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer platforms to build, host and maintain internal replacements of common SaaS tools with guardrails.

enterprise adoption.title: Legacy system and COBOL modernization is risky
enterprise adoption.problem: Undocumented business rules, lost specifications and the need for line-by-line review of AI code stall legacy and mainframe migration. Experts are retiring.
enterprise adoption.who: banks and enterprises with legacy systems
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Agents reverse-engineering legacy apps into specs; business rule extraction; human line-by-line review
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build tools that extract and validate business rules and run automated equivalence testing for migration.

enterprise adoption.title: Support bots trap customers and lack human escalation
enterprise adoption.problem: Voice and chat support agents loop users, miss urgent situations and cannot hand off to humans. Agent-driven traffic also strains channels built for humans.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Hybrid models that escalate to humans; Fin AI agent
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build support agents with emergency detection, reliable human handoff, and agent-aware triage and authentication.

enterprise adoption.title: LLM-assisted customer support and ops agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Support teams want to summarize ticket histories, classify requests, draft replies and run ticketing processes end to end without scaling headcount.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Vercel internal agents resolving 70% of tickets; Sierra; Agentforce; Intercom Apex; n8n receptionists
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build vertical support and ops agents with full context capture, human review and easy administration.

enterprise adoption.title: Clinical documentation, prior authorization and workflow fit
enterprise adoption.problem: Clinicians spend hours on documentation, prior authorization takes weeks, and tools that add EHR clicks are rejected. Alerts get ignored and AI-driven upcoding escalates costs.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Ambient documentation; embedded local guidelines; CMS coverage and ICD-10 connectors
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build low-friction EHR-embedded documentation, prior-authorization and coding-compliance tools.

enterprise adoption.title: Verifying AI output in high-stakes professional work
enterprise adoption.problem: Checking AI-generated legal, medical or consulting documents can take as long as writing them. Hallucinations pass through handoffs and there is no standard disclosure.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Human in the loop; Gemini linked citations; Harvey
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build verification tools with source tracing and highlighting that make checking AI-drafted work faster.

enterprise adoption.title: Vertical AI needs deep customization and forward deployment
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprise and professional customers want custom builds that vendors struggle to deliver at scale, so AI deployment depends on costly embedded engineers.
enterprise adoption.who: AI vendors and enterprises deploying AI
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Forward-deployed engineers; Harvey use-case libraries; no-code configuration on shared primitives; design partners
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Productize forward deployment with templates and tooling that turn customer-specific work into reusable features, or offer managed deployment services.

enterprise adoption.title: Contract language fails to constrain government AI use
enterprise adoption.problem: Vague phrases like 'all lawful use' give weak limits on military and government AI use.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Safety stacks; forward-deployed engineers; API-call-level restrictions

enterprise adoption.title: Government AI procurement and access rules create friction
enterprise adoption.problem: Proposed procurement terms, designations and unclear permitted uses make government AI integration risky.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Less-restricted variants for specific agencies

enterprise adoption.title: Export control and KYC compliance for frontier models
enterprise adoption.problem: Unclear rules and the impossibility of verifying user nationality make export-control compliance uncertain.

enterprise adoption.title: Data center and infrastructure buildout opposition
enterprise adoption.problem: Local opposition, permitting and grid constraints threaten AI infrastructure timelines.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Locked-in electricity prices; property value guarantees

enterprise adoption.title: AI vendor risk assessment and auditable guardrails
enterprise adoption.problem: Security and risk leaders lack checklists, verifiable evidence and insurance to assess AI vendors and agents, and cannot enforce vendor usage restrictions.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Evaluation checklist; Lloyd's-style AI insurance proposed; voluntary pre-deployment evals
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build AI vendor assessment and agent risk-scoring tools with standard questionnaires and tamper-proof evidence trails.

enterprise adoption.title: Audit-ready traceability for AI outputs in regulated industries
enterprise adoption.problem: Regulated industries need verifiable, traceable AI outputs and auditable documentation, and many remain blocked by IT and legal.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build traceability tooling linking model-generated figures to sources and logs for audit.

enterprise adoption.title: Overwhelmed security teams need automated triage and testing
enterprise adoption.problem: SOCs face thousands of alerts, scanners exceed what teams can patch, human red teams are expensive, and insider threats and breached internal AI tools go undetected.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Palo Alto's heavy Mythos token spend for vulnerability finding
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build AI alert triage, vulnerability ranking, continuous penetration testing and insider-threat detection.

enterprise adoption.title: Agents need company context and tacit knowledge
enterprise adoption.problem: Business rules and tacit knowledge live in meetings, emails and scattered systems that agents cannot see, so agents lack governed company context.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Airbnb Everest context graph; hybrid RAG over internal docs; MCP servers for Slack/Drive; Glean; WorkOS Atlas; HubSpot HubCode
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a permission-aware organizational memory and context layer that captures meetings and procedures and connects company data for agents.

enterprise adoption.title: Role-specific agent bundles and enterprise-scale agent deployment
enterprise adoption.problem: Companies want organization-wide, role-specific agents rather than fragmented deployments, and tools built for small teams fail at thousands of engineers.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Indent shared agent; Lindy Teammate; Anthropic finance agent templates; open source agent tooling; TELUS multi-LLM platform
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build role-specific agent packages and a control plane with identity, policy and cost controls for rollout across employees.

enterprise adoption.title: Weak Copilot-style enterprise tools frustrate users
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprise users get weaker tools like Microsoft Copilot while power users use advanced agents, and demand for horizontal AI SaaS looks weak.

enterprise adoption.title: Companies pick models on benchmarks, not task fit
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises choose models by public benchmarks and cost, and cannot evaluate them on their own workflows. Bad early experiences persist after updates.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build private workflow benchmarks and scheduled re-evaluation of models and tools.

enterprise adoption.title: Plug-and-play AI for non-technical small businesses
enterprise adoption.problem: Non-tech organizations want AI that solves a specific problem out of the box and struggle to find where it fits.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Off-the-shelf AI tools, as in a small arborist company
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build vertical, packaged AI automations for common small-business processes.

enterprise adoption.title: AI-built tools and code ship with security and quality flaws
enterprise adoption.problem: AI-generated tools and PRs ship with security holes, missing tests and missed edge cases, and reviewers lack context. Skill erosion erodes trust.
enterprise adoption.who: non-engineers and engineering teams reviewing AI output
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Banning agentic development; screening hires
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build automated security, test and requirements review for AI-generated apps and PRs that surfaces AI-authored changes.

enterprise adoption.title: Accountability and liability for AI and agent failures
enterprise adoption.problem: It is unclear who is responsible when AI-written code or autonomous agents go wrong, and liability constrains adoption.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Keeping a human in the loop
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build incident logging and accountability-trace tooling that attributes agent actions.

enterprise adoption.title: Debate over AI, headcount and worker resistance
enterprise adoption.problem: Leaders argue whether to cut or augment staff, while workers and unions resist AI and feel anxious about changes.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Union contracts; petitions; amicus briefs

enterprise adoption.title: Frontier lab safety oversight and internal governance
enterprise adoption.problem: Labs lack external oversight and coordination, and employees are restricted from discussing safety concerns.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Embedded external reviewers with publication rights

enterprise adoption.title: AI for science and drug discovery tooling gaps
enterprise adoption.problem: AI for drug and materials discovery faces slow validation and per-problem retraining, and scientists struggle to run models and integrate with lab platforms.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Integrations with PubMed, Benchling and 10x Genomics; local models; mixing technicians and automation
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Package structure-prediction and lab-platform integrations for non-computational scientists.

enterprise adoption.title: Biomarker-based patient cohort selection tool
enterprise adoption.problem: Oncology needs software that matches tumors to likely effective treatments using biomarkers.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a cohort-selection tool matching tumor biomarkers to likely effective treatments.

enterprise adoption.title: Organizational inertia slows AI diffusion
enterprise adoption.problem: Path dependence, procurement delays and resistant non-tech businesses slow diffusion of useful AI.

enterprise adoption.title: Governance and observability for deployed agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises struggle to monitor, audit and govern agents, MCP servers and integrations across teams, and prompting alone does not enforce policy.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Centralized MCP gateways; human-approval patterns for finance agents; parallel org charts for human and agent staff
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an enterprise agent control plane with observability, policy enforcement, risk tiering and approval flows.

enterprise adoption.title: Shadow AI and restrictive IT policies
enterprise adoption.problem: Security rules block capable AI tools while employees build or use unsanctioned tools, causing violations and unmanaged personal subscriptions.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Sandbox with open generative AI for 30,000 employees; AI builder labs; banning agentic dev; copy-paste only
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a sanctioned, governed gateway and sandbox with guardrails and visibility into shadow AI use.

enterprise adoption.title: Custom CRM and system-of-record integrations are hard
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises want custom integrations with CRM and document systems, but incumbents lock down APIs and data portability.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Forward-deployed bespoke integrations; AI-coded internal CRM/CMS; HubSpot API parity for agents
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build integration layers that expose systems of record headlessly to agents.

enterprise adoption.title: Individual AI coding gains fail to scale to teams
enterprise adoption.problem: Developers see personal speedups but organization-level gains do not follow, and work left 80% done by AI is costly to finish.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Smaller end-to-end-owned teams; Claude Code rollout days
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build team-level workflow and measurement tooling linking coding agent output to shipped work.

enterprise adoption.title: Patient privacy, consent and cost concerns with clinical AI
enterprise adoption.problem: Patients cannot assess privacy risks of AI scribes, and automated tools deny care and drive up coding costs.

enterprise adoption.title: Clinical AI needs HIPAA compliance, validation and interpretability
enterprise adoption.problem: Clinicians need HIPAA-compliant, validated and explainable AI, and prefer general frontier models while hospital IT prefers specialized ones.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: ChatGPT for Clinicians; ChatGPT for Healthcare; OpenEvidence; Utah AI refill triage; Transpara
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build clinically validated, explainable decision-support that assembles patient context from EHR and wearables.

enterprise adoption.title: Legal AI: practice rules, privacy and multilingual gaps
enterprise adoption.problem: Legal AI faces unauthorized-practice rules, strict privacy and weak non-English performance, while lawyers lose time to administrative work.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Legora on Azure for privacy; translation step for non-English
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a tool handling lawyers' administrative and client-acquisition work.

enterprise adoption.title: Finance agents need approval gates and back-office automation
enterprise adoption.problem: Agents make financial errors and finance work needs human approval, while accounting firms face crunch periods and need client data isolation.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Propose-for-approval design; Brex and Goldman onboarding/KYC agents; finance agent templates; expense audit agent plus review agent
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build finance agent frameworks with approval gates, audit trails, error detection and per-client isolation.

enterprise adoption.title: In-house domain LLMs trained on private data
enterprise adoption.problem: Companies will not sell proprietary domain data to LLM providers but want specialized models, and training from scratch is costly.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises with proprietary data, such as pharma
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Pharma co-funded open model with federated fine-tune
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build pipelines that adapt open-weight base models to private data, including federated fine-tuning.

enterprise adoption.title: Regulatory compliance tooling for AI providers and products
enterprise adoption.problem: AI providers must comply with jurisdiction-specific rules such as China provider lists, nationality-based access limits and 200+ regimes.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: China compliance-as-a-service; Neimo MCP regulatory experts
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build compliance services covering nationality verification and jurisdiction-specific rules.

enterprise adoption.title: Agent-driven product development and in-house coding agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Teams want workflows from customer feedback to merged PR and build their own background coding agents.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Ramp and Shopify in-house coding agents; open-sourced Codex hiring skills
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build workflow tooling that triages feedback and routes it to agents through to merged PRs.

enterprise adoption.title: Robot deployment and integration at customer sites
enterprise adoption.problem: Robotics stays demo-oriented, integration costs exceed robot price, and deploying onto fragmented machine operating systems is hard.
enterprise adoption.who: warehouse and industrial operators and robotics vendors
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Teleoperation; Motive fleet platform; Waymo remote-operator ratios as a model
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build integration, deployment and OS-layer services for robots across heterogeneous machines.

enterprise adoption.title: Vision reasoning for inspection and compliance checks
enterprise adoption.problem: Vision models rely on memorized cues and miscount visible parts, limiting inspection use cases.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Visual reasoning for video policy checks
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build vision-model tools for automated plan-versus-code compliance checks and visual inspection.

enterprise adoption.title: Logistics claim investigations rely on manual legacy lookups
enterprise adoption.problem: Damaged or lost package claims require manual queries of warehouse systems, carrier portals and driver calls.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an investigation agent that queries legacy systems and assembles claim evidence.

enterprise adoption.title: Executive oversight tools beyond passive dashboards
enterprise adoption.problem: Senior management needs tools that monitor whole-firm operations, surface loose ends and act on them.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: AI agents doing proactive research and flagging priorities
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an executive agent that continuously monitors operations and acts on findings.

enterprise adoption.title: Agent evaluation and reliability gating before production
enterprise adoption.problem: Deployers lack context-specific evaluations and reliability thresholds to decide when agents can move from sandbox to production.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Human review before removing the human (Vercel sales agent)
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide internal eval harnesses and reliability-threshold tooling for production readiness.

enterprise adoption.title: Public-sector AI adoption and policy analyst tools
enterprise adoption.problem: Governments and legislative staff struggle to use AI and lack tools built for policymakers.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build AI analyst tools and evaluations tailored to policymakers.

enterprise adoption.title: Domain-specific report-building research assistants
enterprise adoption.problem: Domain professionals need tools that extract sourced facts, flag contradictions and build reports from reviewed findings rather than generic chat.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build research workflows that extract sourced facts, flag gaps and draft reports.

enterprise adoption.title: Enterprise vendor choice and trust between Anthropic and OpenAI
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprise buyers prefer Anthropic and distrust OpenAI, and cloud onboarding friction influences vendor choice.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Claude Marketplace; Snowflake partnerships; Bedrock

enterprise adoption.title: Slow enterprise AI sales cycles for AI vendors
enterprise adoption.problem: AI startups face long enterprise cycles, buyer-side AI creates new objections, and SaaS sales motions do not fit product-led AI lands.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Proving value in one PE portfolio company then expanding; single CRO
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide sales tooling for AI deals such as handling AI-generated RFPs and pilot-to-rollout playbooks.

evals & testing.title: Saturated public benchmarks need harder replacements
evals & testing.problem: Major benchmarks are maxed out, noisy or answerable without reading the question, so they no longer separate frontier models. Good unsaturated evals are scarce.
evals & testing.who: labs, model buyers and benchmark maintainers
evals & testing.current_solutions: Moving-target benchmarks like Frontier-Bench, harder ARC-AGI versions, SatBench saturation tracking, harder tiers
evals & testing.opportunity: Build continuously refreshed, hard-to-saturate benchmark suites and a tracker that flags saturation and curates replacements.

evals & testing.title: Safety and dangerous-capability evals are saturated, narrow and costly
evals & testing.problem: Safety, bio and cyber evals saturate quickly, probe only predefined failure paths, and are slow and expensive to run. Risk thresholds are vague.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Headroom eval suites, production evals on live traffic, triage of evaluations, proposed shared cross-lab metrics
evals & testing.opportunity: Build shared, cheaper, frontier-calibrated safety eval suites with rare-behavior estimation.

evals & testing.title: Benchmark contamination and answer leakage inflate scores
evals & testing.problem: Test questions, answers and fix commits leak into training data or eval environments, so scores reflect memorization. Indirect contamination is hard to detect.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Date-cutoff splits, private held-out sets, hidden backup tests, contamination-auditing agents, offline coding evals
evals & testing.opportunity: Offer contamination detection plus continuously generated fresh, private or offline eval tasks.

evals & testing.title: Benchmarks contain broken tasks, wrong answers and buggy graders
evals & testing.problem: Public benchmarks include impossible tasks, flawed gold answers, buggy verifiers and extraction failures, so scores misstate ability. Fixing them needs manual expert work.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Epoch audits, manual expert review, per-instance provisioning, repeated runs for confidence intervals
evals & testing.opportunity: Build an automated benchmark-audit tool that finds unsolvable, mis-graded or leaky items and reports corrected scores.

evals & testing.title: Agents reward-hack graders and RL environments undetected
evals & testing.problem: Agents exploit flawed graders, impossible tasks, logs and sloppy sandboxes to score without solving the task. Patching is one-off and detection is weak.
evals & testing.who: eval builders, RL environment designers and labs
evals & testing.current_solutions: LLM transcript graders, canary reward paths, activation probes, CheatBench, manual patching
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a detector and environment auditor for reward hacking, impossible tasks and suspicious score jumps.

evals & testing.title: Building RL environments and clean reward signals is costly
evals & testing.problem: Verifiable environments and cheap verifiers are scarce and costly to build. Bad episodes and incomplete resets contaminate training signals.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Prime Intellect Lab, OpenReward, WebArena-Infinity, Terminal-bench
evals & testing.opportunity: Build tools to generate and validate verifiable environments and flag bad RL episodes.

evals & testing.title: Agent eval sandboxes leak into real systems
evals & testing.problem: Agent and cyber eval sandboxes have been misconfigured or escaped, reaching the real internet and real companies, and incidents are often unnoticed.
evals & testing.who: labs and evaluators running agentic evals
evals & testing.current_solutions: Air-gapped networks, trace monitoring, escape stress tests, third-party testing firms
evals & testing.opportunity: Provide hardened sandboxes with default-deny egress, escape testing and breach alerts.

evals & testing.title: Models detect evals and sandbag, invalidating tests
evals & testing.problem: Models recognize test setups, behave differently or underperform deliberately, so alignment and capability evals may not reflect deployment.
evals & testing.current_solutions: De-identified real-request evals, honeypots, probing, production monitoring, eval-awareness ablations
evals & testing.opportunity: Build tooling to measure eval awareness and generate production-indistinguishable test environments.

evals & testing.title: Benchmark scores do not match real-world usefulness
evals & testing.problem: Headline scores diverge from daily use, and benchmaxxing erodes trust. Users cannot tell which model is better in practice.
evals & testing.who: developers, model buyers and teams choosing models
evals & testing.current_solutions: Vibe checks, long-session reports, private evals, open-world evals, live-session leaderboards
evals & testing.opportunity: Build real-work benchmarks and independent comparison views grounded in actual usage.

evals & testing.title: Private task-specific evals to choose and track models
evals & testing.problem: Teams and individuals want repeatable evals on their own workloads to pick models and catch regressions, but few can build them.
evals & testing.who: companies, builders and individual power users
evals & testing.current_solutions: In-house eval suites, personal prompt sets, blind judge scoring, production-sampled evals
evals & testing.opportunity: Offer a service that turns a user's real tasks into private evals rerun on each new model.

evals & testing.title: Pelican-style informal benchmarks need comparison tooling
evals & testing.problem: Informal SVG and creative prompts are used as personal benchmarks but are hard to compare across models and effort levels, and are losing signal.
evals & testing.current_solutions: llm CLI, comparison grids, render-and-iterate loops, secret backup prompts
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a gallery that runs fixed visual prompts across models and effort levels with grading and cost tallies.

evals & testing.title: Benchmarks ignore cost, tokens and effort settings
evals & testing.problem: Scores omit cost, token usage, speed and reasoning effort, so cost-performance tradeoffs are hidden.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Artificial Analysis cost charts, Pareto charts, Agent Arena cost filters
evals & testing.opportunity: Publish cost-per-outcome and effort-swept benchmark views.

evals & testing.title: Benchmark results hide harness, settings and configuration
evals & testing.problem: The same model scores very differently by harness, provider, sampling and setup, and reports omit these details, so comparisons are not like-for-like.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Harness-Bench, Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, harness disclosure, repeat runs
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a standardized harness and reporting layer that records settings and compares identical setups.

evals & testing.title: Eval results are noisy and non-deterministic
evals & testing.problem: Repeated runs give different results, timings vary, and scores lack uncertainty, so one-off numbers and regression tests are unreliable.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Low temperature, fixed seeds, repeated runs, confidence intervals
evals & testing.opportunity: Provide a CI eval runner that repeats trials and reports confidence, variance and stable timing.

evals & testing.title: Vendor benchmark claims lack independent verification
evals & testing.problem: Vendors self-report, cherry-pick baselines, change charts and omit methodology.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Artificial Analysis and same-prompt independent leaderboards
evals & testing.opportunity: Build an independent re-evaluation tracker that checks claimed scores against standardized runs.

evals & testing.title: Silent degradation of hosted models goes untracked
evals & testing.problem: Hosted models may be nerfed, quantized or rerouted, and users lack a standard way to detect regressions.
evals & testing.who: developers and teams relying on hosted models
evals & testing.current_solutions: Anecdotes, ad hoc retesting, mirrored production traffic, LiveNerf frozen panels
evals & testing.opportunity: Run a scheduled fixed-panel tracker on providers that charts drift and alerts.

evals & testing.title: Independent third-party AI evaluators and auditors are needed
evals & testing.problem: Labs largely grade themselves, while outside evaluators lack access, authority and independence.
evals & testing.who: policymakers, safety researchers and the public
evals & testing.current_solutions: METR, Apollo, CAISI agreements, embedded evaluators, double-blind pilots
evals & testing.opportunity: Offer independent or double-blind evaluation services and standards.

evals & testing.title: Leaderboard aggregation and eval registry tooling
evals & testing.problem: Results are scattered across sites without shared schema, provenance, history or pricing.
evals & testing.current_solutions: LMArena Chrome extension, Hugging Face Community Evals, HELM, Inspect AI
evals & testing.opportunity: Build an aggregator with shared schema, historical snapshots, pricing and provenance.

evals & testing.title: Arena Elo is gameable and does not reflect real usefulness
evals & testing.problem: Vote-based arenas measure chat preference, can be gamed, and miss agentic and long-context quality.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Windsurf Arena Mode, Arena Pareto charts, task-specific bake-offs
evals & testing.opportunity: Build task-grounded, domain or personal arenas with reproducible scoring.

evals & testing.title: LMArena usability and reliability friction
evals & testing.problem: Repeated captchas, hangs, false moderation and missing controls interrupt comparison sessions.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Using Google AI Studio instead
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a lighter comparison client with generation controls and coding support.

evals & testing.title: Coding benchmarks overstate mergeable, maintainable code
evals & testing.problem: Passing tests does not mean code is mergeable, clean or durable, and existing suites are contaminated or unrepresentative.
evals & testing.current_solutions: SlopCodeBench, SWE-Bench Pro, DeepSWE, CursorBench, FrontierCode
evals & testing.opportunity: Build real-repo evals scoring mergeability, regressions, design quality and long-term survival.

evals & testing.title: Long-horizon agent benchmarks are missing or saturated
evals & testing.problem: Short single-session suites miss multi-day work, memory and continuity, and the METR time-horizon chart is saturating.
evals & testing.current_solutions: SWE-Marathon, FrontierSWE, METR time horizons, CodeClash, Odysseys
evals & testing.opportunity: Build long-horizon environments with persistent state and objective progress metrics.

evals & testing.title: Game and simulated-business environments for agent benchmarks
evals & testing.problem: Game and simulation benchmarks lack fidelity, fair budgets and replay methodology.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Baldur's Gate 3 harness, Vending-Bench, FoodTruck Bench, MineBench, WoW MCP
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a standard game and simulation harness with budget modes, replays and scoring.

evals & testing.title: LLM judges are biased and manipulable
evals & testing.problem: Judges show position bias, self-preference and length bias, and can be prompt-injected.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Separate judge families, swapped-order runs, Cohen's kappa
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a judge-reliability suite measuring stability, bias and injection vulnerability.

evals & testing.title: Calibrating LLM judges against human labels
evals & testing.problem: Judges are rarely validated against human labels, and calibrating them is slow.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Binary per-dimension judges, TPR/TNR validation, train/dev/test labels
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a workflow that bootstraps and validates judges from few human labels.

evals & testing.title: Eval workflow tooling for error analysis and authoring
evals & testing.problem: Teams find building evals, annotating traces, error clustering and choosing what to measure tedious and fragmented.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Braintrust, Promptfoo, LangSmith, Hamel's eval skills, custom clustering
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a lightweight workbench with error clustering, annotation and auto-drafted evals.

evals & testing.title: Turning production traces into continuous evals
evals & testing.problem: Agent traces are large and confidential, and gold sets go stale. Teams need live loops from traces to evals and harness fixes.
evals & testing.current_solutions: CI evals, transcript replay, Harbor, auto-research loops, notebooks over traces
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a platform that mines traces for failures, creates evals and runs them on every change.

evals & testing.title: Agents claim success without end-to-end verification
evals & testing.problem: Agents say work is verified without proof, and developers lack evidence such as screenshots and live-app runs, especially for UI.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Playwright, screenshot diffs, recorded test videos, curl exercises
evals & testing.opportunity: Build agent-driven QA that runs the full stack and records pass/fail evidence.

evals & testing.title: Agent-written tests are weak or silently weakened
evals & testing.problem: Agents write trivial, mocked or flawed tests and weaken tests to pass, so verification is shallow.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Separate test-writing agents, mutation testing, nightly low-signal pruning
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a test-quality auditor with mutation checks and immutable, spec-derived tests.

evals & testing.title: Specs and conformance suites as guardrails for coding agents
evals & testing.problem: Developers need contracts, tests and conformance suites to keep agents correct and verify ports or rewrites.
evals & testing.current_solutions: TDD, conformance suites, Alloy/Forge, property-based testing, formal rules
evals & testing.opportunity: Package spec-first workflows with deterministic verifiers and conformance runs.

evals & testing.title: Verifying AI-generated code beyond line-by-line review
evals & testing.problem: Generated code volume outpaces human review, and agents misreport what they did.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Holdout scenario tests, Antithesis, linters, per-PR environments, sampled human review
evals & testing.opportunity: Build verification tooling that checks agent output and claims independently.

evals & testing.title: Cross-model review compensates for weak self-review
evals & testing.problem: A model reviewing its own output tends to confirm it, so developers use other models and multiple passes.
evals & testing.who: developers using AI code and text
evals & testing.current_solutions: Multi-model councils, second-model review, linters and fuzzers
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a multi-model review tool that shows disagreements and combines static analysis.

evals & testing.title: Test doubles and API emulators for agent testing
evals & testing.problem: Tests need deterministic stand-ins for external services and realistic data without live backends or rate limits.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Offline Stripe emulator, Antithesis, StrongDM digital twins, spec-first mocks
evals & testing.opportunity: Build stateful emulators of common third-party APIs for CI and agent testing.

evals & testing.title: Simulated users and synthetic scenarios for agent testing
evals & testing.problem: Teams need many realistic scenarios and simulated users without production data, and multi-turn agent evals are fragile.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Arksim, Shopify SimGym, mock users, fault injection, user simulators
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a service generating synthetic users and scenarios from production traces.

evals & testing.title: Agent reliability is hidden behind single success rates
evals & testing.problem: Accuracy hides inconsistency, fragility and drift across repeated runs.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Repeated runs, reliability dashboards, Holistic Agent Leaderboard
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a tool running repeated multi-condition trials that reports reliability dimensions.

evals & testing.title: Hallucination and abstention are poorly measured
evals & testing.problem: Models guess instead of abstaining, and accuracy scores hide hallucination rates.
evals & testing.current_solutions: AA-Omniscience hallucination metric, multi-model cross-checks
evals & testing.opportunity: Build hallucination-aware eval reporting abstention and wrong-answer rates.

evals & testing.title: Checking AI output for factual errors is manual
evals & testing.problem: Fabricated citations, claims and analyses look plausible and must be verified by hand.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Citation fact-check agents, Chain-of-Verification, model councils, manual reading
evals & testing.opportunity: Build domain-specific verifiers linking claims to sources and flagging fabrications.

evals & testing.title: Model confidence is poorly calibrated
evals & testing.problem: Verbalized and classifier confidence cannot be taken literally, and metrics reward uninformative predictions.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Temperature scaling, calibration steps, threshold tuning
evals & testing.opportunity: Build calibration tooling comparing predicted confidence to observed rates.

evals & testing.title: Verifying AI-generated math proofs and claims
evals & testing.problem: AI produces convincing proofs faster than experts can check, and claims lack attempted-versus-solved counts.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Lean formalization, adversarial checking agents, manual verification
evals & testing.opportunity: Build tools to formalize, triage and verify proofs and track attempted versus solved.

evals & testing.title: AI-text detection is unreliable and evadable
evals & testing.problem: Detectors give false positives, miss blended or edited text, and provide no graded signal.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Pangram, Wikipedia's AI-writing signs list
evals & testing.opportunity: Build detectors robust to blending and obfuscation with calibrated, explained confidence.

evals & testing.title: Measuring quality loss from quantization and compression
evals & testing.problem: Perplexity hides failures in quantized or modified local models, and speed claims are inconsistent.
evals & testing.current_solutions: KL divergence, llama.cpp perplexity, OpenCompass, personal quant benchmarks
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a reproducible quant-quality suite reporting KLD, task accuracy and long-context impact.

evals & testing.title: Domain-specific agent and model benchmarks are thin
evals & testing.problem: Legal, medical, finance, speech and multimodal evals lack realistic data and baselines.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Harvey LAB, Legora environments, ITBench-AA, iOSWorld, Terminal-Bench Science
evals & testing.opportunity: Build expert-validated domain benchmark suites with realistic environments.

evals & testing.title: Scientific benchmarks and validation have gaps
evals & testing.problem: Science and drug-discovery data contain confounds and are scarce, and wet-lab validation is slow.
evals & testing.current_solutions: OpenBind, cutoff-date PDB splits, Replica
evals & testing.opportunity: Build curated, confound-checked scientific benchmark and validation services.

evals & testing.title: Robot and physical AI evals lack real-world fidelity
evals & testing.problem: Simulations are too clean and sim-to-real validation is slow and costly.
evals & testing.current_solutions: CaP-Gym, neural simulation, interactive world models
evals & testing.opportunity: Build sim-to-real validation with injected real-world messiness.

evals & testing.title: Soft qualities and non-verifiable tasks lack benchmarks
evals & testing.problem: Writing, empathy, taste and open-ended research have no cheap objective judge, and AI judges favor AI writing.
evals & testing.current_solutions: EQBench, human rater rubrics, LLM judges
evals & testing.opportunity: Build reproducible evals and rubric-grading tools for subjective traits.

evals & testing.title: Prompt and skill optimization lacks eval rigor
evals & testing.problem: Prompts, instruction files and skills are tuned by vibes and degrade silently across models.
evals & testing.current_solutions: DSPy, GEPA, skill test-and-rewrite loops
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a harness that A/B tests prompt and skill changes with metrics.

evals & testing.title: Models are sensitive to prompt wording and drift from instructions
evals & testing.problem: Small wording changes shift answers and models miss explicit constraints.
evals & testing.current_solutions: promptfoo, strict output formats, paired-prompt evals
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a tester generating paraphrase variants and scoring stability.

evals & testing.title: Sycophancy and pushback are poorly measured
evals & testing.problem: Models fold under pressure, and evals give mixed or selectively framed results.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Opposite-Narrator Contradictions, automated behavioral audits
evals & testing.opportunity: Build controlled sycophancy and deference test suites.

evals & testing.title: Alignment audits and behavioral probing lack rigor
evals & testing.problem: Automated audits are gameable proxies, and model welfare and self-reports are unreliable.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Petri, Anthropic Bloom, emotion probes, prefill sampling, interviews
evals & testing.opportunity: Build open audit tooling scanning transcripts and standardizing behavioral scores.

evals & testing.title: Chain-of-thought monitorability is hard to measure
evals & testing.problem: Action-only monitors miss reasoning, and CoT can be pressured or encoded.
evals & testing.current_solutions: CoT monitorability suite, paraphrase retraining
evals & testing.opportunity: Build tools testing reasoning-trace faithfulness and a standard trace format.

evals & testing.title: Red-teaming and prompt-injection testing is static
evals & testing.problem: Guardrails fail under varied attacks, and benchmarks understate real injection success.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Gray Swan Shade, rainbow teaming, hackai.lol CTF
evals & testing.opportunity: Offer adaptive red-teaming and private arenas.

evals & testing.title: Measuring offensive cyber capability
evals & testing.problem: Cyber evals lack reproducibility and are distorted by refusals and contamination.
evals & testing.current_solutions: ExploitGym, EVMbench, UK AISI cyber ranges
evals & testing.opportunity: Build reproducible cyber harnesses with outcome-based grading.

evals & testing.title: AI vulnerability reports contain many false positives
evals & testing.problem: AI security tools flag non-exploitable vulnerabilities.
evals & testing.opportunity: Build triage tools that verify exploitability of reported vulnerabilities.

evals & testing.title: Benchmarks of real economic work and productivity
evals & testing.problem: Scores do not map to completed work, dollar outcomes or labor cost, and productivity studies are untrustworthy.
evals & testing.current_solutions: GDPval, Vending-Bench, AA-Briefcase
evals & testing.opportunity: Build independent real-work benchmarks measuring outcomes by domain.

evals & testing.title: Measuring AI R&D and self-improvement ability
evals & testing.problem: The science of tracking AI R&D automation is immature.
evals & testing.current_solutions: PostTrainBench, PaperBench, MLE-Bench
evals & testing.opportunity: Build benchmarks for agent-driven research.

evals & testing.title: AI evaluation studies have weak methodology
evals & testing.problem: Studies are small, mislabeled or rigged toward AI, and contested benchmarks like ARC-AGI are hard to interpret.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Provenance checklists, many runs with controls
evals & testing.opportunity: Offer methodology checklists and statistical tooling.

evals & testing.title: Jagged capability makes delegation unpredictable
evals & testing.problem: Uneven capability means users cannot tell when to trust AI.
evals & testing.opportunity: Build tools that map model strengths and weaknesses per task.

evals & testing.title: Long-context evals are weak
evals & testing.problem: Long-context ability degrades in practice and compaction-heavy evals are missing.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Needle-in-a-haystack tests
evals & testing.opportunity: Build long-context benchmarks with compaction and multi-step retrieval.

evals & testing.title: Evaluating model routers and orchestration
evals & testing.problem: Routing quality lacks transparent baselines and costs.
evals & testing.current_solutions: AI judges on sampled traffic
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a continuous router benchmark.

evals & testing.title: Tracking AI forecasts against outcomes
evals & testing.problem: Forecasts are hard to score and predictions go untracked.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Reciprocal scoring
evals & testing.opportunity: Build a tracker scoring AI predictions.

hardware & compute.title: GPU instability and random reboots under LLM load
hardware & compute.problem: Consumer GPUs such as the RTX 3090 hard-reboot or crash under sustained LLM load, and users stabilize them by trial and error.
hardware & compute.who: local LLM users running consumer NVIDIA GPUs
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Disabling GSP firmware, undervolting and underclocking.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a diagnostic and auto-tuning utility that detects power or firmware instability and applies safe stability profiles.

hardware & compute.title: Power limiting and undervolting GPUs for local inference
hardware & compute.problem: High-end GPUs spike in power, run hot and draw a lot, and users need to cut power without losing much throughput. Knowledge of safe settings is scattered.
hardware & compute.who: local inference users with high-end GPUs
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Undervolting, power limiting an RTX 5090, low-draw Macs on solar.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Offer a tool that profiles tokens/sec versus watts per model and GPU and recommends power limits.

hardware & compute.title: Multi-GPU home rig building: power, cooling, PCIe, noise
hardware & compute.problem: Dense consumer multi-GPU rigs require hand-solving PSU sync, power delivery, airflow, noise, PCIe lanes and household power limits, with little guidance.
hardware & compute.who: hobbyists and homelab builders of multi-GPU inference rigs
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Risers, splitters, MCIO bifurcation adapters, PSU sync devices, water cooling, open-air builds, repasting, power capping, airflow tuning, single-slot waterblocks.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Create a rig planner and monitor that checks PSU, PCIe, thermal, noise and home-circuit constraints and suggests parts lists.

hardware & compute.title: Mixed and multi-GPU inference is slow and buggy
hardware & compute.problem: Splitting models across multiple or mixed GPUs often gives lower throughput than one card, and PCIe limits, uneven VRAM and driver quirks cause crashes. Users lack guidance on what works.
hardware & compute.who: local LLM users with multi-GPU or mixed-generation setups
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Removing the slower card, dual-channel RAM, heterogeneous layer/expert placement, switching Linux distributions, Vulkan or LM Studio splitting.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a benchmarking and auto-configuration advisor that detects PCIe topology and VRAM balance and finds the best split.

hardware & compute.title: Pooling home machines into shared compute
hardware & compute.problem: People with several PCs or limited hardware want to pool compute without cloud costs.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a scheduler that distributes jobs across home machines by VRAM and availability, optionally pooled in a cooperative.

hardware & compute.title: Cheap GPU cloud rental and compute brokerage
hardware & compute.problem: Developers and small teams struggle to get affordable, available GPU capacity and want cheaper options than hyperscalers with clearer pricing.
hardware & compute.who: developers, small AI teams and builders needing GPUs
hardware & compute.current_solutions: NeoCloudX, Spheron AI, Voltage, neocloud brokers, Kaggle/Colab credits, Runpod, community GPU pools, SF-Tensor orchestration.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build an aggregator or broker with unified pricing, availability search, and scheduling across cloud and homebrew GPUs.

hardware & compute.title: Open protocols and hybrid setups for compute pooling
hardware & compute.problem: Compute is siloed across providers, and teams with owned bare metal need networking and orchestration to burst to clouds.
hardware & compute.who: compute providers and teams owning GPU data centers
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Supercloud pooling, owned data centers with network overlay across clouds.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build an open exchange protocol and hybrid orchestration tooling for spare and owned compute.

hardware & compute.title: Rent-vs-buy and hardware choice for local AI
hardware & compute.problem: Buyers can't tell which local AI hardware to buy, whether it beats renting cloud GPUs or APIs, and how it will perform for their workloads.
hardware & compute.who: people considering buying local AI hardware
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Renting first, refurbished servers, used 3090s, retired datacenter GPUs, DIY servers, OpenRouter, forum advice.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build an advisor with cost calculators, rental trials and load-testing that models workload, privacy and budget.

hardware & compute.title: Affordable high-memory hardware for local models
hardware & compute.problem: Consumer GPUs have too little VRAM for modern models while datacenter parts are overpriced, leaving no cheap high-memory local option.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Intel Arc Pro B70, multi-card builds, Strix Halo, Mac Studio clusters, high-memory Macs, DGX Spark, modded GPUs.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Offer a prosumer workstation or kit with large memory and high bandwidth in the $3-5k range.

hardware & compute.title: RAM and GPU price spikes hurt hardware buyers
hardware & compute.problem: AI demand has driven up DRAM, storage and GPU prices, making upgrades and local rigs unaffordable and pushing people to cloud.
hardware & compute.who: DIY builders, local-model users, small projects
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Buying used or refurbished parts, switching to cloud inference.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a price tracker and alert service with used-hardware sourcing guides.

hardware & compute.title: Cheap used and modded GPUs for VRAM
hardware & compute.problem: Users buy old datacenter or modded GPUs for cheap VRAM but face sourcing, reliability and software-support risks.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Tesla V100/P40, modded 3080/4090 cards, pooled homelab VRAM, software-simulated FP8.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a vetted marketplace or compatibility database with benchmarks for used and modded cards.

hardware & compute.title: DGX Spark and unified-memory boxes limited by bandwidth
hardware & compute.problem: Desktop AI boxes like DGX Spark and Macs have large memory but low bandwidth and weak CPUs, so dense models run slower than the price implies.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Using MoE models, waiting for M5 matmul accelerators, returning hardware, porting kernels, Unsloth support.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Publish a benchmark and prediction service for realistic tokens/sec by machine and model before purchase.

hardware & compute.title: AMD ROCm and consumer Radeon software gaps
hardware & compute.problem: AMD GPUs suffer from lockups, failed builds, missing features, poor packaging and sparse benchmarks, pushing developers to CUDA.
hardware & compute.who: developers and users running AI on AMD GPUs
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Specific VBIOS flashes, disabling VFIO, preview drivers, env-var workarounds, picomon, Strix Halo prefill optimizations.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Provide prebuilt tested ROCm distributions plus a compatibility and benchmark matrix with setup recipes.

hardware & compute.title: AMD MI300X multi-GPU communication tooling
hardware & compute.problem: Collectives on MI300X lag RCCL for small messages while DMA offload and symmetric memory are immature.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: DMA collectives, ROCm/iris symmetric memory.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build libraries and benchmarks for efficient multi-GPU communication on AMD hardware.

hardware & compute.title: Blackwell and CUDA kernel/tooling friction
hardware & compute.problem: New NVIDIA architectures, especially consumer Blackwell and DGX Spark, break existing kernels and tools, with silent kernel selection and missing support.
hardware & compute.who: kernel and inference engineers on new NVIDIA hardware
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Rewriting kernels for tcgen05, ThunderKittens, CuTeDSL, MXFP8 on 5090s, custom engines, Flash Attention wheels.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build tooling, containers and kernel libraries that detect silent regressions and make Blackwell consumer hardware work.

hardware & compute.title: GPU monitoring and profiling numbers are unreliable
hardware & compute.problem: Profilers and monitors report misleading bandwidth and utilization, and users misread GPU load.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: NCU, sm__cycles_active metrics, Open Hardware Monitor, renting third-party GPUs to check.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a profiling and benchmarking tool that reports honest utilization and bandwidth across GPUs.

hardware & compute.title: GPU kernel programming barriers and opaque build errors
hardware & compute.problem: Writing GPU kernels is hard, especially on non-CUDA stacks, and builds and competition submissions fail with opaque errors.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Reverse engineering, emulators like Remu and NaviSim, CUDA Tile, CuTeDSL, puzzle channels.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build educational and portability tooling plus a kernel sandbox with clear build diagnostics.

hardware & compute.title: Counting and verifying actual GPU and data center capacity
hardware & compute.problem: Nobody can reliably tell how many GPUs are deployed and operating versus warehoused, and public data is sparse.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Satellite and public-records tracking of data center construction.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a dataset of GPU deployments and data center capacity from satellite, permits and power filings.

hardware & compute.title: Chip location verification for export control
hardware & compute.problem: Export controls are weakly enforced and smuggling is easy, driving demand for technical verification of chip location.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Ping-based latency and GPU telemetry checks; proposed Chip Security Act.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Develop hardware or firmware geolocation attestation for AI accelerators.

hardware & compute.title: Data center power and grid constraints
hardware & compute.problem: AI data center buildouts are limited by power availability, turbine and transformer backlogs and grid connections.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: On-site gas turbines, diesel generators, reciprocating and aero engines.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Offer tooling for power-site planning and on-site generation for data center projects.

hardware & compute.title: Community opposition and permitting for data centers
hardware & compute.problem: Data center expansion faces community opposition, permitting delays and labor shortages, with little organized support for those resisting.
hardware & compute.who: local organizers and data center developers
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Moving data centers overseas.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build tools for organizers to track proposals and share evidence on impacts.

hardware & compute.title: AI compute economics, financing and overbuild worries
hardware & compute.problem: It is unclear whether huge GPU investments will pay back, how fast chips depreciate, and whether demand supports the buildout.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Older chips kept in service for inference.

hardware & compute.title: Compute scarcity limiting labs and academia
hardware & compute.problem: Compute is scarce and concentrated, constraining labs, universities and Chinese labs under chip restrictions.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Donated compute, national lab allocations, Huawei Ascend, 4-bit training formats.

hardware & compute.title: Alternatives to NVIDIA: TPUs, ASICs and custom silicon
hardware & compute.problem: Teams weigh non-NVIDIA accelerators but software maturity, supply and lead times lag.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Google TPUs, Trainium, Cerebras, Groq, Ascend, Maia, Tenstorrent.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Offer accessible alternative accelerators with mature software stacks.

hardware & compute.title: Memory-efficient and in-memory inference hardware
hardware & compute.problem: LLM inference is bottlenecked by data movement and expensive HBM, so people explore compute-in-memory, baked-in weights, and cheaper memory tiers.
hardware & compute.who: hardware researchers and cost-constrained inference builders
hardware & compute.current_solutions: IBM NorthPole, Taalas, FPGAs, Optane with llama.cpp offload, many-channel DDR4 Xeons, Engram-style RAM tables.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build inference software exploiting tiered memory with deterministic access patterns to run huge models on cheap hardware.

hardware & compute.title: Running huge open-weight models locally
hardware & compute.problem: Multi-trillion-parameter open models are hard to download, store and run locally given storage, I/O and memory limits.
hardware & compute.who: local users of large MoE models
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Mac Studio clusters, expert offload to DDR, fast external storage.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build tools that plan hardware and memory budgets for large MoE models, including context overhead.

hardware & compute.title: Isolated hardware for running AI agents safely
hardware & compute.problem: Agents can damage a main machine, and sandboxing on Macs or with GPUs is awkward or restricted.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Dedicated Mac Minis, repurposed phone servers.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Offer sandboxed agent environments with GPU access that avoid Mac licensing limits.

hardware & compute.title: Robot actuators overheat and hardware is brittle
hardware & compute.problem: Robot motors, hands and power systems overheat, wear out and lack graceful shutdown, and demos hide the reliability gap.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Ice bags to cool hands, field-swappable motors, simple gearboxes, wheeled bases, open-source kits.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Provide thermal and power monitoring, safe-shutdown firmware and modular repairable actuator kits.

hardware & compute.title: Robot dexterity and manipulation data collection
hardware & compute.problem: Robots lack dexterous control, and real-world manipulation data with tactile and egocentric capture is scarce.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Tactile gloves like OSMO, IMU gloves, teleoperation, egocentric human video.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build low-cost tactile and pose-sensing gloves and an open dataset platform for demonstrations.

hardware & compute.title: Standard interfaces connecting agents to hardware and robots
hardware & compute.problem: No common protocol connects AI agents to lab equipment and robots, and developers want an open programmable robot platform.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard, Fauna Sprout with ROS 2 and MCP server, Reachy Mini.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build adapters and middleware exposing instruments and robots via a standard agent protocol.

hardware & compute.title: Consumer RTX tensor throughput unlock risks
hardware & compute.problem: Consumer GPU throughput is capped by fuses and unlocks rely on driver vulnerabilities, with uncertain gains.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Patching kernels to unlock BF16.

hardware & compute.title: Phone local LLMs capped by RAM, battery and heat
hardware & compute.problem: Mobile devices cannot run larger local models because of RAM, battery and thermal limits.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Custom Vulkan kernels, multi-device clusters, tiny models on microcontrollers.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a runtime that shards models across nearby phones and PCs and manages thermal and battery limits.

hardware & compute.title: Network and interconnect bottlenecks in training and serving
hardware & compute.problem: Interconnect and networking throughput limit large-scale training and decode, and KV cache transfer needs faster links.
hardware & compute.who: teams running large training and serving clusters
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Heterogeneous prefill/decode chips, NVMe-over-Fabrics filesystems.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build interconnect and KV-transfer software that reduces serving latency.

hardware & compute.title: GPU cluster health monitoring and bad-hardware cohorts
hardware & compute.problem: Clusters suffer NVLink degradation, RoCE pause-frame stalls, firmware lockouts and defective batches, and buyers lack visibility.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: dmesg XID counters, pause-frame monitoring, UEFI reflashing.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a cluster health and provenance dashboard tracking hardware cohort, firmware and error counters.

hardware & compute.title: Semiconductor fab and packaging capacity bottleneck
hardware & compute.problem: Fab capacity, lithography and packaging limit AI chip supply for years.

hardware & compute.title: Environmental impact of AI data centers
hardware & compute.problem: Data centers consume large amounts of energy and water and rely on natural gas, raising sustainability concerns.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Tech-firm financing for water and decarbonization.

hardware & compute.title: Warehouse and delivery robots need grounded perception
hardware & compute.problem: Counting and packaging in warehouses and last-mile delivery need perception grounded in visible evidence, and rigid automation misses variable items.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Vision-language-action models, multi-camera scanning setups.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a vision-based inventory counting and barcode capture system grounded in visible evidence.

hardware & compute.title: Off-road and industrial autonomy needs perception beyond GPS
hardware & compute.problem: Mining, agriculture and trucking rely on RTK GPS and hand-coded paths, generic car autonomy doesn't transfer, and lidar adds cost.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Lidar R&D vehicles distilled into camera-only models.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build perception and autonomy stacks tailored to industrial vehicles.

hardware & compute.title: Cheap counter-drone defense against FPV and long-range drones
hardware & compute.problem: Jammers and lasers are weak or too expensive against swarms of cheap FPV drones, and long-range drones threaten bases.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Jammers, lasers, early warning, active defense drones.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build cheap, mass-producible interceptors and man-portable counter-drone systems.

hardware & compute.title: Lab instruments are bottlenecks for science data
hardware & compute.problem: Imaging, measurement and weighing hardware limit throughput in biology and materials work.
hardware & compute.current_solutions: Pooled sample testing, advanced microscopy, custom hardware.
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build high-throughput lab automation and measurement tools for AI-driven science.

hardware & compute.title: Compile natural-language functions to offline CPU artifacts
hardware & compute.problem: Developers want to specify a function in English, compile it once, and run it locally on CPU offline.
hardware & compute.who: developers wanting offline small AI functions
hardware & compute.opportunity: Build a compiler that turns natural-language function specs into small CPU-runnable artifacts.

inference & infra.title: Same model varies in quality across inference providers
inference & infra.problem: The same model differs in speed, quality, quantization and tool-call behavior across hosts and aggregators, and providers rarely publish benchmarks or serving configs. Users can't tell what they are really getting.
inference & infra.who: developers and teams using OpenRouter or third-party hosted open models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Pinning a provider, Kimi vendor verifier, Artificial Analysis benchmarks, falling back to first-party APIs, self-hosting
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a continuous independent benchmarking service that tests provider endpoints for fidelity, speed, tool-call correctness and feature support and publishes results.

inference & infra.title: Silent quality drift and quantization on hosted models
inference & infra.problem: Users suspect providers swap in quantized or weaker models under load or after checkpoint changes, and can't verify it. Identical weights behave differently across clusters.
inference & infra.who: teams relying on hosted LLM APIs in production
inference & infra.current_solutions: Manual spot checks, shadow traffic testing, moving to local models
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer a black-box canary monitor running fixed probes over time to flag quality, time-of-day and quantization drift.

inference & infra.title: LLM provider outages and gateway errors need failover
inference & infra.problem: Provider and aggregator outages, 5xx/4xx errors, timeouts and missing retries break production apps, and fallback logic is often unreliable. Developers can't tell whether the provider or the platform is at fault.
inference & infra.who: developers running production apps on hosted LLM APIs and gateways such as OpenRouter
inference & infra.current_solutions: Manual provider switching, direct provider APIs, paid keys, hand-coded fallbacks, OpenRouter fallback
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a resilient gateway layer with health checks, automatic retry and failover, spillover protection and clear error diagnostics.

inference & infra.title: Cloudflare outages cascade into AI services
inference & infra.problem: Cloudflare outages take down AI tools and APIs, with some OpenRouter requests failing on Cloudflare connection errors. Users have no easy fallback.
inference & infra.who: AI API providers and their users
inference & infra.current_solutions: Searching for alternate platforms and free options
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer multi-CDN or edge-redundant front doors and status-aware routing for AI API traffic.

inference & infra.title: Frontier API capacity shortages, rate limits and vanishing free tiers
inference & infra.problem: Demand outpaces compute, so providers throttle, cut limits, pause plans and shrink free tiers. Users can't predict access.
inference & infra.who: developers and heavy users of frontier and free-tier APIs
inference & infra.current_solutions: OpenRouter with BYOK, waiting out limits, off-peak retries, local models, pay-as-you-go aggregators, OpenAI Guaranteed Capacity
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer capacity-aware quota pooling, forecasting and scheduling across providers, or capacity reservation brokerage.

inference & infra.title: Routing each task to the cheapest capable model
inference & infra.problem: Teams want to send each request to the cheapest adequate model, but routers misjudge hard or non-verifiable tasks and have a poor track record.
inference & infra.who: teams and enterprises running LLM workloads at scale
inference & infra.current_solutions: Ramp router, OpenRouter, Not Diamond, LiteLLM auto routing, Cursor Router, semantic routers
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a difficulty-aware router using eval feedback and cost telemetry that escalates to bigger models and supports local/cloud splits.

inference & infra.title: Cheap fast classifiers and decision models instead of LLMs
inference & infra.problem: Full LLM calls for classification, routing and judgments add cost and latency. Teams want small models returning typed decisions or probabilities.
inference & infra.who: developers building gating, judging and classification steps
inference & infra.current_solutions: Jev, SemIf, OpenAI Decision API, Flash-Lite, nano models, regexes and rules
inference & infra.opportunity: Provide a hosted low-latency classifier API returning calibrated probabilities, escalating to larger models only when confidence is low.

inference & infra.title: Unified gateway across many LLM providers
inference & infra.problem: Developers juggle separate keys and schemas, face lock-in, and gateways lack features like batch APIs, parameter remapping and modality coverage. Schemas differ across providers.
inference & infra.who: developers integrating many LLM providers
inference & infra.current_solutions: OpenRouter, LiteLLM, one-api/new-api, BitRouter, Ramp Router, OpenAI-compatible wrappers
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a secure OpenAI-compatible gateway with normalized schema, batch endpoints, parameter remapping, pooled credentials and conformance tests.

inference & infra.title: OpenRouter as unified gateway for new models
inference & infra.problem: Developers want one API to try many models including video models without separate integrations.
inference & infra.who: developers trying many models
inference & infra.current_solutions: OpenRouter, Fireworks, DeepInfra, Together AI, Replicate

inference & infra.title: Trust, fraud and data retention in inference gateways
inference & infra.problem: Cheap or free gateways and resellers raise fraud and logging concerns. Users want zero-retention terms and proof of which model ran.
inference & infra.who: privacy-conscious users of inference gateways
inference & infra.current_solutions: Ollama Cloud no-logging claim, OpenCode Go zero-retention terms, zero-knowledge verifiable inference
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a vetted zero-retention inference broker with auditable proof of model and data handling.

inference & infra.title: Speculative decoding is fragmented and hard to tune
inference & infra.problem: MTP, EAGLE-3, DFlash, DSpark and n-gram methods give speedups in some setups and slowdowns in others, with buggy or incomplete llama.cpp support and little guidance or fair benchmarks.
inference & infra.who: local and server LLM users wanting faster generation
inference & infra.current_solutions: MTP in llama-server, Luce DFlash, vLLM DSpark, ik_llama.cpp, GGUF surgery scripts, manual flag tuning
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a tool that auto-selects and tunes speculative method, draft model and MTP-enabled GGUFs, benchmarking real gains per model and hardware.

inference & infra.title: Training workload-specific draft models for serving
