inference & infra.problem: Production speculative decoding depends on well-trained draft models whose acceptance rates are hard to build and tune.
inference & infra.who: teams operating inference servers on vLLM or SGLang
inference & infra.current_solutions: DFlash, block-based speculation, live draft training, DSpark in vLLM, traffic-specific speculators
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer a service that trains and continuously tunes drafters on customer traffic and plugs into serving engines.

inference & infra.title: KV cache memory limits long-context inference
inference & infra.problem: KV cache memory limits context length and concurrency, and compression or quantization methods vary in real speed, quality and support.
inference & infra.who: operators of long-context and agent workloads on server and consumer GPUs
inference & infra.current_solutions: TurboQuant, KVarN, RotorQuant, DMS, MLA, FP8 KV, CPU offload, sparse attention
inference & infra.opportunity: Ship a drop-in KV compression and offload library with verified speed, memory and accuracy benchmarks across engines.

inference & infra.title: Cache-aware routing and prompt caching for repeated prefixes
inference & infra.problem: Repeated long prefixes get recomputed because routing isn't cache-aware, prompt caching is manual and inconsistent across providers and gateways, and agent prompts bust prefixes.
inference & infra.who: teams serving or paying for agent and long-context workloads
inference & infra.current_solutions: NVIDIA Dynamo, vLLM Router, SGLang HiCache, LMCache, session-sticky routing, manual cache_control
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a caching and routing layer that keeps sticky prefix routing, detects prefix-busting content and reports cache hit rates across providers.

inference & infra.title: Long-context reliability and cost make big windows impractical
inference & infra.problem: Quality degrades well below advertised windows, long contexts are expensive to serve, and users can't tell if sparse methods cut memory.
inference & infra.who: users and operators of long-running agents
inference & infra.current_solutions: Capping runs, prompt compression, context management, hybrid architectures
inference & infra.opportunity: Build context management and compression tooling that keeps sessions in a reliable range.

inference & infra.title: Sparse attention rarely reaches production serving
inference & infra.problem: Many sparse-attention papers exist but yield little real GPU speedup and are rarely adopted in vLLM-class stacks.
inference & infra.who: inference engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: IndexCache, QSInference, DeepSeek Sparse Attention
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a validated drop-in sparse-attention library with approximation guarantees.

inference & infra.title: Local inference is slow at prefill and long context
inference & infra.problem: Prompt processing, model loading and long-context decode are slow on Macs, CPUs, Strix Halo and consumer GPUs, and decode-only benchmarks hide it. Mac clustering tools are unmaintained.
inference & infra.who: local LLM users on Apple Silicon and consumer hardware
inference & infra.current_solutions: ANE-assisted prefill, Metal backends, MLX, RDMA over Thunderbolt, batch size tuning, LMCache
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a local runtime and profiler tuned for fast prefill, model switching and Mac clustering that reports TTFT as well as decode speed.

inference & infra.title: Running huge MoE models on consumer hardware
inference & infra.problem: Frontier open MoE models far exceed consumer VRAM and RAM, and users must tune offload and SSD streaming by hand, with CUDA-only or incomplete support.
inference & infra.who: local LLM enthusiasts wanting large open models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Flash-MoE SSD streaming, DwarfStar, llama.cpp offload flags, hot-expert caching, AirLLM, 2-bit quantization, Krasis
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a runtime that auto-tiers weights and experts across VRAM, RAM and SSD and reports realistic speeds.

inference & infra.title: Hardware-to-model fit and size estimation
inference & infra.problem: Users can't easily tell which models, quantizations and runtimes fit their GPU or instance.
inference & infra.who: local and cloud self-hosters
inference & infra.current_solutions: hf-mem VRAM estimator, mixed-precision quantization, llama.cpp suggestions
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a fit advisor that estimates VRAM, speed and quality from model metadata and recommends quantization and runtime.

inference & infra.title: Self-hosting open frontier models needs datacenter hardware
inference & infra.problem: Large open-weight MoE models need many high-bandwidth GPUs and far more memory than active parameters suggest, putting self-hosting out of reach for most.
inference & infra.who: teams wanting private deployments of large open models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Hosted providers
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer managed private deployments or packaged serving stacks for large open MoE models.

inference & infra.title: Local reasoning models too slow to replace hosted APIs
inference & infra.problem: Local 27B-class reasoning models run slowly and a single reasoning turn can take very long, widening the gap to hosted APIs.
inference & infra.who: users trying to replace hosted APIs with local models
inference & infra.current_solutions: MoE models with few active parameters, narrow C++/CUDA engines, DS4/DwarfStar
inference & infra.opportunity: Build optimized per-model local engines and benchmarks focused on end-to-end task time.

inference & infra.title: Multi-GPU and multi-machine local inference setup
inference & infra.problem: Pooling several machines or consumer GPUs is hampered by interconnect bandwidth, PCIe topology and missing NVLink, with little guidance and poor performance per dollar.
inference & infra.who: users pooling consumer GPUs or small teams sharing a cluster
inference & infra.current_solutions: Exo on Mac Minis, DwarfStar distributed inference, browser-based distributed runtimes
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a diagnostic and configuration tool that checks topology, sets up parallelism, and says honestly when pooling won't pay off.

inference & infra.title: Inference stacks beyond CUDA lack maturity
inference & infra.problem: AMD, Apple, Vulkan, TPU and other accelerators lag in software support, CUDA lock-in persists, and model portability needs heavy engineering.
inference & infra.who: users and builders on non-NVIDIA hardware
inference & infra.current_solutions: ZINC (Vulkan), DwarfStar, Docker Model Runner MLX, vLLM TPU, ROCm and Vulkan in llama.cpp, Lemonade, OpenVINO
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a portable lightweight serving engine and validation suite for non-CUDA hardware.

inference & infra.title: Non-NVIDIA accelerators lack mature software
inference & infra.problem: CUDA-compatible drivers and compilers are the bottleneck for alternative chips, and FPGAs and ASICs face memory and tape-out limits.
inference & infra.who: hardware vendors and buyers of alternative accelerators
inference & infra.current_solutions: TPUs, Trainium, custom lab chips, FPGA offload

inference & infra.title: Predictive prefill while the user types
inference & infra.problem: Local response latency can be cut by prefilling the KV cache and thinking ahead while the user is still typing.
inference & infra.who: local chat front-end users
inference & infra.current_solutions: MAFDET, speculative think-ahead with KV read-ahead
inference & infra.opportunity: Package predictive prefill as a plugin for local chat front-ends and inference servers.

inference & infra.title: Reasoning models overthink and lack effort control
inference & infra.problem: Reasoning models spend excessive hidden tokens, can't always be stopped, and many APIs expose coarse or undocumented effort controls, so real cost and latency rise.
inference & infra.who: developers and users of reasoning models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Effort settings, GPT-5.1 'none', Gemini thinking levels, system-prompt mitigations, client-side budgets
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a unified controller that picks or caps reasoning effort per task across providers and reports cost versus quality.

inference & infra.title: Verbose model output wastes tokens
inference & infra.problem: Verbal tics and verbose style add output tokens and cost.
inference & infra.who: API users paying per output token
inference & infra.current_solutions: Terse 'caveman' prompting
inference & infra.opportunity: Build an output-compression prompt layer or filter that trims filler without hurting quality.

inference & infra.title: Frontier models too slow for flow and agent loops
inference & infra.problem: Top models and tool calls are slow, fast modes carry steep premiums, and tokens per second ignores tool time and time-to-first-token. Slowness breaks flow and compounds across agent steps.
inference & infra.who: developers running coding agents and production AI apps
inference & infra.current_solutions: Opus fast mode, highspeed tiers, Codex-Spark, Cerebras, routing subagents to fast models, hybrid local/API
inference & infra.opportunity: Build end-to-end latency benchmarking and budgeting tools that mix fast and slow models.

inference & infra.title: Ultra-fast inference hardware and diffusion LLMs lack products
inference & infra.problem: Custom silicon and diffusion LLMs deliver very fast tokens, but there are few product paths, usable APIs, or clear pricing and capacity to exploit them.
inference & infra.who: engineers and product teams wanting near-instant inference
inference & infra.current_solutions: Taalas ASIC API, Cerebras, Groq, SambaNova, Mercury 2, Gemini Diffusion
inference & infra.opportunity: Build real-time apps and APIs designed around near-instant inference, including diffusion-LM interaction patterns like infilling.

inference & infra.title: Real-time voice agents need a unified low-latency stack
inference & infra.problem: Voice agents suffer from latency, separate STT/diarization/LLM vendors, and failures with accents, noise and cross-talk.
inference & infra.who: teams building voice agents
inference & infra.current_solutions: MultiTalker Parakeet, Gemini Live, dual-stream architectures, fast first-token models
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer a single real-time voice API combining streaming STT, diarization and fast LLM with robust noisy-audio handling.

inference & infra.title: GPU rental market is opaque, volatile and rigid
inference & infra.problem: Buyers can't see capacity, prices or terms, spot prices swing, capacity is sold in rigid contracts, and startups struggle to get small right-sized blocks.
inference & infra.who: startups and teams renting GPUs
inference & infra.current_solutions: GPU marketplaces, interruptible leases, short-term rentals, Runpod serverless, informal recommendations
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a GPU price index and marketplace with standardized grades, right-sized per-minute access and pooled flexible capacity.

inference & infra.title: AI datacenter financing, overbuild and demand risk
inference & infra.problem: Commentary questions debt-financed buildout, GPU depreciation, neocloud profitability and whether demand and pricing are sustainable.
inference & infra.who: investors and industry observers

inference & infra.title: Compute supply limited by power and construction
inference & infra.problem: AI capacity is constrained by power, grid equipment, memory, slow construction and local opposition rather than chips alone.
inference & infra.who: industry observers and capacity buyers
inference & infra.current_solutions: Spreading compute across multiple providers, leasing Colossus capacity

inference & infra.title: Rising API prices and tight subscription quotas
inference & infra.problem: Providers raise prices, shrink cache discounts and cap quotas, so users lose the low-cost advantage.
inference & infra.who: heavy API and subscription users
inference & infra.current_solutions: Cheaper providers, bring-your-own-key platforms

inference & infra.title: Debugging multi-GPU NCCL hangs and collective performance
inference & infra.problem: NCCL hangs, launch skew and slow collectives are hard to diagnose in distributed training and inference, with little tooling.
inference & infra.who: distributed training and multi-GPU inference engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: nccl-skew-analyzer on nsys dumps, Penny, YALI, NCCLX
inference & infra.opportunity: Build diagnostics that analyze traces and pinpoint collective skew, hangs and communication bottlenecks.

inference & infra.title: Collective communication and training goodput inefficiency
inference & infra.problem: AllReduce and all-gather run below theory, and large training runs lose throughput to failures, imbalanced pipelines and slow collectives.
inference & infra.who: frontier training teams
inference & infra.current_solutions: YALI, FiCCO, elastic data parallelism, virtual pipeline parallelism, NVRAR

inference & infra.title: Pooling and orchestrating compute for training and RL
inference & infra.problem: Startups lack large contiguous compute, and RL post-training needs heterogeneous trainer, rollout and CPU orchestration, bursty load and fast weight sync that Slurm fits poorly.
inference & infra.who: startups and labs running RL post-training
inference & infra.current_solutions: Vendor-agnostic schedulers, Kubernetes parallel experiments, delta weight sync, vLLM IsoExec
inference & infra.opportunity: Build orchestration that pools GPUs across clouds and handles heterogeneous RL services, elastic sandboxes and numerics parity.

inference & infra.title: Serverless GPU and cold starts for bursty inference
inference & infra.problem: Autoscalers and Kubernetes suit steady CPU work, not bursty GPU loads with large model loads and cold starts. Developers want simple, cheap deployment.
inference & infra.who: developers hosting custom models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Modal, Runpod Flash, Koyeb, Auto Endpoints, GPU snapshotting, queue-depth autoscaling
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a simple GPU hosting product with fast cold starts, checkpointing and queue-based autoscaling.

inference & infra.title: Self-hosting LLMs versus API cost and privacy
inference & infra.problem: People self-host open models for lower cost and privacy, but setup is heavy and it's unclear when it pays off.
inference & infra.who: teams and individuals weighing self-hosting against APIs
inference & infra.current_solutions: vLLM on 3090s, rented GPUs with SSH tunnels, Modal guides, used-GPU servers, GLM on B200
inference & infra.opportunity: Provide turnkey self-hosting kits with calculators comparing cost against hosted APIs.

inference & infra.title: Production gateways and shared servers for self-hosted LLMs
inference & infra.problem: Self-hosted engines lack per-user keys, quotas, queues, routing, observability, batching and model swap management for home or team servers.
inference & infra.who: teams and households running shared self-hosted LLM servers
inference & infra.current_solutions: Custom Python gateway with Grafana, vLLM Router, LiteLLM with Prometheus, LM Studio headless, llama.cpp load balancing
inference & infra.opportunity: Build an off-the-shelf gateway with auth, quotas, queues, concurrency limits and dashboards for self-hosted inference.

inference & infra.title: Secure fast sandboxes for AI agents
inference & infra.problem: Agents running untrusted code need fast-starting isolated environments with snapshots and persistent state, while weak isolation and exposed endpoints allow escapes and secret theft.
inference & infra.who: teams running agents, RL and evals
inference & infra.current_solutions: Firecracker microVMs, Modal snapshots, Koyeb and Cloudflare sandboxes, Sprites, DeepSeek DSec
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a managed or self-hostable sandbox service with microVM isolation, egress controls, fast snapshot restore and resizing.

inference & infra.title: Cheap hosting for agent-built apps and non-technical builders
inference & infra.problem: Agents and non-technical builders need always-on hosting and disposable environments, but fixed per-agent VMs are costly and hyperscaler deployment is complex.
inference & infra.who: agent users, non-technical builders and AI app developers
inference & infra.current_solutions: boat VMs, here.now, Sprites, Railway templates, Cloudflare Workers, VPS setups, Modal
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer low-cost instant-deploy hosting with snapshotting and scale-to-zero for AI-built apps.

inference & infra.title: GPU kernel programming is hard and error-prone
inference & infra.problem: Writing kernels in CUDA, CuTe, Triton and Mojo hits bank conflicts, numerics bugs, silent correctness failures, poor docs and clumsy benchmarking, and timing harnesses mislead.
inference & infra.who: GPU kernel authors and inference engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: Helion autotuning, CuTeDSL, cuTile, Nsight profiling, popcorn-cli, Hugging Face Kernels
inference & infra.opportunity: Build kernel authoring, debugging and testing tools that check outputs against references, flag silent divergence and give trustworthy benchmarks.

inference & infra.title: AI-automated GPU kernel generation and optimization
inference & infra.problem: LLM agents can write and tune kernels and serving stacks, but results may not reproduce, carry stability risks and need expert validation. Porting across hardware is manual.
inference & infra.who: inference engineers and chip vendors
inference & infra.current_solutions: KernelEvolve, Kernelbot, FlashInfer-Bench, TritonForge, agentic RL kernel writing, Hugging Face Kernel Hub
inference & infra.opportunity: Build an agentic kernel-tuning and porting service with reproducible benchmarks and correctness verification.

inference & infra.title: No interchangeable kernel backends or reproducible environments
inference & infra.problem: Swapping optimized kernels across backends is manual, library performance is path-dependent and exact version pins are needed for reproducibility.
inference & infra.who: inference and kernel engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: Hugging Face Kernels repo type
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a kernel registry and performance regression tracker across hardware backends.

inference & infra.title: Tinygrad stack missing ops and backends
inference & infra.problem: Tinygrad lacks fast scatter, a CPU SIMD backend and formal benchmarks, with batch-size limits in some models.
inference & infra.who: tinygrad users
inference & infra.current_solutions: Tinybox benchmarks
inference & infra.opportunity: Contribute missing ops, an ISPC backend and benchmarks to tinygrad.

inference & infra.title: Modular MAX and Mojo framework gaps
inference & infra.problem: MAX lacks BERT and dense Qwen3-VL, has slow embeddings, startup failures, GPU bugs and missing language features, limiting adoption.
inference & infra.who: developers evaluating Modular MAX
inference & infra.current_solutions: Python bridging for heterogeneous graphs, MEF reuse, Modal integration
inference & infra.opportunity: Fill MAX gaps such as BERT, embedding throughput and fallback matmul kernels.

inference & infra.title: New architectures and open models lack day-0 serving
inference & infra.problem: Hybrid, linear, diffusion-style and giant MoE models ship with immature kernels and bare weights, so quantizations, speculators and serving support lag by days or weeks.
inference & infra.who: teams adopting newly released open models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Day-0 vLLM and SGLang support, partner patches, Together, Fireworks, Baseten, FlashQLA, Hopper-tuned FP8 checkpoints
inference & infra.opportunity: Build tooling that automates new-architecture kernels, quantization and hosted endpoints for day-0 releases.

inference & infra.title: Quantization quality loss and tooling gaps
inference & infra.problem: Quantization causes unexpected accuracy loss, silent breakage on MoE, uneven module support and FP8 slowdowns, and quality metrics conflict, making formats hard to choose.
inference & infra.who: engineers quantizing models for serving or local use
inference & infra.current_solutions: Unsloth dynamic quants, torchao, llmcompressor, GPTQModel, ModelOpt, Feather, INT4-to-NVFP4
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a quantization evaluator that measures per-layer quality, speed and size tradeoffs per hardware and flags silent degradation.

inference & infra.title: Inference stack deployment fragility and version breakage
inference & infra.problem: vLLM, LM Studio, PyTorch, CUDA and driver updates break installs and performance, with quant assertion errors, leaks and missing configs.
inference & infra.who: people deploying vLLM and local inference stacks
inference & infra.current_solutions: Pinning older CUDA, disabling DeepGemm or CUDA graphs, TRITON_PTXAS_PATH, portproxy for WSL, patches
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a preflight checker and compatibility-matrix service that detects and fixes version incompatibilities.

inference & infra.title: Choosing and benchmarking inference engines is confusing
inference & infra.problem: Many engines and hardware options make tuned performance hard to reach, and cross-engine benchmarks are unstable or not apples-to-apples. Learning resources are scarce.
inference & infra.who: engineers selecting local or server inference engines
inference & infra.current_solutions: vLLM recipes, mini-SGLang, DeepInfer, DwarfStar, Baseten's Inference Engineering book, switching to vLLM or SGLang
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a recommender and cross-engine benchmark tracker mapping model, hardware and workload to tuned configs.

inference & infra.title: Non-deterministic LLM inference outputs
inference & infra.problem: Floating-point reordering and kernel races make generations non-reproducible across hardware and clusters.
inference & infra.who: developers debugging or validating LLM outputs
inference & infra.current_solutions: Controlling seeds, hardware and precision, integer-arithmetic deterministic inference
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a deterministic inference mode or reproducibility verification tool.

inference & infra.title: Inference-side failures like token looping and routing bugs
inference & infra.problem: Models collapse into repeating tokens, graph bugs drop experts, and tool calls fail in serving stacks, silently degrading output.
inference & infra.who: operators of inference services
inference & infra.current_solutions: Inference-side detection and retries
inference & infra.opportunity: Build runtime monitors that detect looping, missing experts and failed tool calls, then retry or alert.

inference & infra.title: Crawler and bot traffic overloading websites
inference & infra.problem: AI crawlers drive heavy CPU and bandwidth load on page-heavy sites and traffic spikes break them.
inference & infra.who: website operators
inference & infra.current_solutions: Cloudflare caching, cheap VPS tunneling
inference & infra.opportunity: Build bot-mitigation and caching tools suited to dynamic page-heavy sites.

inference & infra.title: Image, video and audio generation too slow for real time
inference & infra.problem: Diffusion and sequential generation need many passes, making local generation take minutes to hours and real-time video or audio impractical, with memory limits for long generation.
inference & infra.who: users and builders of generative media apps
inference & infra.current_solutions: Step distillation, consistency models, Fal's optimized engine
inference & infra.opportunity: Build fast distilled generation serving and local runners with real-time context management.

inference & infra.title: Async and batch inference for cost savings
inference & infra.problem: Non-urgent workloads run at real-time prices, and providers and gateways offer limited batch options.
inference & infra.who: teams with latency-insensitive workloads
inference & infra.current_solutions: Async batch APIs, off-peak spot instances, routing to cheaper open models
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a scheduler and batch service that splits real-time and batch lanes and runs batches on idle or spot GPUs with failover.

inference & infra.title: Disaggregated and large-scale MoE serving operations
inference & infra.problem: Prefill/decode splits, KV transfers, wide expert parallelism and rigid topologies create network hotspots, scheduling complexity and hard-to-find configs.
inference & infra.who: operators of large-scale LLM serving
inference & infra.current_solutions: NVIDIA Dynamo, DeepSeek DualPath, wide expert parallelism on GB200 NVL72, SonicMoE
inference & infra.opportunity: Build tooling that auto-configures and benchmarks disaggregated and MoE serving topologies with elastic re-sharding.

inference & infra.title: CPU and orchestration limits for agent workloads
inference & infra.problem: Agent loops and managed agent workloads hit CPU limits, spiky load and orchestration that doesn't scale to thousands of workloads.
inference & infra.who: platforms running many agents
inference & infra.current_solutions: Replacing core Kubernetes pieces
inference & infra.opportunity: Build orchestration and capacity planning for spiky agent workloads.

inference & infra.title: Models deprecated or restricted without notice
inference & infra.problem: Providers remove models, restrict regions or plans, silently route models and change IDs with little warning, breaking workflows. Some users want older models preserved.
inference & infra.who: developers and users dependent on specific models
inference & infra.current_solutions: Migrating to alternate slugs, keeping two model versions live, mirroring repos
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a model availability and version-pinning tracker that alerts on deprecations and helps migrate, plus legacy model hosting.

inference & infra.title: Cheap near-frontier and open model tiers as cost cutters
inference & infra.problem: Teams want near-frontier quality at a fraction of the price using cheap tier models, fine-tuning or hosted open models, but need to know which fits each workload.
inference & infra.who: cost-conscious teams building AI apps
inference & infra.current_solutions: Gemini Flash, Haiku, DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM, Together and Fireworks fine-tuning, Tinker, hosted open-model providers
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a migration tool that benchmarks a workload on cheaper models and automates distillation or hosting.

inference & infra.title: Regional GPU routing for low-latency inference
inference & infra.problem: Users far from GPU capacity see slow responses, and real-time audio and video need locality guarantees.
inference & infra.who: teams serving users outside major GPU regions
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer regional GPU routing with data-locality pinning and fallbacks across providers.

inference & infra.title: Real-time inference for edge, robotics and small models
inference & infra.problem: Robots, cars, instruments and real-time apps need millisecond-scale inference, but cloud calls and big models are too slow or unreliable, and edge deployment is hard.
inference & infra.who: robotics and edge AI builders
inference & infra.current_solutions: Distilled tiny policies, Jetson with vLLM, small models, FPGA deployment, megakernels
inference & infra.opportunity: Build tooling to distill and deploy small real-time models to edge hardware with managed updates and latency guarantees.

inference & infra.title: Megakernels debated versus vendor-tuned kernels
inference & infra.problem: Fused megakernels promise big speedups but may lose to separately optimized overlapping kernels in production.
inference & infra.who: inference kernel engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: VLM megakernel compiler, TPU megakernel for Kimi K3

inference & infra.title: ViT megakernel for VLM preprocessing bottleneck
inference & infra.problem: Image tokenization and preprocessing become the bottleneck once VLM inference is fast.
inference & infra.who: VLM inference developers
inference & infra.current_solutions: SIMD image decoding library
inference & infra.opportunity: Build and open-source a fused ViT tokenization kernel for common VLM encoders.

inference & infra.title: Cheap GPU access for kernel development
inference & infra.problem: Spot GPUs are scarce and GPU cloud onboarding adds friction for kernel experiments.
inference & infra.who: kernel developers
inference & infra.current_solutions: Modal, Colab over SSH, Runpod
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer cheap frictionless GPU sandboxes for kernel work.

inference & infra.title: Neocloud and GPU fleet reliability problems
inference & infra.problem: Rented GPUs perform inconsistently because of undervolting, poor networking, failing nodes and bad templates, and multi-cloud fabrics are hard to operate. Jobs hang and waste costly time.
inference & infra.who: teams renting GPUs from neoclouds and running GPU fleets
inference & infra.current_solutions: Custom reliability layers, spare-node planning, health checks, eBPF TCP overlay, Modal private IPv6 network
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a reliability layer that benchmarks nodes before jobs, detects hangs and bad nodes, and migrates workloads.

inference & infra.title: Structured output and constrained decoding limits
inference & infra.problem: Few providers support strict JSON schema, and constrained decoding in vLLM prevents thinking before constraints apply.
inference & infra.who: developers needing structured outputs
inference & infra.current_solutions: json_schema structured outputs, vLLM constrained generation
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a constrained-decoding layer that allows free reasoning before schema enforcement.

inference & infra.title: Tokenization speed and bugs
inference & infra.problem: Tokenization behaves surprisingly and causes bugs, and tokenizers need drop-in speedups compatible with existing vocabularies.
inference & infra.who: ML engineers
inference & infra.current_solutions: SIMD-based fast BERT tokenization
inference & infra.opportunity: Build tokenizer debugging and drop-in fast-tokenizer tooling.

inference & infra.title: Browser and WebAssembly local AI runtimes
inference & infra.problem: Browser AI needs fast WebGPU kernels and model caching, while WebAssembly runtimes hit networking limits.
inference & infra.who: web developers running AI in the browser
inference & infra.current_solutions: Transformers.js v4 WebGPU, CacheStorage, Pyodide wheels
inference & infra.opportunity: Build WebGPU kernel libraries and WASM packaging tooling.

inference & infra.title: Memory-hungry vector search is costly to host
inference & infra.problem: Embedding vectors use lots of memory, making large vector search expensive on one node.
inference & infra.who: teams hosting vector search
inference & infra.current_solutions: Object-storage-first design with NVMe cache
inference & infra.opportunity: Build cheap object-storage-backed vector search.

inference & infra.title: Storage bottlenecks slow training and finetuning
inference & infra.problem: Slow SSDs, NFS checkpoint writes and data loading throttle GPU-bound training iterations.
inference & infra.who: training and finetuning teams
inference & infra.current_solutions: NVMe SSDs, Vortex data loading

inference & infra.title: Serving stack startup and CPU overhead
inference & infra.problem: CPU kernel-launch overhead, long torch.compile and cudagraph warmups, slow image starts and scheduler bugs waste serving time.
inference & infra.who: inference operators
inference & infra.current_solutions: Precompiled bytecode in images, upgraded torch, CUDA graphs
inference & infra.opportunity: Build tooling that profiles and reduces serving startup and CPU overhead with cached compile artifacts.

inference & infra.title: Multi-tenant hosting of LoRA and personalized models
inference & infra.problem: Hosting many fine-tuned models is costly, and loading and unloading weights at scale is an open systems problem.
inference & infra.who: platforms serving personalized models
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a multi-tenant LoRA serving platform sharing base weights with fast adapter swaps.

inference & infra.title: Frontier model access cutoffs and restrictions
inference & infra.problem: Developers lose access to models mid-workflow through government directives, and the strongest models are limited to partners.
inference & infra.who: developers dependent on frontier models

inference & infra.title: Agent-driven load stresses GitHub and developer infrastructure
inference & infra.problem: Agent commits, PRs and CI runs outpace GitHub Actions, databases and permissioning.
inference & infra.who: platform and CI operators
inference & infra.current_solutions: Load testing and reliability work
inference & infra.opportunity: Build CI and repo infrastructure for high-volume agent traffic.

inference & infra.title: Decentralized community AI compute networks
inference & infra.problem: People want to pool peer or hobbyist hardware for AI tasks outside centralized clouds.
inference & infra.who: hobbyists and decentralization advocates
inference & infra.current_solutions: Meshtastic radios idea, node NFTs
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a peer-to-peer compute sharing network for distributed inference.

inference & infra.title: Training compute utilization gaps
inference & infra.problem: RL and frontier training runs use a small fraction of available FLOPs, so waste rather than scarcity limits progress.
inference & infra.who: training teams
inference & infra.current_solutions: JAX GPU-accelerated environments

local & open models.title: Streaming giant MoE models from SSD and offloading experts
local & open models.problem: Trillion-scale and large MoE models do not fit consumer RAM or VRAM, so people build fragile custom loaders that stream experts from SSD at low throughput. Extreme quants are used alongside, with unpredictable speed and quality.
local & open models.who: enthusiasts running huge open models on laptops, Macs and small GPUs
local & open models.current_solutions: DwarfStar SSD streaming, llama.cpp expert offload and GPU cache, Strata expert placement, n-gram tables on NVMe, Unsloth dynamic quants, Apple LLM-in-a-flash, custom C engines
local & open models.opportunity: Build a packaged runtime with an autotuner that places and caches experts across VRAM, RAM and SSD and predicts speed per machine.

local & open models.title: Clustering Macs and GPUs to run huge models
local & open models.problem: Frontier open models exceed any single machine's memory, so users hand-build clusters over Thunderbolt RDMA, RPC or Tailscale. Multi-GPU control and hardware estimates are weak.
local & open models.who: power users with several Macs, DGX boxes or GPUs
local & open models.current_solutions: Exo with MLX RDMA, llama.cpp RPC over Thunderbolt 5, MLX distributed, Tailscale links, separate instances per GPU, llmfit estimates
local & open models.opportunity: Offer turnkey cluster setup and management that pools heterogeneous devices with automatic sharding, diagnostics and accurate fit estimates.

local & open models.title: Open models too large; need mid-size models and right-sizing advice
local & open models.problem: Strong open models keep growing beyond 8-24GB GPUs and 16-128GB systems, and users lack guidance on which model, quant and context fit their machine. They also ask for 30-80B or small long-context variants.
local & open models.who: local-model users with consumer GPUs, laptops and mid-range Macs
local & open models.current_solutions: Smaller variants, heavy quantization, CPU offload, waiting for community quants, manual guidance, LLmFit, hf CLI auto-pick, Qwen/Gemma 27-35B models
local & open models.opportunity: Build a hardware-aware model advisor and launcher that recommends model, quant and settings, and possibly produces distilled right-sized variants.

local & open models.title: Quantization quality is poorly measured and breaks agents
local & open models.problem: Quant comparisons use perplexity or throughput only, labels are inconsistent, and low-bit quants break tool calling, loop or degrade unpredictably. Users cannot tell which quant is safe for their task.
local & open models.who: local-model users choosing GGUF and other quants
local & open models.current_solutions: KL-divergence comparisons, Unsloth dynamic GGUFs, imatrix pipelines, QAT, higher-bit quants, trial and error, Hugging Face hardware filters
local & open models.opportunity: Build a quant benchmark and registry service publishing KLD and real task metrics, especially tool calling, per quant and hardware.

local & open models.title: Debate over usability of very low-bit quants
local & open models.problem: Users disagree whether Q1-Q3 quants of large models beat smaller higher-precision models.
local & open models.current_solutions: Rules of thumb like 4-bit as sweet spot

local & open models.title: NVFP4 builds scarce and native support lacking
local & open models.problem: NVFP4 GGUF builds are hard to find, larger than expected, and not natively run on Blackwell in many engines.
local & open models.current_solutions: NVIDIA NVFP4 Qwen builds
local & open models.opportunity: Build a catalog and converter for NVFP4 builds with runtime support and size explanations.

local & open models.title: Speculative decoding and engine tweaks for faster local inference
local & open models.problem: Local generation is slow, and speedups like MTP, DFlash and n-gram speculation need special builds, flags and GGUFs scattered across forks.
local & open models.current_solutions: llama.cpp MTP and ngram-mod, Unsloth MTP GGUFs, MLX backends, DFlash, ExLlamaV3, expert caching
local & open models.opportunity: Ship a runtime that auto-enables and tunes speculative decoding and the best backend per model and device.

local & open models.title: Broken chat templates and sampler settings hurt local models
local & open models.problem: Official or runtime-default Jinja templates, parsers and sampler settings often break tool calling and cause loops, and users patch them by hand.
local & open models.current_solutions: Community-patched templates, shared llama-server flag recipes, custom Jinja
local & open models.opportunity: Maintain a validated registry of templates and settings per model and runtime, auto-applied by runtimes.

local & open models.title: Reasoning models overthink, wasting tokens, context and time
local & open models.problem: Reasoning models produce long traces on trivial prompts, fill context and run slowly, and disabling thinking is inconsistent across models.
local & open models.who: local and API users of reasoning models
local & open models.current_solutions: no_think flags, template changes, logit bias on 'wait', system prompt caps, instruct variants, effort levels
local & open models.opportunity: Build middleware that sets reasoning effort per request and trims thinking tokens across local runtimes.

local & open models.title: Local LLM apps (LM Studio, Ollama, KoboldCPP) are buggy
local & open models.problem: Local runtimes crash, leak state, have small default contexts, non-portable installs, stale llama.cpp and missing features, often failing silently.
local & open models.current_solutions: Manual context increases, using llama.cpp directly, switching runtimes, lightweight GUIs, Fox
local & open models.opportunity: Build a more reliable local server and GUI with sane defaults, current llama.cpp, portable install and diagnostics.

local & open models.title: Local AI setup too hard for non-technical users
local & open models.problem: Most people cannot install and configure local models, and want one-click suites covering chat, documents, agents, search and home inference.
local & open models.current_solutions: Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth Desktop, TextGen, LlamaBarn, llama.app, Nativ
local & open models.opportunity: Ship a one-click local AI app or home box with auto-configuration and bundled capabilities.

local & open models.title: llama.cpp lag, breakage and GGUF compatibility
local & open models.problem: New models lack day-zero llama.cpp support, need forks or specific PRs, and GGUFs ship broken or need re-downloads after template fixes.
local & open models.who: users running new open models locally
local & open models.current_solutions: Reading commits, forks, waiting, Unsloth fixes, community ports
local & open models.opportunity: Build a compatibility tracker and validator mapping versions to supported models, GGUFs, templates and breaking changes.

local & open models.title: Routing routine work to local models, hard work to frontier
local & open models.problem: Teams want to cut spend by sending easy tasks to local or cheap models and hard ones to frontier, but routing is ad hoc.
local & open models.who: developers and teams with mixed local and cloud usage
local & open models.current_solutions: Manual switching, semantic routers, BERT classifier routers, cloud burst, small router models
local & open models.opportunity: Build a router that classifies tasks and dispatches to local or cloud models with cost and quality tracking.

local & open models.title: Cheap open models as drop-in replacements for frontier APIs
local & open models.problem: Developers hit costs and quotas with frontier models and want cheaper open alternatives with easy access and fallbacks.
local & open models.who: developers and enterprises under cost pressure
local & open models.current_solutions: OpenRouter, llm-openrouter, Synthetic.new, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, fine-tuned small models
local & open models.opportunity: Offer a gateway with automatic fallback to open models plus cost and migration comparison tooling.

local & open models.title: Wiring local coding agent stacks and harnesses
local & open models.problem: Developers want Claude Code-style coding agents on local models but must wire model, server, harness and templates by hand.
local & open models.current_solutions: OpenCode, Roo, Cline, Pi, Claude Code with llama-server or LM Studio, Ollama Modelfiles, Unsloth guides
local & open models.opportunity: Provide a tested turnkey bundle or gateway of model, runtime and harness per hardware class with correct templates and tool calling.

local & open models.title: Local agents loop and fail at tool calls and edits
local & open models.problem: Small or quantized local models loop on tool calls, ignore results, fail file edits, drift in long contexts and do not terminate.
local & open models.who: users of local coding and general agents
local & open models.current_solutions: Loop detection, forced subagents, scoped tasks, guardrails, rules files, FP8 instead of Q4, escalating to cloud
local & open models.opportunity: Build an agent layer with loop detection, tool-call and edit validation, termination guards and context management for small models.

local & open models.title: Local models need heavy prompting versus frontier
local & open models.problem: Smaller local models need explicit instructions, task breakdowns and docs, and behave like junior collaborators.
local & open models.current_solutions: Detailed prompting, task decomposition, borrowed system prompts
local & open models.opportunity: Build scaffolding that auto-decomposes tasks and injects prompts and docs to lift small models.

local & open models.title: Private web search and grounding for local models
local & open models.problem: Local models lack current knowledge and factual recall, and hallucinate, so users bolt on private search or offline knowledge without leaking data.
local & open models.current_solutions: Browser MCP, self-hosted DuckDuckGo MCP with searxng, Wikipedia backups, search and fetch tools
local & open models.opportunity: Ship a private search and offline knowledge MCP bundle with caching and citations.

local & open models.title: Long-context local inference limited by KV cache
local & open models.problem: KV cache memory and prefill cost limit long context on consumer hardware, quantizing it may hurt quality, and prompt caches fail.
local & open models.who: local users running long agent sessions
local & open models.current_solutions: Q8/Q4 KV cache, TurboQuant, dynamic KV management, cache-stable prompts, prompt-cache patches
local & open models.opportunity: Build tooling that profiles KV cost, tests quant impact on the user's workload and applies the best compression and cache strategy.

local & open models.title: Running LLMs on old hardware, phones and edge devices
local & open models.problem: People want models on CPUs, old phones, wearables and microcontrollers, but each setup needs custom builds, conversion and tuning.
local & open models.current_solutions: llama.cpp on CPU and Termux, Google AI Edge Gallery, Bonsai, Cactus, Gemma E2B/E4B on MLX, kobold.cpp
local & open models.opportunity: Provide an SDK and prebuilt runtimes with model bundles, conversion and benchmarks for common low-end devices and phones.

local & open models.title: Hand-tuning offload and memory flags for consumer GPUs
local & open models.problem: Fitting large models on small or mixed GPUs needs manual offload flags, mmap settings, driver and Vulkan tweaks, and small mistakes cut speed.
local & open models.who: users with 4-24GB GPUs or mixed hardware
local & open models.current_solutions: --cpu-moe, --mlock, -ot overrides, --no-mmap, Vulkan builds, software rendering, Q3 with q4_1 KV, ISTA/ByteShape quants
local & open models.opportunity: Build an autotuner that probes hardware and writes optimal flags and quant, KV and context settings per model.

local & open models.title: Measuring whether local models match frontier on your tasks
local & open models.problem: Users report local models matching cloud ones for everyday work, but claims are anecdotal and people lack measurements to decide when local suffices.
local & open models.who: developers and teams deciding between local and cloud
local & open models.current_solutions: Intelligence-per-watt studies, personal agents on Qwen 27B, own-domain benchmarking
local & open models.opportunity: Build a tool where users run their own tasks across local and cloud models and compare quality, cost and speed.

local & open models.title: Private local-first assistants for sensitive data
local & open models.problem: Users want to process finance, health, email, documents and meetings without sending data to the cloud, and want secure agents.
local & open models.current_solutions: OpenJarvis, local-first agents, Gemma and MedGemma, on-device meeting summarizers, Ollama, OpenClaw
local & open models.opportunity: Build offline-first apps with bundled small models and sandboxed tools for specific private workflows.

local & open models.title: Private open models for security and forensic work
local & open models.problem: Hosted frontier models refuse exploit analysis and incident response, and sensitive attacker data cannot go to APIs.
local & open models.current_solutions: Self-hosted GLM models, cyber-tuned open weights, open models on private infrastructure
local & open models.opportunity: Build a packaged on-prem security-analysis workbench with an open model, sandboxed tooling and policy-controlled refusals.

local & open models.title: Small specialized models for narrow and domain tasks
local & open models.problem: Small fine-tuned or distilled models can handle narrow tasks like translation, medical, shell commands and low-resource languages on-device, but few are ready-made.
local & open models.who: app builders needing task-specific on-device models
local & open models.current_solutions: Hy-MT1.5, FunctionGemma 270M, MedGemma, TranslateGemma, Luth-2, Indic SLMs
local & open models.opportunity: Provide a toolkit or marketplace for building and shipping tiny task-specific and regional-language models.

local & open models.title: Fine-tuning and distilling open models for enterprise tasks
local & open models.problem: Companies want small proprietary models fine-tuned or distilled from frontier models for repetitive tasks, but the process is hand-built and uncertain.
local & open models.current_solutions: Fine-tuned small Qwen3, distillation to sub-8B students, replay-based migration, Unsloth, MLX fine-tuning, LoRA adapters
local & open models.opportunity: Offer fine-tuning and distillation as a service or local toolkit that converts traces into small models with cost-quality comparison and LoRA export.

local & open models.title: Local speech-to-text and TTS tooling
local & open models.problem: Developers and users want private self-hosted transcription and TTS, but runtime support is scattered across per-model stacks, with long-audio issues and gaps in Ollama and LM Studio.
local & open models.current_solutions: Voxtral, Qwen3-ASR, parakeet-mlx, Kokoro, audio.cpp, whisper-server, mlx-audio, KoboldCPP
local & open models.opportunity: Build a unified local audio server and polished dictation apps with ASR, TTS, VAD and diarization behind one API.

local & open models.title: Local vision and image/video model runtimes
local & open models.problem: Local vision models need manual token tuning, crash in runtimes, and large image/video models need lots of VRAM or lack native support.
local & open models.who: users of multimodal and image-generation local models
local & open models.current_solutions: Manual min/max image tokens, pure C Flux, Diffusers 4-bit, ComfyUI quantized models, GPU layers set to 0, Qwen3-VL
local & open models.opportunity: Build reliable local multimodal and image runtimes that auto-tune image budgets and fit models to VRAM.

local & open models.title: In-browser model inference with WebGPU
local & open models.problem: Users want no-install local AI in the browser, but weights redownload and many models need CUDA or PyTorch.
local & open models.current_solutions: WebGPU, Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web, browser voice chat, Mirai, WebRTC peer inference
local & open models.opportunity: Build a browser runtime with persistent weight caching and ready-made conversions.

local & open models.title: Swappable adapters and steering for local models
local & open models.problem: Users want to hot-swap LoRA adapters, expertise packs and steering vectors at runtime without retraining.
local & open models.current_solutions: DwarfStar steering vectors, Jacobian-lens tensors, layer duplication, vision encoder grafting
local & open models.opportunity: Build a runtime and sharing tool for adapters and steering vectors with adjustable strength.

local & open models.title: Open-weight license terms create adoption friction
local & open models.problem: Custom licenses with revenue triggers, attribution and acceptable-use clauses make commercial use unclear.
local & open models.opportunity: Build a license-checking tool summarizing commercial-use terms and thresholds per model.

local & open models.title: Trusted Western open models and model provenance
local & open models.problem: Enterprises rely on Chinese open models but face regulatory and data-flow concerns, with unclear provenance, distillation origin and licensing.
local & open models.current_solutions: Nemotron, Arcee Trinity, Gemma, Olmo, planned US-vs-China download dashboard
local & open models.opportunity: Build provenance, audit and certification tooling with usage-by-origin dashboards.

local & open models.title: Fully open models with transparent data and recipes
local & open models.problem: Models with open data, code and recipes lag closed labs, and openness is poorly measured.
local & open models.current_solutions: Olmo, Nemotron 3 Nano, Openness Index, Trinity-Large-Thinking
local & open models.opportunity: Build tooling for scoring openness and reproducible training and data ablations.

local & open models.title: Tracking open model releases and adoption
local & open models.problem: Open models release faster than people can follow, and adoption and cost-competitiveness data is incomplete.
local & open models.current_solutions: Open Models Dashboard, ATOM Project, Interconnects trackers, Hugging Face downloads, OpenRouter usage
local & open models.opportunity: Build a live dashboard of releases, downloads, usage, licenses and adoption by organization and country.

local & open models.title: Open model ecosystem funding and sustainability
local & open models.problem: Open-weight releases may lose funding as training costs rise.
local & open models.current_solutions: Staged releases, consortium proposals

local & open models.title: Debate over open versus closed frontier gap and geopolitics
local & open models.problem: Commentators disagree on whether open models keep pace with closed ones and how Chinese and US open models compare.

local & open models.title: Open-weight safety and regulation debate
local & open models.problem: People disagree on whether open weights are safe, can be stripped of guardrails, or should be restricted.
local & open models.current_solutions: White-box research access, staged release

local & open models.title: Uncensored local models are hard to find and vet
local & open models.problem: Users want uncensored or derestricted local models for privacy, roleplay and special uses, but variants are hard to track and often lose capability.
local & open models.current_solutions: Derestricted GGUFs, OBLITERATUS, Heretic ablation, jailbreak prompts
local & open models.opportunity: Build a registry and beginner launcher showing refusal rate versus capability loss with provenance.

local & open models.title: Open model behavioral flaws: loops and hallucination
local & open models.problem: Specific open models loop, hallucinate, fabricate facts and degrade in multi-turn use.
local & open models.current_solutions: Prompt workarounds

local & open models.title: Grounding and faithfulness gaps in open models
local & open models.problem: Open models hallucinate and prefer internal knowledge over supplied data.
local & open models.opportunity: Build a grounding evaluation and guardrail layer for source faithfulness.

local & open models.title: Local inference cost versus hosted APIs and hedging
local & open models.problem: Buyers debate whether local rigs beat hosted APIs, while others self-host to hedge API price hikes, deprecation and silent changes.
local & open models.who: individuals and companies weighing local hardware
local & open models.current_solutions: Mac Studio and 3090 rigs, DGX Spark clusters, Qwen via Ollama, local archiving of weights
local & open models.opportunity: Build cost calculators, migration tooling and managed local or on-prem setups with version pinning.

local & open models.title: Hardware benchmarks before buying
local & open models.problem: Buyers cannot tell how a model will run on a given machine, and benchmarks omit prompt-processing speed and hardware details.
local & open models.current_solutions: canirun.ai, ad hoc benchmarks, Intelligence per Watt
local & open models.opportunity: Build a crowdsourced benchmark database for speed, quality and cost across hardware.

local & open models.title: Cheap single-token classification with local models
local & open models.problem: Teams want fast calibrated classification and verification without full generation.
local & open models.current_solutions: Single-token logprob classification, decision models, constrained JSON prompts
local & open models.opportunity: Build a library to turn any local GGUF into a calibrated zero-shot classifier.

local & open models.title: Local embeddings and RAG tooling
local & open models.problem: Private local RAG needs embeddings and tools that small models can drive.
local & open models.current_solutions: EmbeddingGemma, nomic-embed with LanceDB, sqlite-vec stacks, MCP tools
local & open models.opportunity: Build an out-of-box local RAG bundle with embeddings, vector store and MCP tools.

local & open models.title: Weight archiving and takedown-resilient mirrors
local & open models.problem: Open weights may be restricted or removed, and users want to archive them.
local & open models.current_solutions: Torrent GGUF mirrors, local archives
local & open models.opportunity: Offer a decentralized mirroring and archival service with verified checksums.

local & open models.title: Consent-based community open AI
local & open models.problem: Users want local open AI trained on consensual data.
local & open models.opportunity: Build community-run consent-based model projects.

local & open models.title: Persistent memory for local LLMs
local & open models.problem: Local LLMs lack persistent recall.
local & open models.current_solutions: Modified Ollama source with memory file
local & open models.opportunity: Build a pluggable memory layer for local runtimes.

local & open models.title: Apple Silicon MLX ecosystem management
local & open models.problem: Mac users depend on MLX ports, and models and caches duplicate across runtimes.
local & open models.current_solutions: mlx-lm, LM Studio MLX, Nativ, DwarfStar on Metal
local & open models.opportunity: Build tools unifying MLX and GGUF model management.

local & open models.title: Local model management and remote access UX is clunky
local & open models.problem: Users want a community-driven tool for experimenting with local models, simple remote access to LM Studio, and easy pulls and cache management. Some runtimes cannot import GGUFs.
local & open models.current_solutions: Tailscale or SSH tunnels; LLM CLI plugin; LM Studio plugins; day-one multi-runtime support
local & open models.opportunity: A unified local model manager with remote GUI access, trust-building output citations and cache cleanup.

local & open models.title: Efficient architectures and speedups for cheaper inference
local & open models.problem: Hybrid attention, compressed latent attention, multi-token prediction and diffusion text models cut memory and latency for local inference. These are research directions rather than products.
local & open models.current_solutions: Gated DeltaNet MoE; CCA; multi-token prediction; DiffusionGemma; layer duplication

local & open models.title: Local models still too weak to replace Claude Code
local & open models.problem: Models that run on 8-24GB machines are too slow or not capable enough for serious coding, lag frontier models, and need more steering. Opinions differ on how close they are.
local & open models.who: Developers trying to use local models for agentic coding
local & open models.current_solutions: Larger MoE models, mixed local and cloud use

model training & fine-tuning.title: Reward hacking and flawed RL environments
model training & fine-tuning.problem: RL and RLVR training lets models exploit weak rewards, hardcode test outputs or learn from bugged, unsolvable tasks. Nobody systematically audits environments or rewards, and fixes are patched one hack at a time.
model training & fine-tuning.who: labs and teams running RL post-training
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: LLM judges on tool-call intent, checkpoint rollbacks, inoculation prompting, KL terms and clipping, format rewards, safeagents guard
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build tooling that audits RL environments and reward functions for solvability and exploits and monitors rollouts for hacking during training.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Scalable verifiable RL environments: creation and infrastructure
model training & fine-tuning.problem: RL scaling needs thousands of realistic, verifiable environments that are slow to build by hand and mostly exist for code and math. Environment infrastructure is also buggy and hard to debug.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Hugging Face Hub environments, Prime Intellect env hub, Atropos, synthetic environment generators, bought environments, Modal sandboxes
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a platform that generates, versions, shares and load-tests verifiable RL environments from repos, text or domain data.

model training & fine-tuning.title: RL training frameworks, throughput and systems bottlenecks
model training & fine-tuning.problem: LLM RL training is slow and complex because of weight sync, rollout cost, train-inference mismatch and synchronous updates. Choosing a framework is confusing.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: TRL AsyncGRPO, Miles, SLIME, VeRL, SkyRL, Axolotl, bitwise-consistent TRL+vLLM, speculative decoding in rollouts, async RL
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer a lightweight, fast RL framework or hosted service with async rollouts, fast weight sync and benchmarked defaults.

model training & fine-tuning.title: GRPO and RL fine-tuning instability
model training & fine-tuning.problem: GRPO and RLVR runs collapse, spike in gradients, or mismatch between training and inference, and fixes are scattered across papers and forums.
model training & fine-tuning.who: practitioners running GRPO or RLVR fine-tuning
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Dr. GRPO, DAPO tricks, importance-sampling corrections, score centering, switching to DPO, empirical tuning
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Ship a trainer with robust defaults and diagnostics that flag instability early.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Managed fine-tuning services for open models
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fine-tuning or RL-tuning open models still needs GPUs, expert engineering and architecture-specific serving decisions, especially after frontier-lab fine-tuning APIs were withdrawn.
model training & fine-tuning.who: enterprises and non-expert teams customizing open models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Tinker, Fireworks, Prime Intellect Lab, Mistral Forge, Unsloth notebooks, Hugging Face skills
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a managed, self-serve service that handles data prep, training, evaluation and serving for open models.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Small fine-tuned specialists replacing frontier models
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Frontier models are costly and slow on narrow, repeated tasks, and fine-tuned or distilled small models can match them. Teams lack the expertise to build them, and custom models may be superseded by newer bases.
model training & fine-tuning.who: companies running high-volume narrow tasks on frontier APIs
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Shopify and Liquid AI distillation, Harvey fine-tuned Kimi, Cursor Composer, Databricks KARL, ModernBERT classifiers, routers
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer a pipeline that turns usage traces and a benchmark into a cheaper specialist model, routes between models, and ports fine-tunes to new bases.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning library bugs, version breaks and cryptic errors
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Unsloth, TRL, DeepSpeed and similar stacks break on installs, versions, tokenizers, collators, dtypes, vision models and exports, and users waste compute diagnosing them. LoRA parameter counts can also look wrong.
model training & fine-tuning.who: people fine-tuning models with open-source libraries
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Version pinning, manual patches, Docker setups, Discord troubleshooting, Unsloth fixes
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a pre-flight validator and debugger that catches config, version, tokenizer, template, dataset schema and export problems before compute is spent.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning on low-VRAM consumer GPUs and OOM errors
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fine-tuning and RL on 8-24GB GPUs and Macs hits out-of-memory errors, and people cannot predict memory or compute needs in advance.
model training & fine-tuning.who: hobbyists and small teams with consumer GPUs
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Unsloth kernels, QLoRA, activation offloading, packing, Flash Attention 2, free Kaggle GPUs, Runpod and Vast.ai
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a memory-aware tool that estimates VRAM and cost and auto-configures training to fit the user's hardware.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Cheap from-scratch and small-scale training experiments
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Hobbyists and small labs want to pretrain tiny models and run cheap experiments, but guidance, compute and scaling heuristics are limited.
model training & fine-tuning.who: hobbyists, small labs and researchers on small budgets
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: nanoGPT speedruns, nanochat $100 recipe, autoresearch loops, cheap 1.1B model runs
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide a minimal pretraining and RL speedrun kit with experiment tracking and automated optimization.

model training & fine-tuning.title: MoE and large-scale training tooling gaps
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Open tooling for training and post-training mixture-of-experts models is immature and fragmented, and large MoE training is unstable and costly.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams training or tuning MoE models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: TorchTitan SFT, Unsloth MoE kernels, torchao MXFP8, Megatron Core MoE, dense models instead
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build simpler open MoE training and SFT/RL wrappers with fused kernels and expert parallelism.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Preference tuning flattens style and voice
model training & fine-tuning.problem: RLHF and preference tuning cause sycophancy, blandness and a generic assistant voice, and preference data is opaque. Users want models in their own writing voice or persona.
model training & fine-tuning.who: writers, users wanting custom style, and preference-data teams
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Fine-tuning on own writing, DPO variants, system prompts, character training
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a tool that fine-tunes on a person's writing, measures needed examples, and audits preference data for style bias.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning causes unintended side effects and misalignment
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Narrow or bad fine-tuning data causes emergent misalignment, persona drift and hidden behaviors that are hard to detect or undo.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams fine-tuning models and safety researchers
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Inoculation prompting, SAE diffing, deception probes, introspection adapters, checkpoint reverts
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build behavior-diff and regression tools that scan models before and after fine-tuning for side effects.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Distillation provenance and geopolitics disputes
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Labs and commentators dispute covert distillation, terms-of-service violations and whether Chinese labs close gaps by distilling US models.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Terms of service, account bans

model training & fine-tuning.title: Distillation toolkits and teacher-trace curation
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Distillation into smaller models gives inconsistent results, can import teacher quirks or mismatched planning, and needs heavy curation of traces. Methods are scattered.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams distilling frontier or reasoning models into small ones
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: MOPD, on-policy distillation, trace distillation from Claude or GLM, thinking-token masking, DPO with strong-vs-weak pairs, Upskill
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a toolkit that collects, scores and filters teacher traces and tests whether distillation helps the student.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Synthetic data generation and dataset building for fine-tuning
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Building, generating, cleaning and grading fine-tuning datasets is the bulk of the work, and synthetic data suffers imbalance and quality issues. Small or unbalanced data gives poor fine-tunes.
model training & fine-tuning.who: people fine-tuning models without good datasets
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Claude/GPT-generated pairs, agentic synthetic loops, Madlab, rubric synthesis, adding labeled samples
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a dataset workbench that generates, filters, grades, balances and diagnoses fine-tuning data for a stated task.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Training data curation, mixtures and poisoning
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Choosing, filtering and auditing training data, including data mixes, dangerous content, poisoning and synthetic spam, lacks good tools. Some want licensed or era-limited corpora.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Proxy-model mix search, OpenThoughts-Agent pipeline, filtering and labeling documents, narrow-corpus training
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build corpus curation and auditing tools for mix search, poisoning, duplication, synthetic content, licensing and anachronism.

model training & fine-tuning.title: LoRA adapter merging, compression and management
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Teams want to merge, compress, share and swap adapters and fine-tune deltas, but merging is harder after RL and PEFT variants are fragmented.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams managing many fine-tunes and adapters
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: MergeKit, delta-export CLI, Doc-to-LoRA and Text-to-LoRA, DoRA, MoLA routing
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer an adapter hub with tooling for merging, routing, compressing and delivering deltas.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Finding fine-tunable open models
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Nobody systematically tracks which open base models fine-tune well, and base models behave unpredictably when tuned. Hugging Face search is cluttered.
model training & fine-tuning.who: developers choosing open base models to fine-tune
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Counting HF derivative finetunes, base-only filter, community fine-tunes
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Create a finetunability benchmark and curated model directory with quality metadata.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Continual learning from deployment and catastrophic forgetting
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Deployed models do not learn from production traces or corrections, and online fine-tuning causes forgetting. Teams are unsure whether to put knowledge in weights or context.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams running production models and agents
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Cursor's online RL, Baseten trace self-improvement, clinician-edit flywheels, replay data, OpenClaw-RL
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a feedback-to-weights pipeline that captures traces, trains periodic updates with replay and measures forgetting.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Weight editing and steering with side-effect validation
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Direct weight edits, abliteration and steering change behavior without training but can degrade unrelated capabilities, so users need validation.
model training & fine-tuning.who: users editing or steering open models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Heretic, reversible edits with held-out checks, Qwen-Scope SAEs, targeted MLP edits
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a weight-editing and steering toolkit with automatic regression checks.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Low-precision training and quantization pitfalls
model training & fine-tuning.problem: FP8/FP4 and mixed-precision training and quantization cause underflow, overflow, quality loss and silent bugs. GGUF conversion and compressed-model evaluation are brittle.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Quantization-aware distillation, selective MXFP4, QK norm, KL-vs-full-precision checks, merged_4bit_forced
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build linting, conversion and evaluation tools that flag precision pitfalls and measure capability loss after quantization.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Optimizer choice and training stability
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Muon variants and other optimizers lack clear guidance, fair benchmarks and hyperparameter heuristics, and cause instability or non-reproducible results.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Gram Newton-Schulz, HeavyBall, NorMuon, Optuna, Trackio, sqrt batch scaling rule
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build an optimizer benchmark and hyperparameter search and reproducibility tool.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Opaque and hard-to-reproduce open training recipes
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Labs omit post-training details and data, and academics lack resources to reproduce them, with duplicated effort across open projects.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: NousCoder, OLMo releases, DeepSeek pipelines, NeMo, Dolci-Think-SFT

model training & fine-tuning.title: Pretraining scaling limits and decentralized compute
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Scaling returns are diminishing and pretraining is out of reach for small labs, while decentralized runs are far smaller than frontier runs.
model training & fine-tuning.who: small labs and outside compute contributors
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Prime Intellect distributed training, Covenant-72B, Zagora, federated training, layer duplication
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a platform that coordinates pooled, heterogeneous compute for shared training runs.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Robot learning data, simulation and reward bottlenecks
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Robotics lacks internet-scale data, mature post-training recipes and standard success and reset practices. Policies fail to generalize and need costly teleoperation data.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: World-model rollouts, teleoperation fine-tuning, Egocentric-10K, synthetic trajectories, RL from human-assisted trials
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build tools for robot data collection, success labeling, synthetic worlds and world-model policy evaluation.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Agent training transfer across harnesses and tools
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Agents trained on one harness or workflow transfer poorly, harness features are being baked into weights, and tool-using small models need end-to-end training. Models fail outside their training distribution.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Multi-harness RL proxy, Polar, Eval Protocol, Renderers, Agent-R1, atomic-skill training
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide pipelines that capture harness runs and train agents across harnesses with reward-hacking guards.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Image, video and audio generation model training
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Training generative visual and audio models is costly and data-hungry, and long videos lose consistency.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Bootstrapping from image diffusion, planner-then-render, VAE latents, temporal VAE compression

model training & fine-tuning.title: Domain-specific models for niche languages, code and science
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Niche domains like COBOL, low-resource languages, embeddings and biology lack open base models, data and architectures.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: CoT incident log generation, LLM-RecSys with semantic IDs, striped hyena for DNA
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build domain-specialized fine-tuned models and datasets for niche languages and legacy code.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Prompt optimization as an alternative to weight training
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Users want prompt and program optimization like GEPA as a cheaper alternative to fine-tuning or RL.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: GEPA, DSPy, custom adapters, cue prepending
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build an automated prompt-optimization service integrated with evals.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Local no-code UIs for fine-tuning
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fine-tuning still requires scripts and CLI work, and users want a GUI for datasets, training and running models locally.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Unsloth Studio, Madlab, HF Skills Training, Unsloth-MLX
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a polished local app from documents to a fine-tuned LoRA with guided defaults and evaluation.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Serverless multi-node training for mid-sized jobs
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Setting up GPU clusters for post-training or 64-GPU-scale jobs is hard, leaving mid-sized training underserved.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Modal serverless RDMA clusters, Spindle, forward-deployed engineers
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer serverless training clusters with simple APIs, including speculator and draft-model training.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Open datasets of agent traces and expert behavior
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Open agents need real session traces and expert workflow data, but redaction is hard and human-labeled trajectories are costly.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: dataclaw, SWE-ZERO-12M, opt-in usage credits, labeling vendors, expert interviews
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a platform for contributing, redacting and licensing agent traces and expert workflow data.

model training & fine-tuning.title: RL beyond verifiable rewards
model training & fine-tuning.problem: RL works for math and code but not non-verifiable domains, and tacit know-how and hard-to-evaluate tasks limit supervision.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Rubric-based RL, LM reward models, LLM-as-judge hybrids, Lean verifier rewards
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build reward-modeling tooling for rubric-based and learned rewards.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Controlling reasoning length and loops
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Reasoning models overthink and loop, wasting tokens, and teams want to cut length without losing accuracy.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Toggle RL, Antidoom/FTPO, linear length penalty, effort-conditioned RLVR
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide packaged post-training recipes that shorten reasoning and prevent loops.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Repeating layers to boost model performance
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Duplicating middle layers without changing weights improves benchmarks, suggesting cheap gains.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Layer duplication with shared weights
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a tool to search layer-repetition configs automatically.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Injecting new knowledge into models without long context
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Users want models to absorb documents or facts via LoRA or continued pretraining, and are unsure whether to fine-tune or use retrieval.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Continued pretraining, RAG, SIEVE
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a tool that compiles documents into LoRA adapters or continued-pretrained models.
