model training & fine-tuning.title: Is fine-tuning worth it versus frontier models?
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Teams debate fine-tuning versus frontier models and harnesses, and LoRA versus full tuning or dense versus MoE bases.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Frontier models with harness fixes, vertical models, routers, LoRA/QLoRA on gpt-oss, RAG

model training & fine-tuning.title: Multimodal training frameworks and vision adapters
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Researchers lack easy frameworks for multimodal RL and for adding vision to text models.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Training only a small projector with frozen encoder and LLM
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build an easy framework for adding modalities and multimodal RL.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Coding agents automating ML experiments and post-training
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Researchers use coding agents to iterate on training code and run fine-tuning loops, but agent-fixed bugs go uninspected and reward design is the crux.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Claude Code skills for fine-tuning, autoresearch pipelines, PostTrainBench, overnight agent iteration
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build an agentic experiment runner that builds data and rewards, runs fine-tunes, tracks results and enables review.

model training & fine-tuning.title: RL and models for GPU kernel writing
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Writing fast GPU kernels is hard, and RL can speed up kernels but needs datasets, environments and verification.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: KernelBot datasets, CUDA Agent, MiniTriton, Triton-to-PTX translator with verifier
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a kernel-generation and verification assistant or RL service.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Training outside the PyTorch/CUDA mainstream
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Alternative stacks like Mojo, tinygrad, Apple Neural Engine and Keras backends lack training libraries.
model training & fine-tuning.who: developers on non-mainstream hardware and frameworks
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Manual backprop in MAX, tinygrad via safetensors, Keras 3 backends
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build portable training layers for alternative hardware and frameworks.

model training & fine-tuning.title: RL for science and engineering domains
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Scientific and physical domains lack training data, so RL environments from experiments, simulators or physics verifiers are needed.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Physics-based verifiers, experiment-timeline environments, Eureka reward generation
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build environment generators for lab and engineering domains.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Long-horizon RL and deep-network RL research gaps
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Multi-turn and long-context RL lacks data and methods, and RL struggles to use deep networks, with debate over value-based versus policy-gradient methods.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Critic-based alternatives, 1000-layer RL networks, Olmo 3.1 extended RL

model training & fine-tuning.title: Quick custom classifiers from few examples
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fine-tuning a classifier or vision model for one-off tasks is too tedious even though few examples can suffice.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: ModernBERT embeddings, Moondream Lens, segmentation fine-tuning with 10 examples
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a one-click custom classifier trainer from a handful of labeled examples.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Uncensored models for benign safety work
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Safety refusals block benign tasks like crime prevention and education tools.
model training & fine-tuning.who: vetted safety and education tool builders
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer an uncensored open MoE fine-tune for vetted use cases.

observability & cost.title: Hard spend caps and budget gateways for LLM usage
observability & cost.problem: Provider spend limits are mostly soft alerts enforced after the fact, so teams get surprise bills. Teams need enforceable per-user, per-agent or per-period dollar and token caps.
observability & cost.who: teams and companies running LLM APIs and agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: AWS project spend limits, Google Cloud Spend Caps, Cloudflare AI Gateway budgets, thin proxies, virtual cards, manual watching
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a proxy or gateway that enforces real pre-request hard caps across providers, per team, user, agent or task.

observability & cost.title: Runaway agents need per-run budgets and loop detection
observability & cost.problem: Looping, retrying or multi-agent runs burn tokens unchecked, with no per-run cap or attribution of which agent is responsible. Spend can reach thousands of dollars before anyone notices.
observability & cost.who: developers and teams running autonomous or multi-agent workflows
observability & cost.current_solutions: Claude Managed Agents session budgets, Cloudflare Wallet limits, billing alerts, manual supervision
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a per-run budget guard with loop and anomaly detection that pauses agents, asks for approval and attributes spend.

observability & cost.title: Enterprise AI token spend tracking, attribution and budgeting
observability & cost.problem: Companies cannot see, attribute, cap or forecast AI token spend per employee, team, tool or agent, and budgets get exhausted within months.
observability & cost.who: engineering leaders, finance teams and CFOs at companies adopting AI
observability & cost.current_solutions: Per-employee caps, LLM gateways, Cloudflare AI Gateway budgets, ccusage, internal seminars on cutting usage
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a spend dashboard and gateway with per-user and per-team attribution, forecasting, policy enforcement and audit logging.

observability & cost.title: Linking AI token spend to outcomes, ROI and productivity
observability & cost.problem: Organizations cannot show whether token spend yields valuable output. Token counts and AI-written code share are gameable or misleading proxies.
observability & cost.who: engineering leaders and finance teams justifying AI spend
observability & cost.current_solutions: Factory Analytics, Cursor AI-code share, commit and token counts, company measurement surveys
observability & cost.opportunity: Build analytics that tie token spend to delivered work, quality and cost per unit of output.

observability & cost.title: Opaque subscription quotas and usage meters
observability & cost.problem: Subscription users see little about remaining quota, burn rate or what drained their limits, and limits run out unexpectedly and faster than expected.
observability & cost.who: heavy users of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and similar subscription plans
observability & cost.current_solutions: Menu-bar trackers like Headroom, switching tools, /clear and /compact, stacking Max plans, cron prompts to refresh windows
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a cross-provider quota meter that shows remaining budget, per-action burn, history and forecasts, and recommends plans.

observability & cost.title: Credit and quota plans burn down with no warning
observability & cost.problem: Credit-based or call-quota plans can be exhausted in minutes or days with no warning, caps or visibility into what consumed them.
observability & cost.who: users of credit-based AI and API plans
observability & cost.opportunity: Build credit-burn alerting and call-budgeting layers that warn before big consumption.

observability & cost.title: Per-session and API-equivalent cost trackers for coding agents
observability & cost.problem: Developers cannot see what each coding-agent session, subagent or project costs, or what it would cost at API rates, and built-in dashboards are too coarse.
observability & cost.who: developers using coding agents on flat plans or remote agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: ccusage, AgentsView, token-watch, claude-devtools, manual summing
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a unified token and cost analyzer for coding agents showing API-equivalent cost, waste patterns and plan comparisons.

observability & cost.title: Tokenizer changes silently inflate costs
observability & cost.problem: New tokenizers, hidden system prompts and non-English text change token counts for the same input, raising effective prices even when list prices are flat.
observability & cost.who: developers and teams choosing or switching LLM models
observability & cost.current_solutions: Claude token counting API, Simon Willison's Claude Token Counter
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a cross-provider token and cost estimator that shows real counts for your own prompts and documents.

observability & cost.title: Comparing true cost per task across models
observability & cost.problem: Per-token prices, tiers, caching and reasoning levels make list prices a poor guide, and teams lack a standard way to compare effective cost per useful task.
observability & cost.who: teams choosing between LLM models for their workloads
observability & cost.current_solutions: Artificial Analysis cost-vs-intelligence charts, manual benchmarking and price comparison
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a benchmarking tool that runs users' own workloads across models and effort levels and reports realized cost per task.

observability & cost.title: Token-hungry new models erase per-token price advantages
observability & cost.problem: Newer or cheaper-looking models use many more output and reasoning tokens, so all-in task cost and quota drain rise even when list prices are flat or lower.
observability & cost.who: teams upgrading model versions and heavy API users
observability & cost.current_solutions: Adaptive reasoning, scoping tasks, lowering reasoning effort, manual testing, shorter structured outputs
observability & cost.opportunity: Build regression tracking that benchmarks token usage and cost of new model versions on users' own traces before switching.

observability & cost.title: Long-context tiered pricing is hard to predict
observability & cost.problem: Prices that jump past prompt-size thresholds like 100K or 200K tokens make long-context cost hard to budget or compare.
observability & cost.who: developers running long-context or batch workloads
observability & cost.current_solutions: Manual calculation, scoping tasks
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a cost calculator that handles tier thresholds and forecasts batch or agent costs.

observability & cost.title: Cost-aware routing to the cheapest adequate model
observability & cost.problem: Users default to top models for simple tasks and overspend, and lack independent evidence that routers save money without hurting quality.
observability & cost.who: teams running agent and LLM workloads at scale
observability & cost.current_solutions: Cloudflare model router, Cursor Router, Not Diamond, LLMRouter, Coinbase and Databricks routing, batch APIs, downgrading to Haiku
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a model and effort router with built-in evaluation that proves cost and quality tradeoffs per workload.

observability & cost.title: Prompt caching misses and wasted context inflate agent costs
observability & cost.problem: Cache invalidation, resent context, bloated instruction files and long sessions drive most agent spend, yet cache hit rates and waste are hard to see.
observability & cost.who: developers and teams running coding agents and long-running agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: Append-only history, prompt caching, context compaction, CLI output filters, tiered file loading, fresh sessions
observability & cost.opportunity: Build diagnostics showing cache hit rates, what breaks cache prefixes and context bloat, with pruning and compaction that preserves key rules.

observability & cost.title: Silent model degradation and substitution by hosted providers
observability & cost.problem: Hosted models may be quietly rerouted, quantized or reconfigured under the same name, and users have no reproducible way to verify quality or model identity.
observability & cost.who: developers and users relying on hosted LLM APIs and subscriptions
observability & cost.current_solutions: Archived launch-day prompts as regression harness, canary evals, system prompt diff tracking, model fingerprint tests
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a service running continuous canary prompts, fingerprint probes and frozen benchmarks that alerts on drift per provider.

observability & cost.title: Vendor status pages do not reflect real outages
observability & cost.problem: Official status pages show green or stay silent during outages and degraded answers, so users rely on Downdetector and community reports.
observability & cost.who: users and developers depending on AI providers
observability & cost.current_solutions: Downdetector, status pages, retry scripts pinging APIs
observability & cost.opportunity: Build an independent aggregator and prober that cross-checks vendor status and alerts users, with failover.

observability & cost.title: Agent tracing, trace storage and viewers
observability & cost.problem: Agent behavior is decided at runtime, so traces are the main debugging artifact, but they need good storage, ingestion, viewing and replay.
observability & cost.who: teams building and operating LLM agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Datadog LLM Observability, OpenTelemetry, SmithDB, Raindrop, custom trace viewers
observability & cost.opportunity: Build lightweight open tracing with fast ingestion, deduplicated history, nested trace viewing and replay.

observability & cost.title: Visibility into what coding agents did across sessions
observability & cost.problem: Developers lack one view of what coding agents read, which tools and subagents ran, why tokens burned and how full context is, and cannot replay trajectories.
observability & cost.who: developers running one or several coding agents in parallel
observability & cost.current_solutions: Agentsview, claude-devtools, Lapdog, Traces CLI, Claude HUD, tmux labels, ChatGPT Activity sidebar
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a unified session viewer and monitor showing context, tool calls, subagents, token breakdowns, status and replay.

observability & cost.title: Triaging agent failures from traces into evals
observability & cost.problem: Agent failures are reasoning failures across long traces and nobody can read them all, so teams need clustering, root-cause classification and conversion into evals.
observability & cost.who: teams operating agents in production
observability & cost.current_solutions: Langfuse, promptfoo, LangSmith Engine, Raindrop Triage, W&B Weave, Sazabi, trace sampling
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a trace triage tool that clusters failures, classifies root causes and feeds annotations into regression evals.

observability & cost.title: Tracing multi-agent handoffs and provenance
observability & cost.problem: In multi-step pipelines it is hard to see which agent produced what, what was passed between agents and who owns bad output.
observability & cost.who: teams building multi-agent pipelines
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a tracing tool that graphs lead-to-subagent payloads and records decisions and delegated work.

observability & cost.title: Production observability and ops for AI-generated code
observability & cost.problem: AI-accelerated shipping raises on-call burden, and AI code ignores instrumentation conventions. Teams need agent-friendly logs, incident context and production validation.
observability & cost.who: engineering and SRE teams shipping AI-generated code
observability & cost.current_solutions: Sazabi, Interfere, AI SRE startups, Datadog MCP, CLI-accessible logs, canaries, auto-rollbacks
observability & cost.opportunity: Build agent-ready incident tooling linking code, runtime state and runbooks that validates AI changes in production and rolls back safely.

observability & cost.title: Runtime watchdogs and guardrails for autonomous agents
observability & cost.problem: Agents have gone unmonitored for weeks, leaked data, deleted repos, coordinated exploits or disabled monitors, and offline review is too slow.
observability & cost.who: labs and enterprises running agent fleets
observability & cost.current_solutions: Watcher Live, MCPShark, watchdog agents, OpenAI multistage monitoring, auto-review systems, 24/7 CoT monitoring
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a runtime monitor that detects anomalies, blocks actions, pauses sessions and resists being disabled.

observability & cost.title: Tamper-resistant audit logs for agent actions
observability & cost.problem: Agents have deleted logs, spoofed tool results and altered transcripts, so there is no trustworthy record of what happened.
observability & cost.who: teams and investigators auditing agent actions
observability & cost.opportunity: Build append-only, tamper-evident logging of agent decisions and tool calls with attribution.

observability & cost.title: Chain-of-thought monitoring is unreliable and illegible
observability & cost.problem: Reasoning traces can look fine while outputs are misaligned, and they can be terse, hidden, unfaithful or degraded by training, weakening monitors.
observability & cost.who: AI labs and safety researchers
observability & cost.current_solutions: Non-CoT channels, ensemble monitors, activation probes, reasoning summaries

observability & cost.title: Monitoring frontier and internal agents for misalignment
observability & cost.problem: Labs and enterprises detect misbehavior, coordination, sandbox escapes and hidden agent-to-agent communication late, and lack tools to oversee swarms.
observability & cost.who: AI labs and enterprises deploying agents internally
observability & cost.current_solutions: OpenAI monitoring with P0 alerting, trajectory monitor ensembles, METR red-teaming, offline monitoring pipelines
observability & cost.opportunity: Build monitoring and audit products that detect coordination, destructive actions and agent-to-agent deception, and can halt runs.

observability & cost.title: Reviewing huge agent logs and mining transcripts
observability & cost.problem: Agent transcripts run to hundreds of millions of tokens, making manual incident review impractical, and mining them for corrections and failures is manual.
observability & cost.who: teams reviewing agent incidents and improving agent workflows
observability & cost.current_solutions: Daily log analysis, correction phrase mining, /insights, off-the-shelf models analyzing transcripts
observability & cost.opportunity: Build trustworthy forensic and analysis tooling that summarizes transcripts, verifies findings and recommends config, skill and doc updates.

observability & cost.title: GPU rental price and compute cost transparency
observability & cost.problem: GPU prices are volatile and opaque, published indices diverge from what users pay, and companies lack tools to track compute cost and margins.
observability & cost.who: AI startups, GPU buyers and inference providers
observability & cost.current_solutions: Ornn and Silicon Data price indexes, serverless GPU inference, self-hosting
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a GPU price index and TCO tracker using prices paid, utilization and demand data.

observability & cost.title: Comparing inference throughput across providers and hardware
observability & cost.problem: Metrics like tokens per second and throughput with or without cache hits are ambiguous, and routed providers cause speed surprises.
observability & cost.who: teams choosing inference providers and hardware
observability & cost.current_solutions: Running own benchmarks, pinning faster OpenRouter providers, Activity tab, Broadcast to Langfuse
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a standardized benchmark and dashboard reporting TTFT, throughput, cost and quantization quality across providers.

observability & cost.title: GPU profiling and training observability tooling
observability & cost.problem: GPU kernel profiling is error-prone, large traces crash viewers, and tracking training runs and stragglers is painful.
observability & cost.who: ML engineers training models and writing GPU kernels
observability & cost.current_solutions: Triton do_bench, nvbench, Perfetto, Nsight Systems, ncompass, TraceML, picomon, W&B, TensorBoard, Grafana over vLLM
observability & cost.opportunity: Build scalable profiling, trace viewing and cross-run analysis tools for training and inference.

observability & cost.title: Tracking AI crawlers, agent traffic and brand visibility
observability & cost.problem: AI scrapers spoof user agents and AI referrals appear as direct traffic, so site owners cannot see AI crawler visits or brand mentions in assistants.
observability & cost.who: site owners, brands and hosting operators
observability & cost.current_solutions: Promptwatch, Upstash Agent Analytics, Mintlify agent analytics, reverse DNS checks, edge rate limits, CDN blocking
observability & cost.opportunity: Build analytics that classify AI crawlers, agents and humans and track referrals and brand mentions in chatbot answers.

observability & cost.title: Subsidized flat-rate plans hide real cost, causing shock
observability & cost.problem: Flat-rate subscriptions are priced below inference cost, so users and enterprises face shocks as pricing shifts to per-token billing.
observability & cost.who: users and enterprises on flat AI plans
observability & cost.current_solutions: Fixed team seats, stacking two Max plans, local models, switching providers, API-rate trackers
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a plan-versus-API cost simulator that forecasts token burn and cost under changed pricing.

observability & cost.title: Estimating and bounding cost of agentic workflows
observability & cost.problem: One user action triggers many calls via tools, retries, subagents and reasoning, so cost is hard to forecast and spikes only appear with real users.
observability & cost.who: teams building multi-step agent products
observability & cost.current_solutions: Per-step cost tracking, separating retries and heavy paths, scoped tasks
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a cost-modeling tool that forecasts workflow cost from step composition and flags runaway paths.

observability & cost.title: Unified observability across engineering, security and data
observability & cost.problem: Observability, security and data lineage stores stay siloed and legacy SIEMs lag AI-era threats, yet agents need a unified view.
observability & cost.who: platform, security and data teams
observability & cost.current_solutions: Datadog acquiring Metaplane, closed-loop detection learning
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a unified observability layer spanning code execution, threat detection and data lineage.

observability & cost.title: AI energy and datacenter footprint transparency
observability & cost.problem: Energy, water and datacenter footprints, including those of coding agents, are reported vaguely or only for median chat queries.
observability & cost.who: researchers, policymakers and the public

observability & cost.title: Transparency and validation for LLM apps in production
observability & cost.problem: Teams lack tooling to see what LLM apps do behind the scenes and to validate that AI outputs behave as intended.
observability & cost.who: teams shipping LLM applications
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a transparency and assessment framework exposing app internals and validating production behavior.

observability & cost.title: LLM cost attribution per request, task and user
observability & cost.problem: Provider dashboards show only aggregate totals and observability tools show flat spans, so cost cannot be traced to a request, agent loop, retry storm or user.
observability & cost.who: teams operating LLM apps and agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: OpenRouter Broadcast to Langfuse and Datadog, Tailscale Aperture, per-route cost proxies, custom metrics
observability & cost.opportunity: Build APM-style tracing that rolls token cost up to request, task, user and agent loop and flags retry and context drift.

observability & cost.title: Reasoning effort tiers have unclear cost-benefit
observability & cost.problem: Higher reasoning effort multiplies cost and latency with diminishing returns, and hidden billed reasoning tokens make results unpredictable.
observability & cost.who: developers choosing reasoning effort settings
observability & cost.current_solutions: Manually calibrating effort levels and testing outputs
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a tool that evaluates quality versus cost per effort tier on a user's tasks and recommends settings.

observability & cost.title: Measuring MCP and tool-schema token overhead
observability & cost.problem: MCP tool schemas and responses consume tokens on every request, and counting them is hard because tokenizers are model-specific.
observability & cost.who: developers using MCP tools with agents
observability & cost.current_solutions: count_tokens API, manual trimming of tool descriptions
observability & cost.opportunity: Build an MCP token profiler that measures per-tool cost and suggests pruning or lazy loading.

observability & cost.title: AI provider unit economics and financial opacity
observability & cost.problem: Subsidies, heavy usage and opaque metrics like run-rate revenue and adjusted EBITDA make AI provider economics hard to interpret and unsustainable.
observability & cost.who: analysts, investors and customers

observability & cost.title: LiteLLM compromise and LLM dependency pinning
observability & cost.problem: A supply-chain compromise of LiteLLM showed the risk of unpinned dependencies and 'latest' image tags in LLM deployments.
observability & cost.who: teams deploying LLM infrastructure
observability & cost.current_solutions: Pinning versions and avoiding auto-updates
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a dependency and image-integrity checker tailored to LLM infrastructure.

observability & cost.title: Token fraud and unexplained API charges
observability & cost.problem: Stolen keys, resold traffic and compromised accounts cause unexpected charges and inference gateway abuse.
observability & cost.who: LLM API account owners and gateway operators
observability & cost.opportunity: Build key-leak and anomalous-usage detection for LLM API accounts and gateways.

observability & cost.title: Wasteful logging of full chat histories
observability & cost.problem: Chat APIs resend and log the whole conversation each turn, storing massive duplicate JSON.
observability & cost.who: teams logging LLM conversations
observability & cost.current_solutions: Content-addressable Git-style SQLite message store
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a deduplicating LLM log store as a library or service.

observability & cost.title: Embedding and vector search costs block features
observability & cost.problem: Text embedding and vector search costs can far exceed infrastructure budgets, making features infeasible.
observability & cost.who: developers building search and retrieval features
observability & cost.current_solutions: Embedding cheaper low-fps video and audio instead
observability & cost.opportunity: Build cost-efficient embedding and vector search services or cost estimators.

observability & cost.title: Closed-loop detection and repair of failing agent tasks
observability & cost.problem: Teams want systems that find failure patterns in usage data and predict hard tasks before they fail, without manual oversight.
observability & cost.who: teams operating agent products
observability & cost.current_solutions: Synchronous failure-mode predictor, agents surfacing product issues from usage
observability & cost.opportunity: Build a product that mines workflow runs and usage for failure patterns and auto-remediates.

observability & cost.title: Frontier model price hikes and LLM price tracking
observability & cost.problem: New model versions often cost more, and model IDs and tiered prices change frequently, so developers need an up-to-date comparison.
observability & cost.who: developers choosing LLM APIs
observability & cost.current_solutions: Manual checking of pricing pages and cost-versus-performance plots
observability & cost.opportunity: Build an LLM API pricing tracker that normalizes tiered, cached and reasoning prices across providers.

observability & cost.title: Measuring real open-model adoption
observability & cost.problem: Download counts and platform disclosures do not show actual use of open models, so ecosystem adoption is hard to judge.
observability & cost.who: researchers and open-model builders
observability & cost.current_solutions: Open Models Dashboard using OpenRouter data, ATOM Project download tracking, relative adoption metrics
observability & cost.opportunity: Build an open-model usage index combining inference-volume and download signals across platforms and regions.

observability & cost.title: Production quality evals and bad-output detection
observability & cost.problem: Teams need to measure product quality without exposing private data and detect bad generations automatically at affordable cost.
observability & cost.who: teams running LLM products in production
observability & cost.current_solutions: LLM-as-judge evals, custom dashboards
observability & cost.opportunity: Build privacy-preserving online eval tools that detect poor outputs and trigger alerts or refunds.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Personal knowledge bases and second brains for agents
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People want years of notes, bookmarks, emails and files organized and searchable by LLMs and agents. Ad hoc setups for sync, structure and local search are fragile.
productivity & knowledge work.who: knowledge workers, researchers and note-takers using Obsidian or markdown vaults with agents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Obsidian with Claude Code, Karpathy-style markdown wikis, custom MCP servers, SyncThing and git hooks, SQLite FTS5 indexers, local Qwen search, QMD playbooks, Notion workers
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a packaged, local-first, agent-ready personal knowledge vault that ingests notes, bookmarks, emails and files and supports plain-English search and sync.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI chat memory and history are non-portable and unmanageable
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Context, memory and chat history don't carry across chats, projects or providers, and users can't inspect, scrub or organize them. Users re-explain context and fear lock-in.
productivity & knowledge work.who: heavy users of ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Memory-file review, conversation exporters, re-uploading chats as PDFs, forking chats, summarizing into fresh chats, preference files, Projects
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a local, portable, editable memory and chat-history layer that exports, searches, forks, scrubs and syncs across assistants with per-project isolation.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Teams lack shared memory and tacit knowledge for agents
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Institutional knowledge, SOPs and decisions live in people's heads or get lost when answers are shared or employees leave. Every agent chat needs re-explaining.
productivity & knowledge work.who: teams and companies deploying agents, and product teams handing context to agents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: WorkIQ, Granola MCP, Notion as an operating system, Zapier Shared Brain, ContextMCP, AI assistants answering new-hire questions
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a shared company-memory layer capturing SOPs, decisions and product context with permissions preserved for agents.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Shared workspaces where humans and agents collaborate
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Agents work in isolation and sharing outputs or coordinating with people is lossy. Teams want agents inside shared threads, docs and the tools they already use.
productivity & knowledge work.who: teams working with multiple agents in Slack, Notion, Linear and shared documents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Slack-launched agents, Notion External Agents API, Linear agent workflows, Duet, Hubble, Poe group chat, kanban agent boards, Roughdraft markdown commenting
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a multiplayer workspace where people and agents share threads, documents, artifacts and handoffs.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Personal AI chief of staff and proactive daily assistant
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People want one assistant that spans email, calendar, files and tasks, plans their day, and acts proactively. Current setups are DIY and siloed.
productivity & knowledge work.who: busy professionals and less technical users wanting a personal assistant
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Markdown agent folders, Claude Code and Cowork as chief of staff, Gmail briefing agents, ChatGPT scheduled tasks, Dots, Bond, Daily Brief
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an easy hosted personal-agent product with connectors, daily briefings, task tracking and prioritization.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Task management designed for agentic work
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Todo lists and kanban boards don't fit agent workflows where human check-ins matter more than the code.
productivity & knowledge work.who: people running Claude Code, Codex and Gemini agents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Markdown todo files
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a simple cross-agent todo tool that works with multiple coding agents.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Email clients and agents for inbox triage
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Inboxes overwhelm users and built-in AI summaries and filters miss important mail. Users want controllable triage, rules and drafts using their own history.
productivity & knowledge work.who: professionals with heavy email loads
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Gmail filters and labels, Superhuman split inboxes, custom Claude Code CLIs and skills, local email tables, internal MCPs, AI-secretary startups
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a fast email client or agent with natural-language rules, personal context retrieval and reliable triage, labeling and reply drafting.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI-written messages and documents burden recipients
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Colleagues, managers and counterparties send long AI-polished or unreviewed text that buries intent, and recipients can't tell what is asked or what the sender thinks. Review becomes the bottleneck, including for filings and contracts.
productivity & knowledge work.who: workers, managers, reviewers and legal teams receiving AI-generated messages, proposals and filings
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Asking for the original prompt, length caps with the ask first, replying with AI, AI summaries, legal teams condensing filings with their own AI
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a condenser that extracts the ask, decision and key issues from long AI-written messages and documents and flags stale facts.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI-generated spam, cold outreach and low-quality submissions
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Inboxes, feeds, newsrooms and review queues fill with AI-generated outreach, pitches and tips that are hard to tell from genuine ones and waste expert time.
productivity & knowledge work.who: professionals, journalists and editors receiving unsolicited AI content
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Pangram email checks, ignoring unsolicited emails, personal boundaries
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build filters that detect, quarantine and triage automated outreach, pitches and tips.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Preserving personal voice when writing and editing with AI
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI editing and drafting flatten personal style, hedge claims and change meaning. Writers want critique and suggestions without wholesale rewrites.
productivity & knowledge work.who: writers, bloggers and authors using AI to draft or edit
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Voice skill files, custom GPTs trained on past writing, AI used only as critic, diff-based review, nightly style-guide updaters, Kagi proofreading
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a voice-learning writing assistant that critiques and proposes diff-reviewable edits, flags meaning changes and never rewrites wholesale.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Generic AI prose tells and slop
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI-generated text has stock phrases, padding and uniform polish that readers recognize and discard, and prompting against it often fails. Single-pass output lacks iteration.
productivity & knowledge work.who: anyone publishing or sending AI-assisted writing
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Anti-slop system prompts, memory prompts, repeated revisions, manual editing, switching models
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a slop-linting and multi-pass rewrite tool that detects and removes AI tells and checks output against style constraints.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Detecting and disclosing AI authorship
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Readers, editors and platforms can't tell how much of a text is AI-written, and human authors can't prove their work is their own. Detectors give false positives and there are no disclosure norms.
productivity & knowledge work.who: readers, editors, publishers, communities and writers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Pangram, Substack's Pangram partnership, end-of-piece AI disclosures, colleague confirmation, manual spotting of tells
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build detection plus provenance and disclosure tooling showing how much was AI-written, with low false-positive rates.

productivity & knowledge work.title: LLMs as manuscript editors and long-form writing aids
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Authors want whole-manuscript review for structure, proofreading and references, but LLMs lose coherence in long non-fiction as errors compound.
productivity & knowledge work.who: authors and long-form writers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Claude and GPT reviewing full manuscripts, deep-research reference checking
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a manuscript review and planning service combining structural editing, reference verification and iterative judge-model feedback.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Verifying AI output and fact-checking claims
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI output has fabricated or subtly wrong facts and citations, and checking it costs as much as it saves. Users without expertise can't judge quality and data agents give nothing to verify.
productivity & knowledge work.who: writers, analysts and professionals relying on AI output
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Forcing quotes for Ctrl-F, clicking citations, second-model fact checks, requesting reference links, notebook-style output listing assumptions
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a verification layer that links claims to sources and shows assumptions, intermediate steps and unverified items.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Absorbing and reviewing the flood of agent output
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI output volume exceeds human capacity to read and review, and agent reports and shared artifacts are hard to render and share.
productivity & knowledge work.who: people supervising agents and sharing their outputs
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Asking for HTML, diagrams or plain English, Eraser Diagrams, Gist rendering, visual explainer skills, comment-on-HTML review
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a reading and publishing layer that turns agent output into compact, visual, shareable documents and consolidates decisions for approval.

productivity & knowledge work.title: On-demand generated UIs, dashboards and mini-apps
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Fixed app interfaces don't fit changing needs, and users want purpose-built widgets and throwaway dashboards on demand.
productivity & knowledge work.who: knowledge workers and teams wanting custom lightweight apps
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Vibe-coding tools, malleable software ideas, Lovable internal tools, Claude Interactive Apps, throwaway HTML pages
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a platform where users describe a widget or dashboard and the assistant builds and hosts it inside their work app.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI-built internal tools replacing SaaS
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Teams build custom internal tools with AI instead of buying software, but results are fragile and hard to repair, ship and trust.
productivity & knowledge work.who: small businesses and teams building internal tools without engineers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Cloudflare dashboards, LLM-written scripts, vibe-coded CRMs and inventory apps, sandboxed extensions
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a platform to build, host, monitor and self-repair internal apps for non-technical teams.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Keeping up with AI news without noise or hype
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI news and product launches are overwhelming and hype-toned. People want curated, filterable digests on emerging tech.
productivity & knowledge work.who: practitioners and enthusiasts following AI
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: news.smol.ai, Gemini scheduled summaries, HN digests, Techpresso, RSS readers, newsletters, web-change monitors
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a personalized, low-noise AI news digest agent with topic filtering that can also exclude AI topics.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Confusing AI model lineups, modes and tool choice
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Fast-changing products with unclear names, modes and limits make it hard to know which model or tool to use, and users juggle several subscriptions side by side.
productivity & knowledge work.who: AI users and non-experts choosing between models and products
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Running multiple frontier models side by side, manual copy-paste comparison, Inforno, OpenRouter, outside explainers
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a router and guide that recommends and compares models per task, tracks changes and consolidates subscriptions.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Requirements gathering and spec-first planning for agents
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Agents need strong upfront specs but people have incomplete requirements, and the slow elicitation work isn't automated.
productivity & knowledge work.who: builders and product teams directing coding agents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Chat-based architecture discussions, living specs, agents asking clarifying questions, spec-driven development
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a requirements-elicitation and planning tool that interviews stakeholders and maintains a living spec handed to agents.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Deciding what to build when building is cheap
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Shipping is cheap, so deciding what should exist, proving impact, and linking customer feedback to prototypes are the bottleneck. Review and testing lag behind fast coding.
productivity & knowledge work.who: product teams and PMs
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Pilot-scale-kill cycles, prototype-first handoffs, feedback-driven idea generation, dogfooding
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build tools that ground ideas in customer feedback, track feature value and speed review and handoffs.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI-built apps lack distribution and discoverability
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Building is commoditized so distribution matters more, and quality AI-built projects are buried and unnoticed.
productivity & knowledge work.who: solo builders and small teams shipping AI-built projects
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Polished READMEs, launch-style docs, agent skills for social posting
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build discovery and launch tooling that surfaces quality projects and helps builders find users.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Agent-driven work causes burnout and attention fragmentation
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Parallel agents, dopamine loops and endless side projects cause context switching, overwork, exhaustion and half-finished work. People also struggle to stop and stay focused.
productivity & knowledge work.who: heavy agent users, including ADHD users
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Limiting to 2-4 sessions, removing the laptop at set times, PR-sized stopping points, Cold Turkey, ADHD Claude skills, break-reminder hooks
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build tools that time-box sessions, queue and resurface agent tasks, enforce stopping points and provide focus scaffolding.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Cognitive offloading and skill atrophy from AI reliance
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Offloading thinking and craft to AI erodes skills, ownership and satisfaction, and people debate which tasks to keep human.
productivity & knowledge work.who: heavy AI users, students and professionals
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: AI-free tasks, handwriting, physical books, timers limiting AI use

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI thinking partners that push back
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Chatbots flatter and agree, so users want AI that challenges assumptions, offers perspectives and raises ambition. Many also don't know how to prompt for real judgment.
productivity & knowledge work.who: people using AI to brainstorm and evaluate ideas
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Adversarial custom instructions, steelmanning, persona debates, Absolute Mode prompts, devil's advocate requests, meta-prompting
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a thought-partner app with critic modes and multiple perspectives that draws on the user's past work and shows its verification.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Prompt writing and prompt library management
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Generic, underspecified or overlong prompts waste credits and degrade results, and writing good prompts is a learned skill.
productivity & knowledge work.who: AI users across skill levels
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Claude skills writing tool-specific prompts, git prompt libraries, Promptsloth, meta-prompts, custom instructions
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a prompt generator and manager that interviews users and adapts prompts for different models.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Measuring real AI productivity gains
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People overestimate gains, usage and output metrics mislead, and it's hard to tell when AI helps or wastes time. Teams lack outcome-level measures.
productivity & knowledge work.who: individuals, team leads and executives adopting AI
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Comparing to prior estimates, session and context-switch tracking, Epoch-style tracking
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build analytics that measure outcomes such as shipped PRs and closed tickets and advise when delegating to AI pays off.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Evidence on AI productivity is contested
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Studies and reports conflict on whether AI delivers gains, and claimed gains don't show in revenue or shorter work weeks.
productivity & knowledge work.who: executives, workers and researchers

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI for legal documents and consumer legal help
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Lawyers need bulk document review with citations and codified firm knowledge, and consumers want cheap help reviewing contracts and navigating legal processes.
productivity & knowledge work.who: law firms and consumers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Harvey, Office & Dragons, Claude for legal, firm-specific agents, FreeDemandLetter.com, dragging PDFs into chatbots
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build legal review tools with bulk extraction, citations, firm precedent knowledge and consumer contract and lease help.

productivity & knowledge work.title: LLM summaries miss what matters
productivity & knowledge work.problem: LLM summaries misjudge importance, distort details and need repeated passes.
productivity & knowledge work.who: people summarizing meetings, papers and documents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Pasting PDFs into chatbots, chatting with Claude about papers
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a source-grounded summarizer tuned for meetings and papers.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Long PDFs and images break AI ingestion
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Long PDFs and images cause hallucinated numbers, silent truncation and degraded reading, forcing manual splitting.
productivity & knowledge work.who: users feeding large documents to AI chat
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Splitting files, PDF-to-image conversion for vision models, Gemini Flash, custom transcribers
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a document pipeline that guarantees full ingestion, extracts reliably, verifies numbers and shows what was read.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Condensing long videos into summaries
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People lack time to watch long videos and want highlights and timestamped transcripts.
productivity & knowledge work.who: learners and researchers consuming video
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: TLDW, Gemini API with YouTube URLs via llm CLI
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a video-to-highlights and transcript service integrated into note tools.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Private local transcription, dictation and meeting capture
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Users want fast private transcription of speech, long recordings and meetings, voice dictation into any app, and meeting follow-ups or coaching without cloud bots.
productivity & knowledge work.who: professionals, note-takers and meeting participants
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: MacWhisper, Parakeet, Spokenly, Wispr Flow, Typeless, Granola Briefs, Radiant, Alter
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a local-first voice and meeting app with speaker labels, direct text insertion, summaries, tasks and coaching that agents can call.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Digitizing handwriting and historical documents
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Handwritten notes, scanned textbooks and archives are hard to convert into searchable text.
productivity & knowledge work.who: researchers, students and archivists
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Multi-agent OCR, translation and typesetting pipelines
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an OCR-and-structure tool for cursive notes and archive troves.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI slide and office document generation
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Generated slides and documents are image-based, hard to edit, mangle formatting and look generic. Slide tools are clumsy for technical content.
productivity & knowledge work.who: professionals and builders producing decks and documents
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Gamma, NotebookLM slides, Perplexity asset creation, Claude Office files, Kami design skill, Julius, Paper2Slides, Keynote WebP export
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an agent-native deck and document tool with editable HTML or PDF output, preserved formatting, varied layouts, charts and citations.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Agents for non-technical knowledge work
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Non-coders want to delegate multi-step tasks through a graphical interface with safe permissions, visible plans, memory and mobile monitoring, but current tools hide process and lack features.
productivity & knowledge work.who: non-technical knowledge workers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Codex for non-coding work, Openwork, Claude Chrome extension, Telegram-driven harnesses
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a sandboxed graphical agent workspace with visible plans, project memory, connectors and remote progress checks.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Coding-agent tools repurposed for general work
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Claude Code, Cowork and Codex are being stretched into office work, leaving unclear which tool fits which task.
productivity & knowledge work.who: knowledge workers choosing agent tools
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Cowork merging into chat, Codex for research synthesis, Genspark workspace

productivity & knowledge work.title: Sales, CRM and lead workflow automation
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Salespeople spend too much time on admin, quoting and outreach, and inbound leads and feedback arrive when no human is available.
productivity & knowledge work.who: sales and marketing teams
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Clay with Apollo, Attio, n8n, open-source Clay alternatives, Vercel's lead-response agent
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a CRM that automates admin, quoting, lead response and personalized outreach.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Academic peer-review and grant evaluation overload
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Reviewers and evaluators get unwanted requests with no easy permanent opt-out, face AI-written manuscripts and reviews, and are swamped by applications.
productivity & knowledge work.who: journal reviewers, editors and grant evaluators
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Anti-AI notices, keyword screening, email autoresponders, pasting abstracts into chatbots, Obsidian notes
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a reviewer-side manager that triages and declines requests, checks citations, pre-screens applications and tracks notes.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Bureaucratic and personal paperwork automation
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Forms, permits, reimbursements and routine admin take heavy time and give unclear answers.
productivity & knowledge work.who: parents, small businesses and individuals dealing with administration
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Manus autofill, agent-drafted correction emails, Codex and Claude Code with browser control, virtual cards
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build domain-specific agents that navigate permits and forms and handle reimbursements with review.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Synthetic panels for market research
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Market research and concept testing rely on costly, slow human panels.
productivity & knowledge work.who: product managers and market researchers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Auto-research tooling for PM experiments
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a synthetic-panel simulator for surveys, concept tests and A/B tests.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Deep research tools have confusing limits and shallow results
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Deep research features have unclear limits, ignore attachments, vary by plan and dump reports instead of conversing.
productivity & knowledge work.who: researchers and professionals using deep research
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Searxng, manual pricing tracking, moving to GPT Pro
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a conversational background deep-research tool with clear usage and file handling.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Research and analyst agents for reports and monitoring
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Analysts and researchers want agents that synthesize filings, data and papers into reports, comparisons and monitoring, and make results easy to check.
productivity & knowledge work.who: analysts, investors and researchers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Per-deal CLAUDE.md with MCP subagents, Monitor by Parallel, research-agent armies, Codex for papers, Refine, tabular review tools
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build vertical research agents with always-on monitoring, row-and-column bulk review and cited structured outputs.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Blog and newsletter publishing workflow automation
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Writers spend effort on cross-posting, formatting, cadence tracking, bookmark curation and exposing archives to agents.
productivity & knowledge work.who: bloggers and newsletter writers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Vibe-coded Chrome extensions, Substack scripts, Beats system, MCP plugin for blogs, Datasette Agent, bookmark-to-Markdown syncing
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an agent-friendly publishing assistant that cross-posts, formats, tracks cadence and repurposes saved posts.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Reading companions and research literature processing
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Researchers and readers drown in PDFs and papers, and uploading them to chatbots distracts or hallucinates. They want grounded, readable, citable digests.
productivity & knowledge work.who: researchers and book readers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: NotebookLM, Readwise with agents, DOI-to-BibTeX-to-Zotero pipelines, Papiers, podcast-style summaries, open-source NotebookLM alternatives
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a source-grounded reading and literature pipeline with citation libraries, audio summaries and model-agnostic notebooks.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Gap between AI power and everyday adoption
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Most people use AI passively and free-tier users lack awareness of true capabilities.
productivity & knowledge work.who: general workers and free-tier users
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: AI fluency frameworks, informal applied workflows
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build training and onboarding that teaches workflows and capability discovery.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Clinic pre-visit prep and clinician-style notes
productivity & knowledge work.problem: AI output without patient context is generic, and doctors want visit prep and notes in their own format and phrasing.
productivity & knowledge work.who: clinicians
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a pre-visit summary and note generator using chart context and per-clinician style profiles.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Auto-generated documentation from code and tickets
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Documentation and release notes lag behind code and support work.
productivity & knowledge work.who: engineering and support teams
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Copying version diffs into an LLM, Manicule-style agent plus human service
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build tools that turn code, diffs and resolved tickets into docs.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Calendar scheduling is clunky and fragmented
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Users want to merge personal and work calendars and book slots by dragging, and conflict analysis needs custom scripts.
productivity & knowledge work.who: professionals managing several calendars
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Custom Claude Code scripts for conflict analysis
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a unified calendar view with drag-based booking links.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Ingesting personal activity into agents and work journals
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Browsing, shell, screen and reading history are hard to capture as queryable context, or as automatic daily journals and retrospectives.
productivity & knowledge work.who: individuals wanting recall of their own activity
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Shell and editor logging daemon via MCP, Codex Chronicle, keep.surf, screen logging, WorkIQ MCP server, open-source Mac tracker
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a local activity capture and recall layer exposed to agents that also writes daily and weekly summaries.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Turning recorded work into reusable agent skills
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People and companies lack visibility into how work is done and want demonstrations converted into repeatable skills and workflows.
productivity & knowledge work.who: individuals and companies automating processes
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Claude Skills screen recording, on-device Gemma workflow converter, Scribe Optimize, consultant process mapping
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a recorder that converts demonstrated tasks into shareable agent skills and process insights.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Reliable spreadsheet, BI and financial analyst agents
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Agents in Excel and Sheets are slow, fragile and error-prone, quality varies by vendor, and analysts want checkable models and actionable BI. Office integrations from Google and Microsoft underperform Claude.
productivity & knowledge work.who: analysts and teams working in Excel, Sheets and Office
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Claude for Excel, ChatGPT in Excel/Sheets, Shortcut, Sheets Canvas, Interpreter, Crunched, Claude Cowork, Workspace Studio
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a cross-suite Office and spreadsheet agent that shows assumptions, verifies work and handles mixed files and bulk edits.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Web search degraded and sites need agent-readable content
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Search results are polluted with AI filler, and users want concise trustworthy answers while sites need agent-readable versions.
productivity & knowledge work.who: searchers and site publishers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: ChatGPT or Perplexity as search, /llm.txt, publishing Markdown
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a reading-mode or search layer returning concise sourced content and agent-optimized site versions.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Customer feedback synthesis and support routing
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Feedback, tickets, calls and interview data are scattered and need clustering, routing and synthesis into product insight.
productivity & knowledge work.who: product and support teams
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Cheap classification models, Pylon Product Intelligence, Railway's Central Station, Notion Research Agent, Slack/Notion LLM support automation
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a tool that clusters and routes feedback across channels into prioritized insights.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Small business bookkeeping, tax and finance help
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Small businesses and individuals pay a lot for bookkeeping and tax planning, still chase receipts, and face rule-based categorization failures.
productivity & knowledge work.who: small businesses and individual filers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: QuickBooks, Xero, AI cashflow projection from CSVs, Grok and Claude for taxes
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an AI bookkeeping and tax planning assistant with receipt chasing and adaptive categorization.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Confusing AI product surfaces and unreliable connectors
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Overlapping product modes and slow or non-working connectors to Drive, Gmail and OneNote confuse users.
productivity & knowledge work.who: users of AI assistants with workplace data
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Gemini Deep Research workspace connection
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an aggregator that unifies personal and work data connectors reliably.

productivity & knowledge work.title: AI usage limits and credit burn disrupt workflows
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Throttled limits, fast credit use and token-heavy modes break daily workflows.
productivity & knowledge work.who: heavy AI subscribers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Using Sonnet for light tasks
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build usage-aware model routing that preserves limits.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Technical note-taking and LaTeX authoring
productivity & knowledge work.problem: No single tool handles math, diagrams and notes well, since Markdown lacks math and LaTeX is cumbersome.
productivity & knowledge work.who: scientists and technical writers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Prism, AI LaTeX editors, dual Markdown and LaTeX sync
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a unified technical notes editor with math, diagrams and AI editing that compiles to TeX.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Measuring and improving visibility in AI answers
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Companies don't know how AI systems mention or rank them, and OpenAI obscures search behavior.
productivity & knowledge work.who: marketers and companies
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Repeatable prompt tests, 'how did you hear about us' surveys
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build an AI-visibility monitor tracking brand mentions across chat answers and social channels.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Lowering the barrier to starting and sustaining blogging
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Writers hesitate to blog from fear of being unoriginal and debate length and drafting strategy.
productivity & knowledge work.who: aspiring bloggers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Short TIL posts, internal blogs, multiple drafts

productivity & knowledge work.title: Paper versus CAD for woodworking planning
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Hobbyist woodworkers find CAD slow for throwaway design iterations and prefer paper.
productivity & knowledge work.who: hobbyist woodworkers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: Paper and pencil shop drawings, AI-assisted CAD
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a simple joinery planning tool handling clearances and measurements faster than CAD.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Forced AI features degrade interfaces
productivity & knowledge work.problem: Copilot, Gemini and other AI features are pushed into products with no clean way to disable them, slowing simple tasks.
productivity & knowledge work.who: users of Windows, Office, Workspace and other apps
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a utility or opt-out controls that disable or hide AI upsells across apps.

productivity & knowledge work.title: Email tone polishing and fear of sending mistakes
productivity & knowledge work.problem: People use AI to soften and polish emails because sent mail is permanent and mistakes are costly.
productivity & knowledge work.who: email writers
productivity & knowledge work.current_solutions: General-purpose chatbots as tone editors
productivity & knowledge work.opportunity: Build a tone-check email tool that rewrites fraught messages before sending.

research & capabilities.title: LLM hallucinations and confidently wrong outputs
research & capabilities.problem: Models fabricate facts, quotes, sources and basic arithmetic with unwarranted confidence, so users must verify everything and lose time savings. Errors are hard to predict and often missed even by experts.
research & capabilities.who: professionals and researchers using LLMs for fact-sensitive work
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Manual verification; choosing models by task; newer or paid tiers with lower hallucination rates; domain-specific testing before trust
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build verification and confidence-calibration layers that cross-check citations, claims, quotes and arithmetic in LLM output and flag likely errors.

research & capabilities.title: Research assistants return fabricated sources and links
research & capabilities.problem: Deep research and grounding features return fabricated or degraded links and sources and omit risks. They fail at evidence integration.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Superagent fact-checked reports; manual checking
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build a citation checker that verifies every source link and claim against the retrieved text.

research & capabilities.title: LLMs lack world models; neurosymbolic alternatives proposed
research & capabilities.problem: LLMs generalize poorly, memorize, and lack structured knowledge of time, space and causality, so they plan and reason badly. Critics argue for world-model or neurosymbolic hybrids.
research & capabilities.who: developers and researchers needing reliable planning and reasoning
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Neurosymbolic approaches; neural perception plus symbolic planner hybrids; domain-specific AI; JEPA
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build hybrid systems pairing LLMs with symbolic solvers, verifiers or explicit causal knowledge for reliable planning.

research & capabilities.title: Frontier models fail at spatial, counting and visual detail tasks
research & capabilities.problem: Models miscount objects, miss fine visual details, misread layouts and plots, and draw poor diagrams. These failures limit visual and spatial work.
research & capabilities.who: developers and scientists applying VLMs to images, plots and layouts
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Checking with Python; agentic vision loops that crop and zoom; bounding-box and counting grounding tools
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build evals and tool-augmented pipelines that expose and compensate for what VLMs fail to see, count or lay out.

research & capabilities.title: World and video models lack physical consistency and control
research & capabilities.problem: Video and interactive world models show implausible physics, clipping, error accumulation, weak object permanence and poor action conditioning. There is also no clear definition of a world model.
research & capabilities.who: world-model and video-generation researchers and developers
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Fine-tuning video diffusion on physics-simulation data; causal streaming conversion; Genie 3; JEPA
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build physics-consistency evaluation and memory or control layers for long-horizon interactive world models.

research & capabilities.title: Tooling for controllable and playable world models
research & capabilities.problem: Interest is growing in real-time, controllable and multiplayer world models, but tooling for prompting, controlling and evaluating them is early.
research & capabilities.who: developers building on world models and game-like environments
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Waypoint-1.1; GWM Worlds 2; Solaris multiplayer data engine; game-engine bootstrapping
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build developer tooling and datasets for controlling, evaluating and generating training data from world models.

research & capabilities.title: Debates over world models, scaling and AGI paths
research & capabilities.problem: Researchers and commentators disagree about whether scaling, LLMs, world models or new architectures lead to AGI, and whether progress is plateauing or accelerating. These are opinion and research disputes.

research & capabilities.title: AI-generated math proofs are hard to verify and digest
research & capabilities.problem: AI produces proofs faster than mathematicians can read, check or understand them, often unformalized and unreadable. Autoformalization in Lean is costly and unsolved.
research & capabilities.who: mathematicians and researchers receiving AI-generated proofs
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Lean formal verification; autoformalization workflows; AXLE; Numina-Lean-Agent; Harmonic Aristotle; literate proofs with LaTeX and Lean
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build tools that autoformalize, machine-check, summarize, rank and explain AI proofs so humans can triage real results.

research & capabilities.title: AI research claims lack provenance, attribution and reproducibility
research & capabilities.problem: AI-assisted results are announced without prompts, inputs, transcripts or clear human versus AI contributions. Credit is disputed and results cannot be audited.
research & capabilities.who: scientists, mathematicians and reviewers evaluating AI-assisted results
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Lean machine-checking; expert verification; storing sessions in a coding agent as a notebook
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build a registry and logging tool recording inputs, prompts, transcripts, cited prior work and human versus AI contributions.

research & capabilities.title: Vetting a flood of AI-generated scientific results
research & capabilities.problem: AI generates scientific results faster than humans can check or absorb them, making verification the bottleneck.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Verification-heavy workflows; provenance and ex-ante evaluation proposals
research & capabilities.opportunity: Create a platform to vet, track provenance of and distribute AI-generated discoveries and decode them for humans.

research & capabilities.title: Journals and conferences flooded by AI-written papers
research & capabilities.problem: Publishing systems are overwhelmed by hollow, AI-written, fabricated or fraudulent papers and citations. Detectors and integrity checks are lacking.
research & capabilities.who: journal editors, conference organizers and reviewers
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Preregistration, code sharing and living papers proposed
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build detection, citation-checking and triage tools that flag AI-generated or fraudulent submissions for editors.

research & capabilities.title: Peer review under strain and AI-assisted reviewing
research & capabilities.problem: Peer review suffers from volume, poor reviewer matching, low-quality or LLM-written reviews, biased decisions and unclear AI norms. Reviewers also lack tools to check literature coverage or proofs.
research & capabilities.who: reviewers, authors, and conference and journal organizers
research & capabilities.current_solutions: AI reviewers with human review; reviewer incentives; OpenReview; EMNLP 2026 LLM review experiment; GPT-5.5 Pro paper audits; Google Scholar Labs; Semantic Scholar
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build reviewer-matching, review-quality, appeal tracking and AI paper-audit tools with human oversight.

research & capabilities.title: AI-written research has weak methods and enforcement gaps
research & capabilities.problem: AI-generated papers have weak statistics, uninteresting hypotheses and unenforced preregistration.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Expert review
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build audit tools that check AI research for statistical validity and enforce preregistration.

research & capabilities.title: Interpretability and SAE tooling and infrastructure
research & capabilities.problem: Interpretability researchers need shared, scalable, open tooling for probing, SAEs, feature labeling and attribution. Existing methods give unclear results and are hard to use in practice.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Goodfire Silico; Gemma Scope 2; NNsight; Neuronpedia; concept probes; attribution graphs; natural language autoencoders; Seer
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build open, user-friendly libraries and platforms for probing, SAE training, feature browsing and automated interpretability experiments.

research & capabilities.title: Interpretability findings are unreliable and disputed
research & capabilities.problem: Neuron and SAE explanations can be spurious, polysemantic or artifacts, and do not explain whole-network behavior. Interpretability lags capability growth and its safety value is disputed.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Using AI agents to accelerate interpretability research
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build validation tools that stress-test interpretability claims against random baselines and alternative concepts.

research & capabilities.title: Steering and editing model behavior via activations and weights
research & capabilities.problem: Developers want to change model traits cheaply by steering activations or editing weights, but steering weakens in long contexts and its reach beyond style is unclear.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Slop-subtraction steering; attention-head honesty steering; weight-space programming; vector-based abliteration; KV-cache steering; hand-edited MLP circuits
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build toolkits for applying, calibrating and evaluating steering vectors and small weight edits.

research & capabilities.title: Chain-of-thought traces are unreliable evidence of reasoning
research & capabilities.problem: Reasoning traces may be decorative, state answers before deriving them, or be hidden under training pressure, so they are shaky evidence for monitoring. Researchers dispute whether they reflect genuine reasoning.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: CoT monitoring; external process checking; recovered reasoning-trace analysis; filler-token approaches
research & capabilities.opportunity: Build tools that verify whether a reasoning trace faithfully reflects the computation behind an answer.

research & capabilities.title: Reward hacking and automated alignment research
research & capabilities.problem: RL-trained models exploit reward flaws and grader-game, and patching hacks one at a time does not scale. This complicates automating alignment research.
research & capabilities.current_solutions: Patching individual hack patterns; outer-loop optimizers against held-out benchmarks
